title: Senior Backend Developer
description: Payroll that runs itself. You build the part that runs it. quinn is an app-based managed payroll and employment-administration service for households and companies who employ people directly. The customer stays the legal employer. quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, pays salaries, social insurance and taxes, and handles every filing that follows, on their behalf and automated end to end. We don’t sell payroll software. We run payroll. We operate in Switzerland, Germany and the UK. Last year more than CHF 200 million in salaries ran through our systems, correct to the cent. The purpose behind it is simple: fair employment, for all. Why this role exists Every market brings its own authorities, insurers, pension funds and tax rules. Our answer is quinn ONE: one platform for every product and market, with a shared core for what all countries have in common and a configuration layer per country on top, designed to carry twelve countries. The backend is that core. It is a modular monolith in C#, .NET 10 and PostgreSQL, serving one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, Maestro for batch processing, and our AI agents. Development has started, and the foundations the platform will run on for years are being laid now. This role is fully focused on quinn ONE. Our existing products are not part of it. What you will own Backend modules, end to end. Design, build, test and run modules and the APIs they expose, from requirements to production, without waiting to be handed a ticket. The data. The PostgreSQL model the platform rests on: schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and the calculations that must be right to the cent. The foundations. Audit trail, logging, versioning of our APIs and services, and the database upgrades that keep the platform current. Reliability and security in production. Tests, observability, performance, and data protection by design: an API returns what is needed, not everything that is available. Root causes, not symptoms. The architecture, pragmatically. Module boundaries, dependencies, the shared core and the country layers, evolved with clear trade-offs rather than fashionable patterns. The engineering bar. Code review, design discussions, and mentoring the developers around you, in Zurich and in our Armenia team. Where the frontend ends, the backend begins. Our Product Frontend Engineer owns everything on the screen: the app, Maestro’s interface, the component library. You own everything behind it: the domain model, the payroll logic, the APIs, the integrations with authorities, insurers and banks, and the data. You agree the API contract together, and Product decides what gets built. How we work We are AI-native, operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how a small team ships like a large one, and how one engineer can hold the standard described here. We expect you to live in these tools and build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, test generation, migration checks, and whatever else takes manual work out of the way. And we expect the judgement that comes with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: a transaction boundary in the wrong place, a migration that works on test data and locks a table in production. In payroll, an amount is either right or wrong. You take the speed and keep the standard. Your first year In your first month, you set up, learn the system and the people, and merge your first changes. Within 100 days, you have delivered the platform’s audit trail, tested and documented, and fixed the first risks you spotted on arrival. By month nine, you are the person the team turns to for the quinn backend, and a developer you mentored is delivering features on their own. By the end of the year, the major backend roadmap items are live (logging, the database upgrade, versioning for our APIs and services), and at least one standard you introduced is used beyond your own team. Who we are looking for You have shipped and run production systems in C# and modern .NET / ASP.NET Core, and you know how they behave under load. You know PostgreSQL properly: schema design, transactions, locking, indexing and query optimisation. You read the execution plan before you add a cache. You have designed APIs and modules with clear boundaries and manageable dependencies. You treat personal and financial data with care. Security is part of how you design, not a review at the end. You use AI tools every day, and you can show where they made you faster and where you caught them being wrong. You own initiatives independently and raise risks before they become surprises. You review constructively, mentor willingly, and write code others can take over. English is your working language. German is a plus. What makes you stand out You have worked where an amount is either right or wrong: payroll, banking, insurance, accounting or tax. You have built foundations others relied on for years: an audit trail, observability, API versioning, a data model. You have taken a major database upgrade or migration through production without drama. You can explain what you built, why you chose your approach, and what changed because of it. The team We are a small, fast and direct team: engineers in Zurich working closely with our Armenia team, and colleagues across Switzerland, Germany and the UK, 40 people in all. Not much process, not much hierarchy. A clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we mean: be open, own it, speak up, keep it simple, bias for action. We are not filling a seat. If you would rather build the core than maintain the plumbing, we would like to hear from you. The facts Location: Zürich Wiedikon, hybrid with three days a week in the office; occasional travel to the UK, Germany and our Armenia team Role: Senior Backend Developer, individual contributor with technical leadership Reporting line: Our Lead Engineers Stack: C#, .NET 10, PostgreSQL; modular monolith Pensum: 100% Start: As soon as possible Language: English; German a plus Process: A 20–30 minute screening call, an in-person interview in Zürich on your career so far, a focused technical interview with the team (where we may work through a real quinn problem together), and reference calls How to apply Apply with your CV and two short paragraphs: why this role, and why now. If you have something you shipped and are proud of, a system, a module or a write-up of a hard problem, include it. It tells us more than a CV does. Sie bringen Ideen zur Weiterentwicklung der Recruitingprozesse und der Arbeitgeberpräsentation ein. title: Business Development Representative, CEE
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE Notion is rebuilding its go-to-market motion around a workflow-first, builder-led model—and the BDR is at the front of it. As a Business Development Rep, you'll be the force that turns the right accounts into the right conversations. You'll partner closely with Solutions Consultants to identify and target companies that are ready to rethink how they work—and your job is to get them in the room. title: Senior Product Manager (Giftcard)
description: Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets. We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers. Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading. About This Role: We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to take ownership of our Gift Cards vertical - one of the fastest-growing parts of our alternative offers, spanning gift card purchase, redemption, provider partnerships, and cross-market growth across France, Germany, and Spain. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. You'll set the strategy for a business line generating triple-digit YoY growth in some markets, own the commercial relationships with our gift card providers, and work directly with our Fulfilment leadership on where the vertical goes next. You'll also work closely with - and may grow into ownership of - adjacent parts of our Alternative Offers and in-store rewards portfolio. We want a strong senior product leader: someone who has built and scaled products at a leading tech company and/or a startup, who thinks and acts like an entrepreneur, and who can move a commercial product forward with minimal hand-holding. Our Benefits: At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect: A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities. A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas. 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge. A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life. Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role. Mental health coaching to support your well-being. Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections. The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company. A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are. *These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location. Responsibilities: In this role, you will: Own the gift card product strategy and roadmap - from provider selection and inventory quality to the end-to-end purchase, redemption, and admin experience. Lead commercial and provider negotiations - framework agreements, commission structures, SLAs, and multi-entity contracting with gift card providers (e.g. Finperks, Tillo), in partnership with Operations, Legal and Finance. Drive revenue growth across markets - set and deliver GMV and commission targets across France, Germany, and Spain, backed by rigorous transaction-level analysis. Partner cross-functionally - work daily with engineering, design, data, CRM, and adjacent product teams to ship a coherent gift card experience across web, app, and browser extension. Own delivery end to end - set the roadmap, own the backlog, and take each bet from discovery to launch with engineering, design and data: frame the problem, write the specs and user stories, prioritise sprint by sprint, make the scope calls, and measure what shipped. This is a hands-on build role, not a coordination role. Use data to lead, not just report - build and refine models (e.g. fraud-tier scoring), validate revenue and performance data with Finance, and identify the next highest-impact bet. Represent the vertical at the leadership level - bring clear recommendations and trade-offs to cross-team and leadership forums, and help shape Alternative Offers' broader strategic direction. Build for scale - help expand gift cards from a standalone catalogue page into a fully integrated offer type across the platform. Your Profile: 5+ years in product management , including significant time owning a product or business line end-to-end at a leading tech company and/or a startup. A strong entrepreneurial track record - you've built something from close to zero, made judgment calls with imperfect data, and taken ownership beyond your formal remit. Commercial fluency - comfortable owning revenue targets, running vendor/partner negotiations, and thinking in margin, commission, and unit economics, not just features. Strong analytical skills - fluent working with transaction and revenue data to make and defend decisions; comfortable partnering with data/finance teams on models like fraud scoring. Proven cross-functional leadership - experience leading engineering, design, and data counterparts in a fast-paced, matrixed environment, without formal authority over them. Hands-on product delivery - you have recently (last 2 to 3 years) taken features from problem to production yourself, working day to day with engineers and designers: running discovery, writing the specs, owning backlog and sprint priorities, and making trade-offs when scope, time or data ran short. You are as comfortable in the detail as at the roadmap level. Excellent stakeholder management - able to influence and present confidently to senior/executive stakeholders. A degree from a top-tier university (e.g. Oxford, Cambridge, LSE, HEC Paris, ESSEC, Sciences Po, Bocconi, ETH Zurich, or equivalent); an MBA or further qualification from a leading program is a plus. Fluent English required Our hiring process : TA Call : Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better. Technical Round : Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case) , and meet your potential manager. Final Round : Meet other Atollians 🏝️ It varies from 1 to 3 interviews *Some processes might slightly change according to needs Ready to apply? Be part of a destination where your work helps millions of people make better decisions every day. One focused application is all we need. If you truly fit more than one role, you're welcome to apply to up to three. This helps us match you with the right opportunity faster. We review every application with equal care and will reach out if your profile aligns. Apply now with your CV in English. *Portfolios, writing samples, or certifications may be requested based on the role. #LI-PM1 At Atolls, we want to ensure that all employees can thrive in an inclusive environment. Our employment opportunities are open to every gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, ability, place of origin, or socioeconomic status. We remain committed to a culture of diversity, equity and belonging, where all employees are welcomed, respected, connected, and engaged. These tools are designed to assist our teams and are never used independently to make hiring decisions. Every assessment and hiring decision is made by our hiring panel and team through human judgment. Before your first interview, you will receive an email with the option to opt out. You can also change your preference at any time during the recruitment process by using the link in that email or by contacting your Talent Acquisition Partner. title: Sales Engineering Manager Core - Mainland Europe
description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: Samsara is seeking an experienced and results-driven Sales Engineering Manager to focus on our Enterprise Core business in Mainland Europe (DACH & France). You should have experience managing and ideally growing a dispersed sales engineering team in a high-performance environment. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact. You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value trust and human relationships built over time. You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and inspired to go farther than you have before. You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team. In this role, you will: Manage individual and team performance ensuring our partnership with sales, product, support, and customer success teams are productive and efficient Work with Account Executives and Regional Sales Directors on account planning, strategy, and sales call activity Manage escalations (product issues, feature requests, etc.) in a pre-sales environment Participate in customer/prospect calls as a trusted advisor Partner with other Sales Engineering leaders to improve the overall Sales Engineering organization at Samsara Minimum requirements for the role: B.S. degree in Computer Science or similar 5+ years of sales engineering management experience Experience with Software Product sales: Infrastructure, SaaS Knowledge in one or more of these areas of expertise: IoT, Networking / Security, SaaS, Cloud Technologies, or Physical Security Strong technical and business acumen Excellent communication, customer service, and interpersonal skills Ability to partner with a broad coalition of stakeholders, ranging from sales, product, marketing, support, and customer success, and from individual contributors to executive team members across the organization Demonstrated leadership, creativity, and problem-solving abilities Excellent presentation and organizational skills Ability to work in a fast-paced dynamic environment Ability to travel as needed Location: Remote, Germany or Remote, France Language requirement: Fluent German or Fluent French Total Rewards At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. Flexible Working At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. title: (Senior) Marketplace Manager (m/w/d)
description: Deine Aufgaben Als (Senior) Marketplace Manager verantwortest du unsere Präsenz auf den führenden Fashion- und Sport-Marktplätzen Europas, strategisch wie operativ. Du bist die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Marke und Plattform. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit E-Commerce, Operations, Marketing, Finance und externen Partnern zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass sich unser Community-Spirit auf jedem Marktplatz genauso anfühlt wie in unserem eigenen Shop. Du verantwortest die Umsatz- und Ergebnisziele deiner Kanäle (GMV, NMV, Deckungsbeitrag) und steuerst sie über klare KPIs wie Conversion, Retourenquote und Sichtbarkeit. Du bewertest Marktpotenziale, erstellst Business Cases für neue Plattformen und leitest daraus Empfehlungen für das Management ab. Du legst fest, welche Essentials wir dauerhaft listen und welche Drops exklusiv bleiben, und entwickelst Launchkonzepte je Marktplatz. Account- und Plattformsteuerung Du führst unsere Partnerschaften mit den führenden Fashion- und Sport-Marktplätzen eigenverantwortlich. Dazu gehören Jahresgespräche, Konditions- und Promotion-Verhandlungen und das Platzieren von Aktionen und Kampagnen. Du verantwortest die CXM- und SLA-Kennzahlen (On-Time, Return Time, Valid Tracking), erkennst Risiken frühzeitig und setzt Maßnahmen konsequent um. Du steuerst Feed- und Attributmanagement über unsere Middleware (Tradebyte, ChannelEngine o. ä.) und treibst die Weiterentwicklung der Schnittstellen und Prozesse voran. Content, Visibility & Brand Experience Du bist Marken-Wächter auf allen Plattformen und sorgst für einen einheitlichen Auftritt in Bildsprache, Texten, Pricing und Promotions. Du planst Kampagnen, Launches und Retail-Media-Maßnahmen gemeinsam mit Marketing und steuerst die Budgets für Retail Media. Du optimierst Produktdaten, Content-Qualität und Conversion und stellst sicher, dass unsere Produkte sauber und performant ausgespielt werden. Operations & Data Du verantwortest Forecasting, Bestandsplanung und Replenishment für die Marktplätze in enger Abstimmung mit Operations. Du steuerst die Abläufe rund um Versand und Retouren, z. B. über Fulfillment- und Retourenprogramme der Plattformen oder eigene Carrier-Setups, und optimierst sie hinsichtlich Kosten und SLA-Erfüllung. Du baust das Marketplace-Reporting auf und aus und übersetzt Zahlen in klare Entscheidungen für Management und Finance. Partner & Dienstleister Du steuerst externe Partner und Dienstleister wie Agenturen und Middleware-Anbieter. Dein Profil Deine Stärken die wir in unserem Team brauchen: Abgeschlossenes Studium in Betriebswirtschaft, E-Commerce, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation Mindestens 3–5 Jahre Erfahrung im E-Commerce- oder Marketplace-Management, idealerweise im Fashion- oder Sportswear-Umfeld; für die Senior-Rolle nachweisliche Verantwortung für einen Marktplatz-Kanal inklusive Umsatzzielen Fundiertes Know-how in Marktplatzprozessen, Fulfillment-Setups und Provisionsstrukturen; Erfahrung mit großen Fashion- und Sport-Marktplätzen ist ein großes Plus Sicherer Umgang mit Tradebyte, ChannelEngine o. ä., Looker Studio und Excel/Sheets Ausgeprägte analytische Stärke, unternehmerisches Denken und ein gutes Gespür für die Balance aus Performance und Brand-Ästhetik Hands-on-Mentalität: Du arbeitest gern selbst im Tagesgeschäft mit, statt nur zu delegieren, und setzt Dinge schnell und pragmatisch um Verhandlungsstärke und Souveränität im Umgang mit Plattformpartnern und internen Stakeholdern Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse Warum wir? Deine Perspektiven: Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem jungen Team Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege Spannende und vielseitige Aufgaben, die viel Eigeninitiative erfordern Regelmäßige Feedback Gespräche und transparente Kommunikation Zukunftsorientierte Tätigkeit in einem innovativen Unternehmen Unsere Benefits: Zukunftssicherheit mit Extras Profitiere von unserer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge und baue dir entspannt deine finanzielle Absicherung auf – wir unterstützen dich dabei mit einem monatlichen Zuschuss. Familienfreundlichkeit im Fokus Wir entlasten dich bei den Betreuungskosten durch einen monatlichen Zuschuss zur Kinderbetreuung – damit Familie und Beruf gut zusammenpassen. Flexibilität durch digitale Benefits Ob Shopping, Tanken oder Freizeitaktivitäten – du erhältst ein monatliches Guthaben, das du ganz nach deinen Wünschen einsetzen kannst. Alternativ kannst du mit Wellpass deutschlandweit auf über 8.000 Fitness- und Gesundheitsangebote zugreifen – online oder vor Ort – und profitierst dabei von unserem attraktiven Firmenrabatt. Fitness direkt im Haus Kein Zeitverlust – nutze unser hauseigenes Gym , um dich vor, während oder nach der Arbeit fit zu halten. Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte Sichere dir exklusive Vergünstigungen auf unsere Marken – mit satten Rabatten auf Produkte von TEVEO, fayn. und Meek & Hon. Selbstverständlich ist für uns: Wasser, Kaffee und verschiedene Milchsorten in unseren Offices in Hamburg und Ansbach. Monat hast du die Möglichkeit 2 Tage pro Woche im Home Office zu arbeiten. We deliver innovative solutions to<a class="c-link" href="https://customers.twilio.com/" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://customers.twilio.com/" data-sk="tooltip_parent"> hundreds of thousands of businesses </a>and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.</p> <p>Our dedication to <a class="c-link" href="https://www.twilio.com/en-us/blog/open-work" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.twilio.com/en-us/blog/open-work" data-sk="tooltip_parent">remote-first work</a>, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.<br><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">.</span></p> <p><strong>Hiring and how we work</strong></p> <p>We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! </p> <p>Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings. <br><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">.</span></p></div><p><strong>See yourself at Twilio</strong></p> <p>Join us as our next Senior Solutions Engineer on Twilio’s Digital Sales Communications team!</p> <p><strong>About the job</strong></p> <p>This position is needed to enable our customers to build the future of communications. The Senior Solutions Engineer is a critical part of the sales team focused on our Digital Sales segment.</p> <p> </p> <p>Twilio’s Senior Solutions Engineers are responsible for delivering the technical win and best product fit to our customers.They lead the technical pre-sales relationship, drive technical discovery, propose technical architectures, demonstrate the product, anticipate concerns and offer creative solutions. They build customer trust in Twilio’s solutions.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <p> </p> <p>In this role, you’ll:</p> <p> </p> <ul> <li>Partner with Account Executives to execute pre-sales activities including opportunity qualification, demonstrations, Proof-of-Concept, RFP, design documentation, technical presentations and enablement sessions.</li> <li>Help customers achieve success by leading the technical and product sale, recommending best-practice solutions, and guiding them on how to use Twilio’s APIs.</li> <li>Establish yourself as a trusted advisor to our customers, by taking the lead on understanding customer technical pains through discovery in order to design, demonstrate, and present innovative solutions that solve business challenges.</li> <li>Build and present highly interactive, complex and engaging customer product demonstrations to help showcase the capabilities of Twilio’s Communications Products, while effectively forming strong customer relationships with both technical and nontechnical stakeholders. </li> <li>Be Hands-on, high-energy, passionate, and a creative problem solver, equipped with the knowledge of how to get things done and ability to lead others to success.</li> <li>Take the initiative to identify and solve problems - both for the customer and within the organization as we grow. </li> <li>Contribute to the broader Twilio Solutions Engineering community through knowledge sharing, constructing demonstration materials, and creating reusable presentations. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications </strong></p> <p>Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>*Required:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of pre-sales experience selling complex, technical products or 3+ years of professional experience supporting technical products coupled with customer facing experience, particularly in delivery or consulting. </li> <li>Excellent communicator and presenter able to gain audience confidence. </li> <li>An engaging storyteller - you can gain audience confidence and communicate complex topics to multiple levels of audience.</li> <li>Ability to build a deep understanding of a customer’s communications needs and guide them to a technical solution. </li> <li>Previous software development experience or working knowledge in one or more of the following areas:</li> <ul> <li>Backend (Java, C#, Node.js, Python, PHP)</li> <li>Web development (JavaScript, HTML/CSS, frontend frameworks - React, Vue.js, Angular)</li> <li>Experience building with REST APIs</li> </ul> <li>Bachelor’s and/or Master’s degree in a technical discipline (Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science) or equivalent practical experience. </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Desired:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Familiarity with cloud platforms (Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure) and cloud application architecture.</li> <li>Previous experience in Telecom, SIP, Contact Center, or Security is a plus.</li> <li>Experience with sales methodologies. </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Location</strong></p> <p>This role will be remote AND based in the United Kingdom. </p> <p><strong>Travel </strong></p> <p>We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 10% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way. </p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Twilio thinks big. Do you?</strong></p> <p>We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call <a href="https://www.twilio.com/company/values">Twilio Magic</a>. Additionally, we empower employees to build <a href="https://twilio.org/support-and-resources/impact-fund">positive change in their communities</a> by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.</p> <p>So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, <a href="https://www.twilio.com/company/jobs#open-positions">please consider other open positions.</a></p> <p><strong><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">.</span></strong></p> <p><strong>Stay alert to recruitment fraud</strong></p> <p>We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @<a href="http://twilio.com">twilio.com</a> email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.<br><br><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">.</span><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.</strong> We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Permitting and Regulatory Compliance Manager (f/m/d)
description: About Focused Energy Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A, the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry, we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies. Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable, and abundant source of power globally. Your Role You will own Focused Energy's permitting and regulatory pathway across our regulated technical facilities, from early feasibility through construction, commissioning, and handover to Operations. You will build and run the integrated permitting strategy under the direction of the Senior Project Manager / Programme Director, and act as our primary contact with competent German authorities. Your work will ensure regulatory requirements shape design, procurement, and construction decisions, with a particular focus on the Biblis site transition and the evolving German fusion regulatory framework. What You'll Do Develop and maintain the integrated permitting strategy, including authority mapping, submission schedules, permit and conditions registers, and regulatory-risk forecasts. Lead coordinated engagement with municipal, district, Hessian state, and federal authorities, aligning submissions and commitments with the approved project strategy. Own permitting coordination for the Biblis nuclear-site transition, including RWE decommissioning interfaces, existing licences, radiation-protection arrangements, and handover evidence. Coordinate application readiness with Engineering, architects, fire-safety and structural specialists, and the Prüfstatiker, and track reviews to closure. Monitor the German fusion legal framework and translate permit conditions and regulatory changes into project requirements, schedules, and risk responses. Escalate material risks and options to the Senior Project Manager / Programme Director, and hand ongoing permit obligations to Operations. Who You Are Must-Haves Strong experience in German construction and public permitting, including building applications, authority consultations, and partial approvals. Working knowledge of Hessian procedures and the Hessische Bauordnung. Working knowledge of radiation-protection licensing and nuclear-site interfaces. Experience coordinating fire-safety and structural-checking processes with specialists and consultants. Ability to explain regulatory risk and options clearly to non-specialists, including project managers and agency counterparts. Fluent German and English, both written and spoken. Nice-to-Haves Tritium or comparable regulated-facility experience. Experience with multi-agency permitting for novel or regulated technical facilities. Experience building reusable permitting playbooks or standards across projects. Experience working alongside RWE, licence holders, or other site owners on decommissioning or site handover. Familiarity with EU or German energy and nuclear regulatory frameworks. Mentoring capability through example and playbook-building, without formal line management. What We Offer Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery. Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career. Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges. Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company. Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together. Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year. Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily. Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives. Equipment: We offer state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptops. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1. Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace. Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs - whether it’s a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing you choose what fits your lifestyle. Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub. Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. title: Product Designer
description: TL;DR We’re looking for a world-class product designer who’s obsessed with craft & excited about AI. You’ll join +60 builders shipping one of Europe’s biggest consumer AI products, shaping how millions of students learn. Why Knowunity? We're building the #1 AI learning companion for 1 billion students. A future where every student on the planet can access, enjoy & benefit from the highest quality education. Since founding Knowunity straight out of high school in 2020, we've been committed to revolutionising how students learn. Millions of students already use our AI learning companion weekly. We just raised €27m - Europe’s largest education round in the past three years. The AI learning market is at an inflection point, finally enabling true personalisation at scale, and we're determined to build the first AI learning unicorn in this space. You will join an elite team of +60 hands-on builders serving 1 billion students worldwide. If we execute on our product vision, you will have built something generational that transforms education globally. This is your chance to build a generational company that shapes how an entire generation learns. Why now? Design is the single highest-leverage investment at Knowunity right now. You’ll be at the center of that shift. We’ve built a product millions of students love , powered by an engineering team that ships & learns extraordinarily fast. Now we’re going all-in on craft . The kind of UI excellence, motion design, and systematic thinking that turns a loved product into a world-class one. We just brought on a new Head of Design . We’re building a design system from the ground up. And we’re working with Ragged Edge (the agency behind the Transferwise & Granola rebrands) on a major brand evolution . You won’t be maintaining someone else’s vision. You’ll be shaping it from the start. Who you are Your portfolio matters more than your years of experience. Show us work that moved metrics & delighted users: Craft-obsessed: The details are the design. You push back until the bar is raised. AI enthusiast : From prototyping to research to shipping. You see AI tools as a multiplier, not a threat. Systems thinker: You care about scaling quality across a product, not a pretty Figma library. Code-first design systems, AI-powered design reviews, whatever works at speed & scale. Simplifier: Education is messy. AI is unpredictable. You turn complicated user journeys into experiences that feel obvious. Biased to action : You move fast by default. Prototypes over presentations, experiments over endless debate. Builder : You like getting your hands dirty. Bonus if you’ve shipped a side project end to end, or opened a merge request. Team-first : Direct feedback, no preciousness, no territory. Engineers prototyping features? More builders means better outcomes. Curious : New tools, new patterns, new ways of thinking. You stay up to date & experiment continuously because you want to, not because someone told you to. What you'll do Raise the bar on everything students see, touch & feel. Make the Knowunity product undeniably world-class. Set the standard : UIs students want to screenshot & details they feel, but can’t name. Your work is the reference point. Scale it : Curated references, stellar components & sharp reviews. Make it easy even for vibe-coding PMs to hit the standard. Pioneer AI-native design : AI changes how we research, ideate, ship, as well as what we ship. You’ll figure out both, from AI-assisted workflows to AI-native product experiences. Idea to production, fast : Work directly with C-level & engineering. Concept on Monday, shipped on Wednesday, live for a million students on Thursday. What we offer Not for everyone. Everything for the right ones: Impact at scale: Your work reaches millions of students daily. Future generations will know what you build. Elite team, real ownership: +60 exceptional people. Direct access to C-level & founders. You own entire areas from conception to delivery. Compensation & equity: Competitive salary paired with meaningful equity in a company with genuine unicorn potential. Benefits: 28 days annual leave, 40 days work from anywhere, personal development budget, mental health support, Urban Sports Club, monthly retail vouchers, team & company events. Next steps Click “Apply for this job” and submit your CV and LinkedIn profile. We move fast. Intro call : Get to know each other, see if there’s mutual excitement. 5 minute Loom : walk us through something you’re proud of. A feature you shipped, an app you vibe-coded. Your pick. Deep-dive call : Unpack your Loom case with our head of design/CPO, discuss your experience & perspective. On-site day : Meet our CEO, CPO & the team. Work together, get a real feel for the culture. We’ll cover travel. We encourage applications from exceptional talent regardless of traditional background requirements. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of nationality, ethnic origin, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, or marital status. Translating business needs into clear functional requirements and practical technical solutions. Configuring and implementing new features, processes and tools, while developing your knowledge of relevant technologies. You communicate clearly with different stakeholders and can explain complex topics in a practical way. You take ownership of your work and operate with a high degree of autonomy. LANGUAGE SKILLS You have strong verbal and written communication skills in both French & English and are happy working in a multicultural environment IMPORTANT: You must possess an employment status that will allow work from our Paris office. The team regularly connects through optional activities such as team lunches, sports, karaoke, or occasional after-work gatherings. Akur8 works with customers across multiple entities, currencies and billing processes. You will work at the intersection of Finance, Sales Ops and our customers. You will also play an important role in improving the Salesforce to Maxio process, replacing manual checks with automated controls and making contract and billing data more reliable for the Finance team. You will join Akur8’s Finance team and own the process from contract signature to payment collection. Your scope will cover all entities and currencies, including new contracts, renewals, upsells, amendments and terminations. You will register each signed contract in Salesforce, create the corresponding customer and contract in Maxio, issue invoices and follow up on outstanding payments. You will work closely with Sales Ops on contract information and with customers, procurement teams and accounting departments on invoicing and payment follow-up. Accounting activities such as recording cash receipts and revenue recognition are outside the scope of this role. This will include, but not be limited to, the following responsibilities: Reviewing signed contracts and amendments, comparing them with the information recorded in Salesforce and identifying specific cases such as prorated contracts, in-period upsells and terminations. Creating customers and contracts in Maxio, including the identifiers required for electronic invoicing. Issuing invoices and credit notes in Maxio and uploading them to customer portals such as Coupa and Ariba when required. Reviewing automated annual indexation results, handling exceptions such as inflation caps or specific contractual clauses and ensuring updated values are reflected in Salesforce. Contacting customers with overdue invoices and working with their accounting and procurement teams on purchase orders, portals and disputes. Sharing payment delays with Sales Ops, supporting follow-up with the relevant sales teams and helping address the underlying causes. Tracking the monthly accounts receivable ageing report, overdue balances and DSO. Acting as the Finance point of contact for Salesforce data-entry rules, Salesforce to Maxio integration testing and recurring data discrepancies. Identifying repetitive tasks that can be automated with Claude and other team tools, then supporting their implementation through to production. Helping ensure that Maxio reports are reliable for FP&A forecasting, budgeting and financial models. This role is based in our Paris office. EDUCATIONAL / PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE You have 3+ years of experience in sales administration, including billing and collections, ideally in a B2B SaaS company. You have worked with contracts involving renewals, upsells, amendments and multiple currencies or entities. You have experience with a CRM to billing system integration. You understand the basic principles of revenue recognition. You have knowledge of electronic invoicing requirements in France. TECHNICAL SKILLS You use Salesforce and a billing platform on a daily basis. Experience with Maxio, Zuora, Chargebee or an equivalent tool is preferred. You are comfortable working with contract, billing and payment data. You understand how system integrations work and can identify inconsistencies between tools. description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. That's where this role comes in. As Senior Specialist, Global Market Planning, you'll help refine the models and tools at the heart of how we plan courier supply globally. You'll make sure the right supply levers are pulled in the right markets, and you'll help us learn which levers actually work. It's a role at the crossroads of data, tooling, and operations. It's for someone who is as comfortable designing a test or building a model as they are working out why a specific market is off plan and what to do about it. You'll be part of the Global Market Planning team and will partner closely with local operations and courier marketing so that our planning always reflects the reality on the ground. What you'll be doing Develop the global planning model: Help develop and refine our global supply planning model so it delivers robust coverage across both large and small cities, accounting for local context like holidays, special events, etc. Allocate investments across markets: Help optimize supply lever allocation, translating region and country budgets into the right mix of levers for each market. Test and learn in markets: Propose tests and actions within markets, in line with lever allocation, especially where we don't yet know the right answer or don't have enough data to rely on history. You'll work with local teams and analytics to shape the approach and turn what we learn into the next plan. Build the tooling: Develop tools that ensure the correct supply levers are being used effectively across markets to hit our targets. Deep dive & solve: Investigate problem areas, identify root causes, and turn your findings into corrective actions and better planning approaches. Collaborate: Partner with regional supply leads, local operations teams, and central teams (finance, procurement, product, analytics) on plans, performance, and improvements. Improve how we work: Test and prove new concepts in planning, acquisition, onboarding, and activation, and support the roll-out of global improvements across regions. Our humble expectations 3+ years of experience in consulting, operations, analytics, or strategic business development in a fast-paced environment. Strong analytical and modelling skills, with a structured, pragmatic approach to solving complex problems. Experience designing and interpreting tests or causal analyses, and good judgment about what you can and can't conclude from them in a marketplace setting. Comfort making and defending recommendations with incomplete data, and adapting your thinking when the facts change. Proficiency in SQL, Looker, and Excel/Google Sheets modelling. Python, Cursor, and Claude Code are a plus. An attitude for action and ownership beyond the obvious, always looking for opportunities to improve, with the determination to drive change. The ability to work across cross-functional teams and manage relationships with stakeholders, both local and global. A true culture champion who leads by example with collaboration, teamwork, and data-driven decision making, and who brings humility and respect to every interaction. title: Tech Lead (m/f/d)
description: At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. The phone call, the contact form, the support ticket: all of it is being replaced by messaging and AI. We're building the platform that runs underneath. Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide , from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day . We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams. We're 100 people , profitable , and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin. We are hiring a backend-leaning Tech Lead to lead a team of 3-4 engineers and own the tech for a part of Superchat’s product. This is a hands-on leadership role: You’ll spend roughly half your time designing and building software and the other half enabling your team to perform at its best. Work directly on architecture, development and important projects while creating the clarity, feedback and environment your engineers need to deliver an excellent product Who We Want A strong, current backend engineer. You bring 3+ years of experience as a Senior or Staff Engineer and remain deeply involved in software development. You are comfortable owning, designing and building crucial parts of production systems. Experienced with the JVM ecosystem. You have substantial experience with Java or another JVM language. Kotlin and AWS experience are a plus, since our backend runs on Kotlin/Quarkus. Ready to lead people. You may already have worked in a hybrid Tech Lead role, have been an Engineering manager for a short time or be taking your first steps in people leadership after successfully owning projects and architecture. What matters is that you genuiely want to help people grow Strong at delivery. You know how to turn product goals into reality. You are used to work in fast-paced startups and are a driver to increase velocity. Product-minded. You care about solving the customers problem. You engage with product decisions, challenge assumptions constructivly and find pragmatic solutions to build things in a lean way. Clear communicator. You are able to explain complex technical things in details to Engineers and in an understandable way to non-technical stakeholders. You create alignment and motivate people Excited about AI-assisted development. You are already using AI in your development workflow and are eager to explore how it can improve engineering speed, quality and the way teams work. Who We Don’t Want Pure people manager. You no longer want to work directly on software. This role requires meaningful, ongoing involvement in architecture, implementation, code review, and technical problem-solving. Hero engineer. You want to make every important technical decision yourself or become the bottleneck for the team. Your job is to raise the effectiveness of the whole team, not to be the only person who can solve difficult problems. Pure delivery manager. You treat engineering as a ticketing operation focused only on timelines and task tracking instead of product quality, technical health, and team growth. We need engineering leaders, not project coordinators. Remote-only operator. You prefer fully remote work and don’t want to actively build relationships and culture in person with the team. We believe strong engineering leadership requires regular in-person collaboration and presence in Berlin. Your Day To Day Spend approximately 50% of your time contributing directly to architecture, development, code reviews, and important technical projects. Lead a team of 3-4 engineers and take responsibility for its effectiveness, technical quality, and delivery. Work closely with your Product Manager to understand customer problems, shape solutions, scope projects, and set priorities. Establish clear technical direction while enabling engineers to own decisions and develop their judgment. Run regular 1:1s, give actionable feedback, and support each engineer’s development and performance. Remove blockers, manage dependencies, and help the team identify delivery risks early. Improve engineering practices and explore effective uses of AI throughout the software-development lifecycle. Contribute to hiring through technical interviews, structured feedback, and candidate conversations. Stakeholders Director of Engineering: Your manager and partner on people development, calibration, processes. Direct Reports: Engineers in your team; you own their development, performance and growth Product Manager: PMs own what and why; you own how (delivery) and who (people) CTO and CPO: We are a lean organization with a flat hierarchy. You will regulary disccuss the direction of architecture with the CTO and product with the CPO Why People Choose Us Mission that matters. Real impact on small businesses, not abstract metrics Funded with conviction. $18M raised and profitable Modern stack. Kotlin/Quarkus, AWS, TypeScript/React/Next.js, and LangGraph for AI-powered features Squad-based organization. Each squad owns its domain end-to-end with real ownership and autonomy Two clear career tracks. We support both individual contributor growth (up to Staff level) and Management Paths with explicit reversibility between both and Tech Lead being the first level of management that is still quite hands-on Product-led structure. PMs report directly to the CPO, keeping product strategy focused, consistent, and clearly prioritized Hybrid by design. Our Berlin office in Prenzlauer Berg is the center of gravity, with two work-from-home days as the standard setup Direct feedback culture. Honest, direct, and kind feedback is part of how we work together - in 1:1s, retrospectives, and everyday collaboration Benefits & Culture Choose between an Urban Sports Club/John Reed membership or a public transport/Dance subscription Regular company and team events Annual personal development budget of €500 for conferences, courses, books, career coaching, and more An inclusive and exciting startup culture that enables fast professional and personal growth Beautiful office in the heart of Berlin (Prenzlauer Allee 242) with free snacks, drinks, and top-notch equipment We want to build a community, not just a company. It’s important to us to create an environment where people genuinely enjoy spending time together - whether that’s through HYROX training, golfing, beer pong tournaments, running clubs, Warhammer, weekend activities, or whatever kind of community you’d like to help build here! We're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the description. title: Senior Documentation Specialist
description: About this position As the Senior Documentation Specialist, you ensure the effective management, quality, completeness, and inspection readiness of essential clinical trial documentation for assigned studies, programmes or documentation activities, including the sponsor TMF and oversight of CRO and laboratory TMFs. You acts as an experienced TMF specialist, working closely with Clinical Operations and cross-functional study teams to provide expert guidance on document processes, compliance, risk management and continuous improvement. Your tasks: Oversee documentation handling, filing and archival activities for assigned studies, programmes or documentation activities across relevant functional areas, ensuring that final documents are complete, accurate, traceable and maintained in the company document management system. Perform complex quality-control reviews and provide technical oversight of QC activities completed by TMF colleagues and external partners, in accordance with applicable SOPs, the CDISC TMF Reference Model, study-specific TMF Plans and regulatory requirements. Plan and conduct risk-based periodic oversight reviews of CRO and laboratory TMFs; identify quality or completeness issues, recommend remediation actions, monitor progress and escalate significant or recurring risks. Lead TMF inspection-readiness activities for assigned studies and coordinate documentation support during audits and regulatory inspections; develop and coordinate documentation-related corrective and preventive actions, monitor implementation and verify effective closure. Act as a TMF subject matter expert for study teams and external partners, providing practical guidance and escalating matters that require management direction or cross-functional decisions. Analyse and communicate TMF quality and performance metrics, identify trends and recommend improvements to processes, systems, templates and ways of working. Ensure assigned activities comply with company and CRO SOPs, ICH GCP, applicable regulations and relevant regulatory guidance. Represent Clinical Documentation in study meetings, provide input on TMF status and quality, and follow up on agreed documentation actions, decisions and risks. Prepare and deliver TMF guidance and training, and share expertise with study-team members and other TMF colleagues on compliant documentation practices. Role requirements Bachelor’s degree in a scientific, health-related or other relevant discipline. Minimum seven years of experience in TMF and documentation management within the pharmaceutical or CRO industry, including at least three years of experience in biotechnology or another fast-growing, dynamic environment. Advanced knowledge of eTMF solutions, such as Veeva Vault Clinical, PhlexTMF or comparable platforms, together with strong working knowledge of ICH GCP, applicable regulations and the CDISC TMF Reference Model. Demonstrated experience in TMF quality control, risk-based TMF reviews and CRO or vendor oversight. Demonstrated experience leading TMF inspection-readiness activities and managing documentation-related findings and corrective and preventive actions. Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to provide clear guidance, influence without direct authority and build effective working relationships across functions. Proactive and accountable approach, with sound judgement, analytical problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and implement pragmatic, GCP-compliant solutions. Excellent attention to detail, organisation and time management, with the ability to prioritise and manage multiple activities in a dynamic environment. Professional proficiency in written and spoken English. Work permit Candidate needs to hold a Swiss work permit or be an EU citizen eligible to work in Switzerland Your path forward If you meet most of these requirements and bring a strong dedication to technical documentation, we encourage you to apply. You will contribute directly to our mission of advancing new medicines for patients. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

description: <p><strong>Associate Director / Director, Data Strategy & Measurement</strong></p> <p><em>Location: Remote</em> — this is a remote, work-from-home role, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners. Some travel is required for client meetings, internal meetings, conferences, and industry events.</p> <p><strong>The Role </strong></p> <p>The Associate Director / Director, Data Strategy & Measurement is responsible for defining and leading Acceleration Partners' data, analytics and measurement capability. This role sits at the intersection of client strategy, data science, measurement, AI-enabled insights and commercial growth. The Director will work directly with enterprise clients to understand their marketing and business data ecosystem, develop measurement strategies, and help clients make better decisions through data. Internally, the role will partner with Client Services, Strategy, Sales and AI Automation teams to build AP's data capability, improve decision-making, develop new services and products, and raise data literacy across the organization. As a senior leader, the Director will also develop AP's market position as a leading authority on affiliate, influencer and partnership measurement.</p> <p><strong>Top Responsibilities:</strong></p> <p><strong>Client Measurement & Data Strategy</strong></p> <p>• Serve as AP's senior advisor on measurement, analytics and reporting.</p> <p>• Understand client data ecosystems including affiliate networks, influencer platforms, Google Analytics, CRM systems, customer databases, MMM outputs and business intelligence tools.</p> <p>• Design measurement frameworks that connect partnership marketing activity to broader business outcomes, spanning attribution, incrementality, customer acquisition and lifetime value.</p> <p>• Advise clients on how affiliate and influencer activity should be measured alongside paid media, brand marketing and broader customer acquisition strategies.</p> <p>• Own AP's point of view on measurement, partnering with MMM providers, analytics platforms and measurement vendors to keep AP at the forefront of measurement innovation.</p> <p><strong>Strategic Consulting & Problem Solving</strong></p> <p>• Lead analytical workstreams for enterprise clients, including programme audits and strategic reviews.</p> <p>• Support growth strategies, forecasting, partner valuation models and opportunity assessments.</p> <p>• Translate complex datasets into actionable commercial recommendations.</p> <p>• Partner with senior client stakeholders across Marketing, Analytics, Finance and Data Science teams.</p> <p><strong>Data Products & Capability Development • Define and own AP's data and analytics roadmap.</strong></p> <p>• Partner with Strategy and AI teams to identify opportunities for automation and AI-enabled insights.</p> <p>• Lead development of scalable reporting frameworks, dashboards, benchmarking products and measurement tools. • Drive innovation across APVision and future analytical capabilities.</p> <p><strong>Data Enablement & Industry Thought Leadership</strong></p> <p>• Increase data literacy across Account Management, Strategy and Sales teams through training programmes, workshops and playbooks.</p> <p>• Coach teams to ask better questions, interpret data effectively and communicate insights to clients.</p> <p>• Represent AP externally as a thought leader on measurement and analytics, speaking at conferences, webinars and client forums.</p> <p>• Produce thought leadership on attribution, incrementality, MMM, AI and partnership measurement, and build relationships with key industry vendors and platforms.</p> <p><strong>What Success Looks Like:</strong></p> <p><strong>By 6 Months</strong></p> <p>The Director has built strong relationships with key enterprise client stakeholders and is actively advising on measurement strategy and programme audits. They have an established working relationship with their Data Strategist and a clear view of AP's data and analytics roadmap. Early training and enablement sessions have begun to raise data literacy across Account Management and Strategy teams.</p> <p><strong>By 1 Year</strong></p> <p>The Director is recognized internally and externally as AP's leading voice on measurement and analytics. Clients are adopting AP's measurement recommendations, and client satisfaction and retention have improved. The Director has contributed to new business wins, launched at least one new analytical product or framework, and represented AP at industry events. Data literacy and standardized analytical frameworks are visible across the organization, and the Data Strategist is developing well under their mentorship.</p> <p><strong>Qualities of the Ideal Candidate:</strong></p> <p>• Strategic thinker, comfortable operating with ambiguity</p> <p>• Strong communicator and storyteller, able to simplify complex concepts for non-technical audiences</p> <p>• Commercially minded</p> <p>• Collaborative and influential across teams and seniority levels</p> <p>• Naturally curious and innovative</p> <p>• Confident representing AP as an external thought leader</p> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications & Skills:</strong></p> <p>• 8–12+ years of experience in analytics, measurement, marketing science, consulting or data strategy</p> <p>• Experience working with enterprise clients and advising senior stakeholders and executive teams</p> <p>• Strong understanding of affiliate, influencer, digital marketing or performance marketing</p> <p>• Experience leading teams and developing talent</p> <p>• Strong understanding of Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM), attribution methodologies and incrementality testing</p> <p>• Proficiency with Google Analytics, Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) and Business Intelligence/dashboarding tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker or similar)</p> <p>• Familiarity with data warehousing concepts and AI-enabled analytics</p> <p>• SQL and data querying experience preferred</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>WHY ACCELERATION PARTNERS?</strong></p> <p>Acceleration Partners is the world’s largest and first-to-market Partnership Marketing Agency creating and nurturing partnerships that drive exceptional measurable outcomes for their clients. Managing clients in 40+ countries, their global team of 300+ focuses on data-driven strategies that help connect brands to the right consumers through performance partnerships, traditional affiliate, influencer, performance PR, content, and B2B partnership marketing.</p> <p><strong>AP PERKS & BENEFITS – WHAT WE OFFER</strong></p> <ul> <li>100% remote work for everyone </li> <li>Group medical, dental, and vision coverage insurance (with opt-out benefits) </li> <li>401K with matching </li> <li>Open Paid Time Off </li> <li>Summer & Holiday Wellness Breaks in July and December </li> <li>Volunteer and Birthday Time Off </li> <li>Focus Fridays </li> <li>Paid Parental Leave Benefits </li> <li>Wellness, Technology & Education Allowances </li> <li>Paid sabbatical leaves, donation matching, and more!! </li> <li>Target base salary is £65K - £85K depending on location and experience.</li> </ul> <p>Benefits may vary based on employment status or country location.</p> <p> </p> <p><em>Acceleration Partners is committed to a diverse workforce and we are an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants regardless of an individual's age, race, color, gender, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status.</em></p> <p>  </p> <p>#LI-REMOTE  </p> <p><em>*GLSDR</em> </p> <p>#LI-MG1 </p> <p> </p> <p> </p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
