You'll report to the Data Analyst Manager helping establish our data practice, including documented pipelines, governed metric definitions, and an established way for other departments to ask for data without it becoming ad hoc, bespoke work every time. In addition, CoreView is improving how we understand product telemetry, platform product usage, licence utilisation and adoption trends.  You will work across business functions and take ownership of CoreView's customer usage and adoption analytics and turn them into a production-grade, reliable system, then help scope and build the next set of metrics and signals on top of them. You'll work primarily in Databricks (Unity Catalog, Spark Declarative Pipelines), using SQL and Python day to day, and you'll be expected to use AI-assisted development (Cursor, Claude, or equivalent) as a normal part of how you work.</p> <p><strong>Job Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Take operational ownership of the usage and adoption pipelines and their alerting</li> <li>Reconcile figures derived from our product-usage tool</li> <li>Separate development and production environments and mature CI/CD so deployment is repeatable and rollback is reliable.</li> <li>Build and maintain Bronze-to-Gold pipelines in Databricks, Unity Catalog metric views, and the permissions/row-level-security model behind them.</li> <li>Extend automated data quality checks across the underlying gold-layer tables and validate outputs against existing Power BI reports.</li> <li>Co-own the scoping of the next set of usage and adoption signals with Product and Post-Sales: prioritising upsell signals and the ROI narrative and confirming what needs new instrumentation.</li> <li>Handle the realities of business system data: schema drift, inconsistent field naming, soft deletes, incremental loads </li> <li>Lead and be responsible for the consolidation of additional data sources — including support tickets, audit logs, CRM, and other customer-facing systems — while defining the feasibility, effort, cost, and implementation approach required to support a future unified data platform.</li> <li>Establish documented pipelines, an access model for raw and transformed data, and a working intake process for cross-department data requests.</li> <li>Act as a credible point of contact for CoreView's Databricks estate</li> <li>Bring automation and AI-assisted tooling into the day-to-day work — for example automated monitoring and anomaly detection on metric movements — as the platform matures.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Job Requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>3 to 5 years' professional experience building and operating production data pipelines (ETL/ELT) in a commercial setting.</li> <li>Hands-on Databricks proficiency: Unity Catalog, Spark Declarative Pipelines and metric views, including the permissions / row-level-security model behind them.</li> <li>Strong SQL and Python applied to data engineering work — building, testing and supporting pipeline code through to production.</li> <li>Experience with data transformation/orchestration tooling such as Spark Declarative Pipelines, dbt, or an equivalent.</li> <li>Solid grounding in data modelling (dimensional/star-schema approaches) for analytics consumption.</li> <li>Git-based version control and CI/CD practices applied to data pipelines, not just application code.</li> <li>Experience ingesting data from a range of source systems — CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot), product usage and telemetry (CoreView's own platform, UserPilot, or equivalents such as Pendo, Amplitude or Mixpanel), and other business systems.</li> <li>Comfortable operating with limited hand-holding: implementing, documenting and running to an agreed direction rather than waiting for detailed instruction.</li> BI tool, including validating a migrated report against a legacy one.</li> <li>Prior experience implementing data governance, a metric catalogue, or an access model from a low base of maturity.</li> <li>Background in B2B SaaS.</li> <li>Experience using AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude) as part of a production engineering workflow.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> title: Stage of Afstuderen: Optimalisatie van Machine-inspecties
description: Wat ga je doen? Binnen Customer Service voert Voortman periodieke machine-inspecties uit om de technische staat van machines te beoordelen en klanten te adviseren over onderhoud, reparaties en mogelijke verbeteringen. Deze inspecties vormen een belangrijke basis voor het verhogen van de betrouwbaarheid, prestaties en levensduur van machines. Het huidige inspectieproces is door de jaren heen organisch gegroeid. Hierdoor worden inspectievragen niet altijd op dezelfde manier geïnterpreteerd, verschillen beoordelingen tussen monteurs en worden bevindingen niet overal uniform vastgelegd. Ook de rapportage richting klanten kan op onderdelen duidelijker, consistenter en meer actiegericht worden ingericht. Tijdens deze opdracht analyseer je het volledige machine-inspectieproces en ontwikkel je een vernieuwde werkwijze die aansluit bij de huidige en toekomstige behoeften van onze serviceorganisatie. Daarbij kijk je niet alleen naar de inhoud van inspectievragen, maar ook naar de manier waarop inspecteurs informatie verzamelen, beoordelingen uitvoeren, bevindingen vastleggen en resultaten communiceren naar klanten. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Het analyseren van het huidige machine-inspectieproces en het identificeren van verbeterpunten; Het ontwikkelen van een logische en uniforme structuur voor machine-inspecties; Het herformuleren en standaardiseren van bestaande inspectievragen; Het opstellen van duidelijke beoordelingscriteria voor de technische staat van machineonderdelen; Het ontwikkelen van een uniforme methode voor het vastleggen van metingen, bevindingen, foto's en aanbevolen acties; Het verbeteren van inspectierapportages zodat technische bevindingen overzichtelijk, eenduidig en actiegericht worden gepresenteerd; Het opstellen van een implementatievoorstel voor het vernieuwde inspectieproces binnen Customer Service. title: Working Student Graphic / 3D Design (m/f/d)
description: THIS IS THE JOB At everdrop we are creating innovative, plastic-free household and personal care essentials, that prove that sustainability, performance, and outstanding aesthetics go hand in hand. Our design team shapes every single touchpoint of the brand - from retail packaging on the shelves to digital campaigns. As a Working Student in our Design Team, you will be deeply integrated into our creative process. You’ll help bring visual concepts to life and ensure flawless execution across print and digital platforms. As Working Student Graphic / 3D Design (m/f/d) these will be your tasks: Support the development and execution of visual assets for all brand channels, from initial concepts to final artwork. Assist in creating 3D renderings, product mockups, and visualizations for presentations and marketing purposes. Help prepare print-ready artwork and ensure technical accuracy throughout the prepress process DAS BIST DU If you are passionately committed to sustainability and highly motivated to make the world a little cleaner with us, then we think you are really great! If you also like to work proactively and in a team, and you see every small and large challenge as an opportunity to get even better – then we are already a little bit smitten. Finally, if you also have the following skills and experience, we are almost certain: This could be the start of a great love story! Currently enrolled in Graphic Design, Communication Design, Marketing, or a related field, with initial practical experience in graphic design, pre-press/print design, and 3D rendering. Fluent in German or very good English skills (C1 Level), based in the Munich area with the ability to work on-site at least once a week, and available for 16–20 hours/week (full-time optional between semesters). You are confident in Adobe Creative Cloud (especially Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign), have an eye for typography, composition, colors, and materials, and a solid understanding of packaging design and print-ready prepress files. Experience with 3D rendering and visualization software (e.g., Blender) is a strong plus. An organized, structured natural communicator with excellent written and verbal skills who stays calm and keeps the overview during stressful phases. Ideally you bring an understanding of German culture, lifestyle, and e-commerce. THIS IS EVERDROP Our Mission 💚🌱🌎 We want to change the world – together with you! everdrop's everyday products help people easily reduce their ecological footprint in the household. We started with our cleaning tabs in 2020. Since then, our household and personal care products have already saved more than 20 million single-use plastic bottles and thousands of tons of unnecessary CO2 emissions and chemical raw materials. By the way, we have been a certified B Corp since 2023. And with your help, we want to take everdrop to the next level. Join our mission – and help us make a sustainable lifestyle so easy that it becomes the new standard in our society. Our Benefits 🍲💪🏡 varied, meaningful, and purpose-driven work great team spirit and regular team events a beautiful, bright, spacious office near the Isar an outdoor fitness facility next to the office (can be used anytime) a monthly voucher for everdrop products in our employee shop Family and Friends discount codes for everdrop and other Startups for Tomorrow companies Membership with FutureBens & Corporate Benefits flexible working hours an additional 2 days paid vacation per year for your own environmental or charitable projects ("Green & Social Impact Days") your own MacBook, as long as you work at everdrop Our values 💛🏳️‍🌈🤝‍ At everdrop, we want to live a culture of inclusion, diversity, and equal opportunities. The commitment to making the world a little better is part of our daily actions. Above all, we want to promote awareness for our planet and for other people. One example of how we want to create awareness in the workplace: Menstruating colleagues who suffer from pain can easily take one or more "Power Days", which are additional paid days off. And this without questions, without justification. Another example: Our "Green & Social Impact Days" are two additional paid days off per year that you can dedicate to your own projects for the environment or for your community. We also try to be as mindful as possible in our hiring process. We treat every person equally, regardless of origin, gender, religion, age, appearance, language, culture, nationality, marital status, sexual orientation, or physical disability. We are certainly not perfect – but we want to get better every day and learn something new with every step. That's what every journey is all about. Are you coming along? title: Stage Spécialiste Environnement - Lyon
description: Qui sommes-nous ? Q ENERGY France est un acteur majeur du marché des énergies renouvelables en France. Autrefois affilié au groupe RES, l’entreprise œuvre depuis 27 ans dans le développement, la construction et l’exploitation de projets éoliens et photovoltaïques. Aujourd'hui également positionnée sur le marché du stockage d'énergie, Q ENERGY poursuit son expansion vers de nouveaux domaines afin de proposer des solutions intelligentes et complètes pour la production et la fourniture d’énergie durable en France. L'entreprise compte près de 300 collaborateur.rice.s et 6 agences sur le territoire ainsi qu'un siège social basé à Avignon. Q ENERGY France est une entreprise de la holding européenne Q ENERGY Solutions, créée en 2021 par Hanwha Solutions dans l'objectif de conduire à la prochaine génération de production d'énergie verte et flexible en Europe. Basée à Berlin, Q ENERGY Solutions est une société sœur de Q CELLS, fabricant de modules photovoltaïques reconnu à travers le monde. Les deux sociétés constituent la division Energie du groupe Hanwha Solutions, basé à Séoul. Vos missions : Rattaché.e au service développement éolien et sous la supervision de la Chargée d’Etudes Environnement, vous contribuerez à la bonne prise en compte des enjeux environnementaux tout au long des phases prospection, développement et construction des projets éolien terrestre. En particulier les sujets suivants seront travaillés : Élaborer des notes d’analyse et des argumentaires techniques pour les volets environnementaux et paysagers. Participer aux actions de concertation et de communication autour des projets (élus, services de l’État, société civile, habitants...). Garantir la prise en compte des enjeux environnementaux et le respect des réglementations applicables tout au long du développement des projets. Référencement et chiffrage des mesures ERCAS spécifiques à chaque projet. Définir et sécuriser des mesures de compensation et d’accompagnement dans le cadre de la séquence ERC des projets : exemple îlot de senescence Participer et suivre la mise en œuvre des mesures environnementales en phase de construction et durant les procédures de financement. description: Qui sommes-nous ? Q ENERGY France est un acteur majeur du marché des énergies renouvelables en France. Autrefois affilié au groupe RES, l’entreprise œuvre depuis 27 ans dans le développement, la construction et l’exploitation de projets éoliens et photovoltaïques. Aujourd'hui également positionnée sur le marché du stockage d'énergie, Q ENERGY poursuit son expansion vers de nouveaux domaines afin de proposer des solutions intelligentes et complètes pour la production et la fourniture d’énergie durable en France. L'entreprise compte près de 300 collaborateur.rice.s et 6 agences sur le territoire ainsi qu'un siège social basé à Avignon. Q ENERGY France est une entreprise de la holding européenne Q ENERGY Solutions, créée en 2021 par Hanwha Solutions dans l'objectif de conduire à la prochaine génération de production d'énergie verte et flexible en Europe. Basée à Berlin, Q ENERGY Solutions est une société sœur de Q CELLS, fabricant de modules photovoltaïques reconnu à travers le monde. Les deux sociétés constituent la division Energie du groupe Hanwha Solutions, basé à Séoul. title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer, Environment Automation
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p>As a Staff Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) at GitLab, you’ll help keep all user-facing services and production systems reliable, scalable, and efficient. Our SREs combine a pragmatic operations mindset with strong software engineering practices to drive automation, reduce toil, and improve resilience across our platform.</p> <p>In the Environment Automation specialization, your focus is on operating and automating hundreds of GitLab environments—from initial provisioning to day-to-day maintenance tasks. </p> <p>Unlike other SRE roles, this position centers on automating the lifecycle of many tenant environments, ensuring they remain secure, consistent, and reliable at scale.</p> <p>Some examples of the projects you could work on:</p> <ul> <li>Designing infrastructure automation that provisions and operates GitLab environments using Terraform, Ansible, and Kubernetes</li> <li>Creating and maintaining deployment packages for GitLab, such as Helm Charts and omnibus-gitlab</li> <li>Building and operating Dedicated GitLab instances integrated with cloud-native services (e.g., GCP, AWS)</li> <li>Developing tools to orchestrate infrastructure-as-code workflows across multiple tenants</li> <li>Deploying and managing microservices on Kubernetes clusters at scale</li> <li>Enhancing GitLab’s observability stack (e.g., Prometheus, ELK) to support proactive monitoring and incident response</li> <li>Integrating with and operating infrastructure in cloud provider ecosystems (e.g., IAM, networking, storage)</li> <li>Championing and implementing cloud security best practices across automated infrastructure</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Build & Scale Multi-Tenant Infrastructure:</strong> Design and implement automation that provisions and manages hundreds of isolated GitLab environments using Terraform, Ansible, and Kubernetes. Manage complex state strategies and workspace configurations to support scale and maintainability.</li> <li><strong>Debug & Resolve Production Issues: </strong>Troubleshoot issues across Kubernetes clusters, cloud services, and GitLab apps—identifying root causes of failed deployments, crash loops, and scheduling conflicts to ensure service continuity.</li> <li><strong>Automate Operations at Scale: </strong>Replace manual workflows with infrastructure-as-code solutions, including automated version upgrades, configuration rollouts, and provisioning pipelines that operate reliably across all tenants.</li> <li><strong>Monitor & Predict Capacity: </strong>Build observability systems that detect bottlenecks, predict usage trends, and optimize resource consumption using tools like Prometheus, ELK, and Grafana.</li> <li><strong>Respond & Lead During Incidents: </strong>Lead incident response and postmortem efforts, applying technical depth to resolve issues and establish operational standards that reduce future risk.</li> <li><strong>Architect & Collaborate: </strong>Influence architectural decisions around automation, scalability, and operational excellence. Partner with engineering teams to improve automation, platform resilience, and production-readiness.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Production-Scale Experience: </strong>Proven ability to operate and troubleshoot production workloads across multiple tenants or environments. Deep understanding of how distributed systems fail at scale and how to build in resilience.<br><strong>Terraform & IaC Mastery:</strong> Strong hands-on experience with Terraform, including workspace strategies, state management, and automation patterns that scale. Comfortable solving state isolation issues and building reliable, reusable infrastructure code. Experience with Ansible and templating tools like Jsonnet is a plus.<br><strong>Kubernetes in Production: </strong>Skilled at diagnosing deployment failures, interpreting pod logs, and debugging scheduling issues and rollback scenarios in live environments. Understands how pods, ReplicaSets, and controllers interact in production.<br><strong>Programming & Code Analysis: </strong>Ability to read and debug code in Go and/or Ruby. Familiar with identifying performance issues, scalability concerns, and contributing to infrastructure tooling through thoughtful code analysis.<br><strong>Large Scale Operations Background: </strong>Experience supporting infrastructure for many customers or environments simultaneously. Comfortable managing isolation, scaling, monitoring, and incident response across diverse workloads.<br><strong>Architecture & Incident Response:</strong> Able to reason through complex systems and operational challenges. Brings on-call experience and can lead technical discussions and incident resolution efforts under pressure.<br><strong>Customer-Focused Collaboration: </strong>Proven ability to work across teams and with internal or external customers to solve technical problems while maintaining service commitments and clear communication.<br><strong>GitLab Platform Proficiency: </strong>Comfortable using GitLab as a daily tool for infrastructure automation, collaboration, and operational workflows.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong><br>GitLab’s Dedicated team, where the SRE Environment Automation role sits, is on a mission to deliver a fully managed, single-tenant GitLab experience through the GitLab Dedicated platform. Our goal is to eliminate manual operations across the entire lifecycle of customer environments, including provisioning, upgrades, security, and monitoring, so customers can focus on unlocking the full potential of The One DevOps Platform without managing the underlying infrastructure. We build scalable, automated systems that ensure each GitLab Dedicated instance is secure, consistent, and production-ready—whether we're managing 10 environments or hundreds.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blan

title: Principal Engineer
description: <p>Principal Engineer - Contract<br><br>About this role<br><br>The bar has moved. Five years ago a strong engineer was measured by what they could build and how well they could mentor others to build it. Today, with Claude Code and agents, we produce quality work at a speed that would have looked superhuman in 2022 (Podium, PayPoint, Zuto, RL, OAG Analyser and others).<br><br>What separates exceptional from good is no longer typing speed or local craftsmanship. It is the complete package: architecture, deep engineering foundations, communication, system thinking, and the judgement to direct both your own intelligence and AI toward outcomes that matter. <br><br>Exceptional people at this level are not the best implementer in the room; they are the person whose specifications, decisions, and review judgement compound into systems that work in production and that others (and agents) can build on. They are a force multiplier, they hold a room at the highest levels, and clients treat them as the SME by default.<br><br>Your mindset<br><br>The mindset is the engine, and it is almost impossible to teach retrospectively. You are outcome obsessed, not output obsessed and you care whether the problem was actually solved - you resist the ego instinct to admire a clever solution and ask whether it was needed at all.<br><br>You are intellectually honest about uncertainty, taking a trust-but-verify approach and assuming the surprising bug is the one that will burn. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. strong communication and teamwork skills.</li> </ul> <p><strong>NICE TO HAVE</strong></p> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience with hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing or field flight testing of unmanned aircraft.</li> <li>Experience with edge AI acceleration hardware (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson, Coral).</li> <li>Knowledge of RF technologies, radar systems, or optical sensing for counter-drone applications.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your <strong>CV in English</strong>. We're looking forward to meeting you!</span></span></p> <p> </p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>SECURITY CLEARANCE</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Due to the nature of our work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the appropriate security clearance required for this position. This includes information such as, for example, your name, address, telephone number and date of birth, but also data relating to your specific career etc. by reference to which a specific individual can be identified with reasonable effort. However, information which cannot be (in)directly associated with your real-life identity is not personal data.</p> <p>Fundamentals and purposes of processing personal data collected from application documents and during the application process</p> <p>If you apply to us electronically, i.e. via e-mail or using our online form, we will collect and process your personal data for the purpose of executing the application process and preparing contracts.</p> <p>By submitting an application via our recruitment website, you express your interest in taking up work with us. In this context, you transmit personal data, which we will use and store exclusively for the purpose of your job search / application process.</p> <p>In particular, the following data is collected during this process:</p> <ul> <li>name (first and last names)</li> <li>e-mail address</li> <li>phone number</li> <li>LinkedIn profile (optional)</li> <li>channel through which you found us</li> </ul> <p>Furthermore, you can choose to upload expressive documents such as a cover letter, your CV and reference letters. These may contain additional personal data such as date of birth, address etc.</p> <p>Only authorized HR staff and/or staff involved in the application process have access to your data.</p> <p>The personal data is stored, as a rule, exclusively for the purpose of filling the vacancy for which you have applied.</p> <p>Your data will be stored for a period of 180 days after the application process has been concluded. In this context, Greenhouse is our processor under article 28 of the GDPR. In this case, the processing is based on an agreement for the processing of orders between us as the controller and Greenhouse.</p> <p><strong>Rights of data subjects</strong></p> <p>If we as the controller process personal data, you as the data subject have certain rights under Chapter III of the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), depending on the legal basis and the purpose of the processing, in particular the right of access (article 15 of the GDPR) and the rights to rectification (article 16 of the GDPR), erasure (article 17 of the GDPR), restriction of processing (article 18 of the GDPR), and data portability (article 20 of the GDPR), as well as the right to object (article 21 of the GDPR). title: Engineering Manager, Product Catalogs
description: <div class="content-intro"><div class="c-message_kit__blocks c-message_kit__blocks--rich_text"> <div class="c-message__message_blocks c-message__message_blocks--rich_text" data-qa="message-text"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer" data-qa="block-kit-renderer"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper--first"> <div class="p-rich_text_block"> <div class="p-rich_text_section">Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit <a class="c-link" href="http://www.redditinc.com/" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="http://redditinc.com" data-sk="tooltip_parent">www.redditinc.com</a>.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div></div><p><strong>This role is open to candidates based in the UK or the Netherlands. </strong></p> <p>Our ads team is developing Dynamic Product Ads, enabling us to match users to specific advertiser products. Our vision is for Reddit’s product ads to be highly relevant and contextual. A user browsing r/golf sees ads for popular golf clubs. A user reading a thread on r/buyitforlife about sunglasses sees ads for the exact models being discussed, just a few clicks away from a purchase. To achieve this vision, we need a highly scalable catalog infrastructure and intuitive user experience to onboard thousands of advertisers and ingest millions of products into our systems.</p> <p>As the Engineering Manager for the Product Catalogs team at Reddit, you will lead the full stack team responsible for our entire advertiser-facing experience. You will build UIs, APIs, and backend systems that manage advertiser’s products. The team also works closely with the knowledge graph teams to power organic shopping. This role combines technical expertise, leadership abilities, and drive to understand and deliver on customer needs.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Create a world class catalogs system that can scale to support billions of products</li> <li>Work closely with product managers and designers to craft compelling user experiences</li> <li>Collaborate with a wide range of teams from Ad Formats to Ad Delivery to ensure successful end-to-end delivery of product ads</li> <li>Establish and manage to SLAs within your team</li> <li>Be a strong mentor and cross-functional advocate for your team</li> <li>Contribute meaningfully to team strategy. We give everyone a seat at the table and encourage active participation in planning for the future. Don’t just come along for the ride.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Required Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>7+ years of experience in backend or full stack product development</li> <li>2+ years of experience managing engineering teams</li> <li>You're highly technical, enough to solve almost any problem your team has yourself, but you prefer to guide your team into solving them.</li> <li>Ability to work independently. You’ll be working with stakeholders that are mostly based in North America. You need to be able to make decisions and solve problems autonomously.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills. You must be able to collaborate effectively with teams in a fully-remote environment and discuss complex topics with technical and non-technical audiences.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Benefits:</strong></p> <ul> <li data-renderer-start-pos="3156" data-local-id="8c5ff10a-7296-4539-815b-c31a42a4d2d0">Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support</li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="3273" data-local-id="8c5ff10a-7296-4539-815b-c31a42a4d2d0">Family Planning Support</li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="3301" data-local-id="8c5ff10a-7296-4539-815b-c31a42a4d2d0">Gender-Affirming Care</li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="3326" data-local-id="8c5ff10a-7296-4539-815b-c31a42a4d2d0">Mental Health & Coaching Benefits</li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="3363" data-local-id="8c5ff10a-7296-4539-815b-c31a42a4d2d0">Private Pension plan with Employer-matching</li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="3410" data-local-id="8c5ff10a-7296-4539-815b-c31a42a4d2d0">100% employer-sponsored group medical plan</li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="3458" data-local-id="8c5ff10a-7296-4539-815b-c31a42a4d2d0">Income Replacement Programs</li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="3489" data-local-id="8c5ff10a-7296-4539-815b-c31a42a4d2d0">Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off</li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="3536" data-local-id="8c5ff10a-7296-4539-815b-c31a42a4d2d0">Generous Paid Parental Leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable.  We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes.  We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision.  For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our <a href="https://redditinc.com/policies/candidate-privacy-policy">Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors</a>.</span></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve.  Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know.</span></em></p></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Data Center Operations Implementation Manager
description: <h1><strong>Role Overview</strong></h1> <p>We are seeking a Data Center Operations Implementation Manager to own the end-to-end Day 0 to Day 2 transition of Nscale's data centres — spanning construction, fit-out, and live, steady-state local operations — across an assigned region and set of sites. Rather than owning construction execution itself, you'll be the connective tissue between Construction, Network Engineering, Compute/Infrastructure Deployment, and local Operations teams — driving a structured, well-documented transition so every site goes live on schedule and ready to support production workloads. This is an individual-contributor role built on strong stakeholder management, cross-functional influence, and travel to sites during critical transition windows.</p> <h1><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h1> <p><strong>Day 0 to Day 2 Transition Leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the end-to-end Day 0 to Day 2 transition process for each data centre site within your assigned region — spanning construction, fit-out, and steady-state operations.</li> <li>Define and maintain a standardized transition framework and readiness checklist applied consistently across your assigned sites.</li> <li>Track and drive closure of cross-team action items, dependencies, and blockers standing between construction handover and operational go-live.</li> <li>Identify and escalate risks to go-live timelines, and drive resolution across the relevant stakeholder groups.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Coordination</strong></p> <ul> <li>Track progress and status across Construction, Network Engineering, Compute/Infrastructure Deployment, Facility Engineering, SDM, and local site Operations teams throughout the transition window.</li> <li>Partner with Construction teams to track handover status, outstanding items, and site readiness milestones.</li> <li>Track Network Engineering's buildout, testing, and cutover activities required for a site to go live.</li> <li>Track hardware intake, rack-and-stack, and deployment scheduling with Compute/Infrastructure Deployment teams to stay aligned with the transition timeline.</li> <li>Coordinate with Facility Engineering on site systems and infrastructure readiness ahead of transition.</li> <li>Engage with the Service Delivery Management (SDM) team to ensure alignment with customer needs, SLAs, security, and facility performance.</li> <li>Take part in regular cross-functional syncs and stakeholder reviews to stay current on transition status.</li> <li>Contribute to a shared sense of ownership and accountability across stakeholder teams, even without formal authority over them.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Local Day Two Operations Readiness</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner with local Operations leads to confirm staffing, training, tooling, and support processes are in place before a site transitions to Day 2 ownership.</li> <li>Create and validate standard operating procedures (SOPs) and operational processes required for local Operations teams to run the site post-handover.</li> <li>Create the operational site tool bill of materials (BOM) required for local Operations teams to maintain the site post-handover.</li> <li>Verify the spare parts bill of materials (BOM) is complete and in place ahead of Day 2 handover.</li> <li>Facilitate structured knowledge transfer and handover documentation from Construction, Network, and Compute teams to local Operations teams.</li> <li>Confirm monitoring, ticketing, and ITSM processes are validated and operating before a site is handed to local Operations.</li> <li>Act as an escalation point for local Operations teams during the early post-handover period to smooth the transition.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Reliability, Safety & Compliance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Define and enforce Day 2 readiness criteria that a site must meet before transitioning to local Operations ownership.</li> <li>Facilitate root-cause analysis for transition delays or gaps surfaced during handover, and drive remediation across teams.</li> <li>Ensure health, safety, and environmental requirements are validated and documented as part of readiness sign-off.</li> <li>Support certification and audit readiness (ISO 27001, ISO 22237, SOC 2, Cyber Essentials Plus, ISO 22301) ahead of go-live.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Vendor & Supplier Coordination</strong></p> <ul> <li>Coordinate with construction contractors and colocation providers as needed to close out remaining items affecting the transition timeline.</li> <li>Track vendor commitments and SLAs relevant to the transition window, and escalate delays that put go-live at risk.</li> <li>Coordinate with the Supply Chain team to align hardware intake and staging with the transition schedule.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Monitoring, Reporting & Analytics</strong></p> <ul> <li>Track KPIs and KRIs for the Day 0 to Day 2 transition process (time to transition, readiness checklist completion rate, post-handover incident rate, etc.).</li> <li>Build and maintain dashboards that track transition status across your assigned site pipeline for all stakeholder teams.</li> <li>Produce regular reports for senior leadership on transition status, risks, and blockers.</li> <li>Use data-driven insights to identify systemic bottlenecks in the Day 0 to Day 2 process and drive continuous improvement.</li> </ul> <h1><strong>About You</strong></h1> <p><strong>Experience & Background</strong></p> <ul> <li>3-8 years of experience in data centre operations, program/project management, or infrastructure deployment at scale.</li> <li>Proven track record coordinating the transition of new sites into live operations across construction, network, compute, and operations functions.</li> <li>Experience operating in a matrixed environment, influencing outcomes without direct authority over every stakeholder team.</li> <li>Demonstrated success managing multiple concurrent site transitions in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.</li> <li>Background in hyperscale, cloud, or HPC data centre environments (preferred).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Technical Knowledge & Expertise</strong></p> <ul> <li>Working knowledge of data centre power, cooling, networking, and compute infrastructure, sufficient to coordinate effectively across specialist teams.</li> <li>Familiarity with network deployment and cutover processes, and compute/hardware deployment lifecycles.</li> <li>Knowledge of Layer 1 network infrastructure, including fiber, copper, optics, and transceivers.</li> <li>Familiarity with ITSM tooling, ticketing systems, and monitoring platforms used by local Operations teams.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Influence & Communication</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and align Construction, Network, Compute, and Operations teams without direct authority.</li> <li>Excellent cross-functional communication skills, able to translate technical detail between teams with different priorities and vocabularies.</li> <li>Program management discipline, with the ability to track and drive multiple concurrent workstreams to closure.</li> <li>Comfortable operating in ambiguous, matrixed, fast-moving environments.</li> <li>Bias toward ownership, pragmatism, and delivering results with urgency.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Operational Excellence</strong></p> <ul> <li>Rigorous tracking of readiness checklists, risk logs, and action items across many concurrent site transitions within your assigned region.</li> <li>Proven ability to build and refine standardized transition frameworks that scale with business growth.</li> <li>Strong attention to detail in transition documentation and handover packages.</li> <li>Willingness to travel to sites during critical transition windows.</li> </ul> <h1><strong>Nice to Have</strong></h1> <ul> <li>Experience with program management tooling (e.g., Smartsheet, Asana, Jira, monday.com) for tracking multi-workstream transitions.</li> <li>Familiarity with network cutover or compute/hardware deployment processes specifically.</li> <li>Experience with ITSM platforms and ticketing workflows.</li> <li>Experience with Palantir Foundry or similar data platforms for operational analytics.</li> </ul> <p>At Nscale, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enriches our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities.  We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.</p> <p>If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.</p> <p>The responsibilities outlined in this job description are not exhaustive and are intended to provide a general overview of the position. The employee may be required to perform additional duties, tasks, and responsibilities as assigned by management, consistent with the skills and qualifications required for the role.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>For information on how Nscale handles candidate personal data, please see our Employee & Candidate Privacy Notice: <a href="https://drive.google.com/file/d/1QK5Yg04WHD9K9IAtJgQWubJZC9oLvatK/view?usp=sharing" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1QK5Yg04WHD9K9IAtJgQWubJZC9oLvatK/view?usp%3Dsharing&source=gmail&ust=1765375172804000&usg=AOvVaw2Ncte4rmlGl8OKuFuDgDtx">Here.</a><br><br>Nscale does not accept unsolicited candidate submissions from recruitment agencies.<br></em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Technical Director
description: <p>This is a <strong>permanent full-time remote </strong>opportunity <strong>for those based in the UK.</strong></p> <p><strong>About Nearform<br></strong>Nearform is an independent team of data & AI experts, engineers, and designers who build intelligent digital solutions and capability at pace. We create AI-enabled solutions that enhance digital experiences, empower developers, and deliver measurable results. In these ways, we partner with ambitious enterprises to deliver enduring impact.</p> <p>Our deep expertise in solving the world’s most complex digital problems, along with our collaborative, people-first approach, enables enterprises to build breakthrough products and modernise legacy systems by unleashing the power of AI.</p> <p>Today, our team of 500 experts in 20+ countries is trusted by leading enterprises including Lululemon, Puma, Sun Life, Starbucks, Travelex, Virgin Media 02, and Walmart.  </p> <p>As part of our Delivery Management function, you will help our clients build solutions and platforms, launch new product ventures, and fundamentally change how they operate.</p> <p>You will work as part of a highly skilled, multidisciplinary team, typically consisting of designers, developers, DevOps engineers, and members of the client team.</p> <p>Whether you’re a Delivery Manager, Technical Lead, or Technical Director, you will act as the bridge between client needs and timelines, ensuring the delivery of innovative, scalable solutions.<br><br></p> <p><strong>About the Technical Director role</strong></p> <p>As a Technical Director at Nearform, you will provide strategic and technical leadership across multiple projects, ensuring alignment with business goals while fostering innovation and excellence. Your role will involve technical vision-setting, client engagement, and team leadership to drive both project success and long-term growth.</p> <ul> <li>Technical Strategy & Leadership – Define and communicate a clear technical vision, ensuring best practices in architecture, software development, and emerging technologies. Foster a culture of excellence, mentorship, and innovation across teams.</li> <li>Financial & Operational Oversight – Manage project burn-down, optimize resource allocation, and identify revenue growth opportunities while maintaining financial accountability.</li> <li>Industry Influence & Thought Leadership – Stay ahead of industry trends, contribute to open-source projects, and engage in public speaking, blog writing, and mentorship. Champion Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) and sustainability initiatives within Nearform.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we are looking for in this person</strong></p> <ul> <li>15+ years of technical leadership experience, ideally within consulting, SaaS, or large-scale digital transformation projects.</li> <li>Deep expertise in software architecture, cloud platforms, and modern development practices.</li> <li>A strong track record of guiding technical decisions on complex, high-impact projects.</li> <li>Experience leading pre-sales, discovery, and solution design discussions.</li> <li>Strong ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.</li> <li>A consultative mindset, able to align business needs with technical strategies.</li> <li>Strong stakeholder management and negotiation skills to influence at all levels.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with AI, databases, distributed systems, and modern software engineering best practices.</li> <li>Experience leading and mentoring senior software development teams</li> <li>A passion for continuous learning, innovation, and professional excellence.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Previous experience working in a fully remote, globally distributed environment.</li> <li>Background in financial oversight of technology projects.</li> <li>Experience contributing to open-source projects or technical thought leadership.</li> <li>Prior exposure to AI-driven solutions and emerging technologies.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Benefits & Perks</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Annual Company Bonus -</strong> We all help Nearform to hit company goals so we all receive a share of the profits on an annual basis in line with company performance.</li> <li><strong>Work Remotely and Flexibly -</strong> We have a genuine dedication to work/life balance. Our flexible working culture allows you to work around what matters - school run, no problem!</li> <li><strong>Paid Time Off Package -</strong> We offer an annual leave of 25 days plus public holidays. We also offer sick leave, marriage leave and many more.</li> <li><strong>Remote Working Allowance -</strong> Every 2 years, you will have a budget of up to €1250 (equivalent in GBP) to help you set up a comfortable and productive workspace in addition to your essential equipment provided by Nearform when you join.</li> <li><strong>Training and Development Allowance -</strong> Nearform is committed to supporting and investing in employees’ ongoing learning and professional development. You will be encouraged to pursue relevant learning opportunities that support your growth and the growth of others, subject to manager approval.</li> <li><strong>Healthcare -</strong> It’s important to always take care of your health, so we offer additional private healthcare here at Nearform. If you wish to learn more about the plan offered feel free to reach out to our team.</li> <li><strong>Pension & Insurances -</strong> We offer a pension match of up to 5% and Income Protection and Death in Service for peace of mind.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Our Interview Process</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Talent Call</strong> (30 mins, Zoom)<strong><br></strong>An introductory conversation with a member of our Talent Team to learn more about your background, experience, and career goals. This step helps us assess initial alignment.</li> </ul> <hr> <ul> <li><strong>Hiring Manager Interview </strong>(1 hour, Zoom)<strong><br></strong>A conversation with the Head of Delivery or CTO focused on your approach to delivery management, client collaboration, and technical problem-solving in an enterprise development setting. We'll also share more details about Nearform and the potential projects you may join.</li> </ul> <hr> <ul> <li><strong>Panel Interview</strong> (1.5 hours, Zoom)<br>A discussion with 2 Technical Directors focusing on your team leadership and delivery management approach in more detail. This includes scenario-based questions on team management, delivering technical work, and client collaboration, assessing how you drive success in an enterprise development environment.</li> </ul> <hr> <ul> <li><strong>Final Interview</strong> (45 mins, Zoom)<strong><br></strong>A final chat with the Managing Director for the region to discuss the plans for this role, Nearform’s strategy, and any questions you may have.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3><strong>Ready to Join Us?</strong></h3> <p>If you're passionate about building high-quality applications, solving complex challenges, and driving innovation in enterprise development, we’d love to hear from you.</p> <p>Apply now via our careers page at Nearform and be part of a team that values technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.</p> <p><em>As part of our recruitment process, we conduct manual and electronic identity verification checks to confirm the identity of prospective employees.</em></p> <p><br><em>Nearform is committed to shaping a better world in all that we do. title: Technicien / Ingénieur Intégration & Validation Cryogénique
description: Quandela est un leader mondial de l’informatique quantique, qui conçoit, développe et déploie des solutions quantiques de pointe à destination de la recherche et de l’industrie. Son offre comprend notamment les ordinateurs quantiques les plus économes en énergie pour les data centers, des solutions complètes de calcul quantique accessibles via le cloud, ainsi que des services d’accès à des algorithmes pour les acteurs académiques et industriels. Avec une feuille de route pragmatique et progressive, Quandela déploie depuis 2023 des systèmes de niveau industriel, tout en développant les futures générations d’ordinateurs quantiques tolérants aux pannes, capables de passer à l’échelle grâce à l’intégration de milliers de composants photoniques. Quandela ambitionne de rendre l’informatique quantique accessible au plus grand nombre afin de contribuer à résoudre les défis industriels et sociétaux les plus complexes. En savoir plus : Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions Rejoignez-nous à la pointe de l’innovation en informatique quantique 🚀 À propos du poste Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités de production et d'intégration de processeurs quantiques photoniques (QPU), nous recherchons un(e) Technicien(ne) / Ingénieur(e) Intégration & Validation Cryogénique pour rejoindre notre équipe Assemblage & Production, basée à Massy. Vous interviendrez principalement sur l'intégration et la validation des équipements et sous-ensembles au sein des cryostats utilisés dans nos systèmes. Ces opérations impliquent la manipulation de composants sensibles et délicats , nécessitant une grande précision, de la méticulosité et une attention particulière aux conditions de montage et d'intégration. Vous réaliserez les opérations de montage, de câblage, de thermalisation, de mise en service et de contrôle, en veillant au respect des contraintes cryogéniques et des protocoles de validation. Vous participerez également au suivi du fonctionnement et des maintenances des équipements cryogéniques, notamment les cryostats et leurs compresseurs associés. La compréhension et l'utilisation des systèmes de vide et de pompage feront partie de vos activités, en tant qu'éléments nécessaires au bon fonctionnement des installations cryogéniques. Au-delà de l'application des procédures, vous devrez être capable de comprendre le comportement des systèmes, d'analyser les anomalies et de contribuer à l'identification des actions nécessaires à leur résolution, en collaboration avec les experts techniques concernés. Selon les besoins, vous pourrez apporter un support technique à distance ou intervenir ponctuellement sur les systèmes installés chez nos clients, en France ou à l'international. Le poste s'inscrit dans un environnement de production en petite série , avec des équipements complexes et multidisciplinaires. La montée en échelle de la production est déjà engagée, notamment à travers la structuration progressive de nos méthodes et processus d'industrialisation. Une première base documentaire est déjà en place, et vous contribuerez à son amélioration afin de rendre les opérations plus robustes, reproductibles et adaptées à l'augmentation des volumes de production. Vous bénéficierez d'un accompagnement et de formations internes pour approfondir votre connaissance des équipements cryogéniques spécifiques à Quandela, avec la possibilité de devenir progressivement un interlocuteur technique de référence sur ces systèmes. Missions principales Intégration et validation des équipements dans les cryostats Vous réalisez l'intégration de composants et sous-ensembles, parfois sensibles et délicats, au sein des cryostats. Ces opérations nécessitent une grande précision et le respect des exigences de propreté, de manipulation et d'assemblage. À ce titre, vous : Préparez les cryostats, les composants et les équipements nécessaires aux opérations d'intégration. Manipulez et assemblez avec précision des composants sensibles , en appliquant les précautions et méthodes adaptées à leur fragilité et à leurs contraintes d'intégration. Réalisez le montage et l'intégration des composants et sous-ensembles dans les chambres de cryostats. Assurez le passage, le cheminement et la fixation des câbles et connexions à l'intérieur des enceintes cryogéniques, en veillant à préserver l'intégrité des composants et des connexions. Réalisez les opérations de thermalisation des câbles et composants, en tenant compte des contraintes thermiques et mécaniques. Veillez au respect des contraintes d'intégration : encombrement, interfaces mécaniques, compatibilité des matériaux, propreté et contraintes thermiques. Appliquez les bonnes pratiques de manipulation, de protection et de contrôle des composants tout au long des opérations d'intégration. Réalisez les opérations de contrôle et de validation de l'intégration selon les protocoles définis. Analysez les résultats des contrôles, identifiez les éventuelles non-conformités et participez à leur résolution. Rédigez les rapports de validation associés et assurez la traçabilité des opérations réalisées. Identifiez les difficultés d'intégration et proposez des améliorations adaptées. Requirements Compétences techniques – Indispensables Bonnes connaissances pratiques en cryogénie et compréhension des contraintes associées aux basses températures. Connaissance des principes de transfert thermique, de thermalisation et des contraintes mécaniques liées aux environnements cryogéniques. Capacité à réaliser des opérations de montage et d'intégration de composants dans des systèmes cryogéniques. Expérience dans la manipulation et l'assemblage de composants sensibles ou délicats, nécessitant précision et précautions particulières. Maîtrise des bonnes pratiques de manipulation, de propreté et de protection des composants lors des opérations d'intégration. Compréhension du fonctionnement général des cryostats et de leurs équipements associés. Connaissance des principes de mise sous vide et du fonctionnement des équipements de pompage nécessaires aux applications cryogéniques. Capacité à réaliser des opérations de mise en service, de refroidissement et de validation selon des procédures établies. Capacité à réaliser et valider des opérations d'intégration selon des protocoles définis, à analyser les résultats et à rédiger les rapports associés. Capacité à interpréter des mesures de température et de pression pour analyser le fonctionnement d'un système. Capacité à réaliser les premières investigations techniques, à analyser les symptômes observés et à contribuer à l'identification des causes d'un dysfonctionnement, en collaboration avec les experts lorsque nécessaire. Capacité à suivre des procédures tout en sachant identifier les situations nécessitant une analyse complémentaire ou l'intervention d'un expert. Capacité à assurer le suivi des échéances de maintenance et des interventions réalisées. Capacité à lire, appliquer et rédiger des procédures techniques et des rapports d'essais. Sensibilisation aux risques associés aux systèmes cryogéniques et aux équipements sous vide. Qualités recherchées Méticulosité et précision : capacité à réaliser des opérations d'assemblage délicates avec soin, patience et une attention constante aux détails. Rigueur et respect des procédures : attention portée à la qualité des montages, à la propreté des équipements et à la protection des composants sensibles. Autonomie et esprit d'initiative : capacité à prendre en charge les activités confiées, à identifier les difficultés et à solliciter les bons interlocuteurs lorsque nécessaire. Esprit d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes : capacité à comprendre le comportement des systèmes, à analyser les anomalies et à mener des investigations méthodiques. Pragmatisme et sens pratique : goût pour les manipulations techniques, l'intégration et la résolution concrète de problèmes. Organisation et traçabilité : capacité à documenter les opérations, suivre les essais et maintenir des historiques techniques fiables. Curiosité technique et volonté d'apprendre : intérêt pour le fonctionnement des équipements et l'acquisition progressive d'une expertise approfondie. Esprit d'amélioration continue : capacité à contribuer à la structuration des processus et à l'amélioration des méthodes de travail. Capacité à travailler en équipe avec des profils techniques variés et à solliciter les experts appropriés. Pédagogie et communication : capacité à transmettre des connaissances et à accompagner d'autres intervenants. Respect des règles de sécurité et conscience des risques associés aux systèmes cryogéniques et aux équipements de vide. Benefits Ce que nous offrons : Un rôle à fort impact, avec de réelles responsabilités dès votre arrivée Une équipe qui a envie de collaborer, de partager et de grandir avec vous Un modèle de travail hybride : 3 jours par semaine sur site à Massy, 1 jour à Paris et 1 à 2 jours en télétravail Une exposition quotidienne à l’ensemble de la stack quantique : des API haut niveau jusqu’au firmware bas niveau, et tout ce qui se trouve entre les deux Processus de recrutement : Entretien avec l’équipe Talent Acquisition (30 à 45 min) Entretien avec le Hiring Manager (45 min) Étude de cas : en direct ou à préparer chez vous puis à présenter Rencontre avec les équipes 2 prises de références Offre Ce processus est donné à titre indicatif et peut évoluer en fonction du poste. Chez Quandela, nous sommes convaincus que la richesse de notre équipe repose sur la diversité des expériences, des perspectives et des parcours. Nous nous engageons à construire un environnement de travail respectueux, inclusif et accueillant. Toutes les candidatures sont les bienvenues. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior IP Manager/ IP Professional (m/f/d)
description: <p><strong></strong></p> <div> <p class="x_MsoNormal"><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">You will be responsible for managing the Agile Robots Group’s patent, trademark and design portfolio. Based in Munich, you will work across a group with production sites in Europe, the Americas and Asia.</span></p> </div> <div> <p class="x_MsoNormal">The portfolio comprises more than 1,700 files. You will be supported by an IP Paralegal and a Chinese Patent Attorney based in China. External patent and trademark attorneys handle the drafting and filing of new applications. You will coordinate their work with inventors, business teams and other internal stakeholders, and report to the General Counsel of Agile Robots Group.</p> </div> <p><strong></strong></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Your Responsibilities: </strong></p> <p></p> <div> <ul type="disc"> <li class="x_MsoNormal"><strong><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">Manage the IP portfolio:</span></strong> Oversee pending applications and granted rights, regularly review their strategic value, and instruct external counsel on prosecution, maintenance and portfolio decisions. The portfolio covers Germany, European patents (including unitary patents and national validations), the US, China, Japan, Korea, India and other jurisdictions.</li> </ul> </div> <div> <ul type="disc"> <li class="x_MsoNormal"><strong>Develop new IP:</strong> Serve as the main contact for inventors, product designers and marketing teams. title: Associate Account Executive (Top Talent Sales Program - Lunar) BENELUX
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.</p></div><h3><strong>Lunar Sales:</strong></h3> <p>The Celonis Lunar Sales is a fast-track, 2-year development programme designed for ambitious professionals who want to accelerate their career at the intersection of AI, enterprise technology, and strategic sales.  If you have experience solving complex problems in a client-facing role, in management or strategy consulting or a leading industry strategy function and you are ready to bring that expertise into enterprise sales, this is your launchpad.</p> <p>The Program immerses you in every stage of the customer sales journey, supported by motivating leaders who will help accelerate your growth beyond expectations. If you're an innovative thinker who thrives on overcoming challenges, our Top Talent Sales Program will provide strategic significance, arming you with the knowledge and tools to address complex problems, create meaningful change and excel as an Account Executive. </p> <p>Onboarding Period of 1-3 months with the whole Lunar Cohort one-site at the Celonis Munich Office.<br><strong><br><br>The Role:</strong></p> <p>Fast-track your growth in enterprise sales through our exclusive top talent program. You will gain hands-on experience selling AI-driven business transformation, build relationships with industry leaders across Celonis verticals, including Automotive, Manufacturing, Banking, FSI,  Life Sciences, Consumer Goods, Retail, Energy and Public Sector and develop the leadership skills needed to drive real change for enterprise customers.</p> <h3><strong>The program focuses on three key pillars </strong></h3> <p><strong> </strong><strong> Strategic Business Development & Executive Relationship Building </strong></p> <ul> <li>Take full ownership of generating your own pipeline through cold outreach, persona identification, and first meetings, driving directly towards concrete KPI and revenue targets.</li> <li>Collaborate with C-suite executives (CEO, CFO, COO, CDO/CIO) to address challenges and align with their strategic objectives. </li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong><strong> Tailored Solutions & Strategic Alignment </strong></p> <ul> <li>Position Celonis Context Model and AI capabilities to address critical business needs, delivering measurable impact and expansion.</li> <li>Align strategies with clients' long-term business goals to maximize platform adoption and success.</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong><strong> Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration</strong></p> <ul> <li>Join a highly collaborative cohort of peers featuring a great team who can tackle challenges together, a strong performance culture, and continuous shared learning experiences.</li> <li>Orchestrate cross-functional teams, including Value Engineers, Service Consultants, Marketing, BDRs, and external partners.</li> <li>Partner directly with a senior Account Executive in a dedicated 1:1 mentorship model to accelerate your professional growth.</li> </ul> <h3><strong><br>The work you’ll do:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Understand the strategic and operational business needs of your target accounts and effectively communicate how Celonis and its AI-powered Process Intelligence Platform, will meet those to create real opportunities.</li> <li>Responsible for delivering revenue in your allocated account patch by creating new business opportunities. </li> <li>Identify key stakeholder personas, cultivate strategic relationships, and build an internal network of champions to drive customer success and account expansion.</li> <li>Engage cross Line-of-Business at C-level and below within your target organizations </li> <li>Become proficient in driving the sales process, following a structured, staged, programmatic flow through prospect, initial call, qualify, pitch to close.</li> <li>Collaborate with Value Engineering or personally conduct comprehensive presentations and demonstrations tailored to specific use cases, including Celonis AI, Process Intelligence Graph and industry-specific solutions, showcasing the value of our platform.</li> <li>Forge strong partnerships, particularly with leading consulting firms, tech partners, and the Big4.</li> <li>Work closely with your team, which includes business development representatives, value engineers, partner managers, and marketing specialists, to ensure seamless collaboration and success. </li> <li>Stay current on AI trends, process automation, and digital transformation to position Celonis as the intelligent backbone of enterprise operations.<br><br></li> </ul> <h3><strong>The qualifications you need:</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Proven Track Record in Client-Facing Roles: </strong>You bring 2–3 years of professional experience from a top-tier management consultancy, corporate strategy/transformation function, or leading enterprise technology company. </li> <li><strong>Strong Academic Foundation: </strong>You studied Business Economics, Engineering, Informatics, or a related discipline. A Master's degree is preferred, but exceptional graduates with solid foundational knowledge are encouraged to apply.</li> <li><strong>Sales Drive & Career Acceleration: </strong>You're ready to accelerate your career in sales. You have a genuine interest in applying your professional experience to a dynamic sales environment and are excited to build expertise in enterprise software solutions and client success.</li> <li><strong>Business Acumen & Process Intelligence Expertise: </strong>You have a sharp ability to quickly understand how companies operate, identify inefficiencies, and recognize where Process Intelligence and AI unlock real value and drive transformation.</li> <li><strong>AI-Forward Mindset: </strong>You're genuinely curious about AI and emerging technologies, driven to deepen your business acumen, and passionate about understanding business processes and KPIs—particularly in Finance, Supply Chain, or operations.</li> <li><strong>Industry Edge:</strong> You bring familiarity or hands-on experience in Manufacturing, Automotive, Consumer Goods, Retail, Financial Services, Telecommunications, or Utilities. This foundation helps you quickly grasp client contexts and add immediate value.</li> <li><strong>Communication Excellence</strong>: You communicate complex, strategic ideas with clarity and confidence in Business English. Fluency in Dutch is a strong plus.</li> <li><strong>Analytical & Independent Thinker</strong>: You bring a forward-thinking mindset with analytical capabilities. You think strategically, operate independently, and are comfortable owning challenges and driving solutions.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>What Celonis can offer you:</strong></p> <ul class="p-rich_text_list p-rich_text_list__bullet p-rich_text_list--nested" data-stringify-type="unordered-list" data-list-tree="true" data-indent="0" data-border="0"> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Pioneer Innovation:</span> Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Ownership from Day 1:</span> Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Unrivaled Family Support:</span> Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Work-Life Integration:</span> Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Continuous Growth:</span> Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Holistic Well-being:</span> Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Drive Sustainability:</span> Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Global Inclusion & Belonging:</span> Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Value-Driven Impact:</span> Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About Us:</strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1264">Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><a href="https://fin.ai/">Fin</a>, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.</p> <p>Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.</p> <p>Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.</p> <p>Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.</p></div><p>Speed is something we fight for every day at Fin, and we believe Berlin is built for people who share that instinct. We are drawn to Berlin by its rare blend of deep technical talent and rich creative culture – all within a vibrant, globally connected city that’s close to our R&D hubs in Dublin and London. It’s a place where the best of the best technical talent thrive, and where people from around the world are eager to relocate and build ambitious products.</p> <h2>What's the opportunity? </h2> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Fin, you will be a product engineer - someone who solves real customer problems through a</span><a href="https://blog.intercom.com/run-less-software/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">smart and efficient application of your technical knowledge</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and your tools. You’ll be part of one of our multidisciplinary product teams, where you will build both back-end and front-end systems, and work closely with designers, product managers, researchers, and data analysts.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re facing many exciting scaling challenges and we’re building a robust platform where your expertise can be applied to areas such as building a beautiful messenger composer, rule matching, deliverability, security, app availability and machine learning, to name a few. </span></p> <h2>What will I be doing? </h2> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">As an experienced engineer you will:</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Develop technical plans and contribute to our technical architecture as we scale our products to serve tens of millions of people every day.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Write Ruby code, which knits together a lot of AWS, infrastructure, platform and SaaS technologies that form the core of Fin's backend infrastructure</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Ship a change to production on your first day and a feature in your first week. That “day one” change is automatically deployed to production along with 100 other deployments (on average) each weekday.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Build using the best tools in the industry. This is a chance to be an integral part of building and growing a team.</span></li> </ul> <h2>What skills do I need? </h2> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">4+ years of industry experience in a software engineering role, preferably building a SaaS product.
