Great people are effective and learn what we use quickly (or introduce us to better ways of working)</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Experience collaborating directly with product teams and designers, and a proven track record of delivering value to customers or users. Engineers at Fin are pragmatists who work closely with others on cross-disciplinary teams</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Experience with Distributed systems </span></li> </ul> <div class=""> <p>#LI-Hybrid</p> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Unleash Your Potential</strong></p> <p>When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. title: Associate Deployment Engineer - Galaxy Graduate Program
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.</p></div><h3><strong>The Team</strong></h3> <p>Celonis makes processes work for people, companies, and the planet. As the <strong>Celonis Services</strong> organization, we are the strategic implementation consulting & transformation arm of a unified Customer Organization aligned to four core mandates:</p> <ol> <li><strong>Make Celonis Business Critical:</strong> Transform the platform into the central nervous system of our customers’ operations.</li> <li><strong>Scale Customer Health:</strong> Drive full platform adoption to ensure long-term value and stability.</li> <li><strong>Focus on High-Value Activities:</strong> Prioritize complex, high-impact technical work that moves the needle for Focus & Strategic customers.</li> <li><strong>Empower Career Growth:</strong> Foster an environment where every Celonaut owns customer success while accelerating their own professional trajectory.</li> </ol> <p>We deliver production-ready <strong>Celonis Platform</strong> implementations that drive measurable top, bottom, and green-line impact. Moving beyond “point-in-time” analysis, we utilize a <strong>Discover-and-Build</strong> approach to solve the world's most complex operational challenges.</p> <p>In close partnership with Value Engineering, we perform data-driven discovery to validate business hypotheses against real-world data. We then build and deploy <strong>operational, AI-enriched solutions</strong> on top of the Celonis Platform that automate decisions and optimize workflows at an enterprise scale.</p> <p>We don't just implement AI for our customers; we live it. Our project delivery lifecycle is accelerated by <strong>state-of-the-art AI augmentation</strong>, allowing our consultants to focus on high-level, strategic problem-solving. By serving as the "eyes and ears" in the field, we maintain a continuous innovation loop with our Product & Engineering teams, ensuring our frontline learnings directly shape the future of the Celonis Platform.</p> <h3><strong>The Role</strong></h3> <p>As an <strong>Associate Deployment Engineer within the Galaxy Graduate Program</strong>, you will support the end-to-end "Discover-and-Build" journey for our global customers. The Galaxy program unites Celonauts across different locations into one dedicated onboarding program which develops recent graduates into well rounded, skilled Services professionals in 12 months. As part of a consulting team, collaborating with more experienced consultants, you will bridge the gap between complex data landscapes and strategic business value. This role is designed for high-potential university graduates who possess a "Business-Critical Mindset" and the ability to understand how technical solutions can impact customer operations and improve efficiency, resulting in platform adoption and long-term ROI for our customers. </p> <h3><strong>The Work You’ll Do</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Support Strategic Implementations: </strong>Support the implementation of Celonis Platform as a business-critical tool by connecting customer data to actionable strategic outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Execute Discover-and-Build: </strong>As part of a project team, participate in process mining discovery activities, data transformation (SQL/Python), and the creation of AI-driven analyses to identify execution gaps.</li> <li><strong>AI-Forward Solutioning: </strong>Leverage your technical background to build and deploy "AI-forward" solutions, utilizing Machine Learning and LLM integrations for our most strategic customers.</li> <li><strong>Stakeholder Engagement: </strong>Actively participate in discovery and requirement workshops, practicing a consulting mindset to communicate technical findings to business stakeholders and continue building the solution with a strong customer centric mindset.</li> <li><strong>Operational Excellence: </strong>Contribute to project speed and efficiency by maintaining high-quality documentation and ensuring "Built-in Quality Control" in every line of code or analysis produced.</li> <li><strong>Cross team collaboration: </strong>Have the opportunity to collaborate with various teams within the Celonis organization, including but not limited to: <ul> <li>Business Analytics, Academy and Global Programs</li> <li>Business Apps & Product and Engineering</li> <li>Solution Architecture & Celonis Support</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <h3><strong>The Qualifications You Need</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Academic Background: </strong>A recent graduate (or final year student) with a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related technical field.</li> <li><strong>Technical Foundation:</strong> Proven experience building technical solutions during your studies or internships. You should be comfortable with Python, SQL, and have a foundational understanding of Machine Learning and AI architectures.</li> <li><strong>Business-Critical Mindset: </strong>A strong interest in how technology creates financial value. You are driven by outcomes like ROI, efficiency, and process improvement.</li> <li><strong>Consulting DNA: </strong>You are curious, solution-driven, and outspoken. You possess the confidence to manage stakeholders and the skills required to navigate complex corporate environments.</li> <li><strong>Analytical Rigor: </strong>The ability to not only focus on "What is the data saying?" and also to recommend "What should the business do, based on the findings?" </li> <li><strong>Communication: </strong>Excellent communication skills in <strong>English and German (native/proficient on both)</strong>, with the ability to translate technical concepts into business impact.</li> <li><strong>You are available to start working full time from February 1st, 2027 onwards, with the rest of our global cohort.</strong></li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>What Celonis can offer you:</strong></p> <ul class="p-rich_text_list title: Chief Financial Officer (m/f/d)
description: <p>Advise. Invest. Build. Meet ALAIKA — a new kind of Financial Services firm — globally scaling, headquartered in Munich. <strong>The work is hard. The bar is high. You own the finance function end-to-end, build the automated backbone a scaling firm runs on, and thrive in it.</strong></p> <h2>About ALAIKA</h2> <p>At ALAIKA, our vision is to build the future of Financial Services with three brands under one roof — Advisory (Strategy Consulting), Capital (Private Equity), Building (Company Builder). Right now, we are in the midst of building our trojan horse ALAIKA Advisory.</p> <p>The ambition: building the leading Financial-Services-specific entrepreneurial holding — Fortune 500 access, PE discipline, Silicon Valley technology-depth and thinking. <strong>Three networks that compound and multiply.</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>One industry. </strong>Financial Services. Nothing else.</li> <li><strong>One focus. </strong>The intersection of business and technology — across Strategic Transformations, AI & Data Intelligence, and Cybersecurity.</li> <li><strong>One goal. </strong>Being the go-to partner for the world's leading Fortune 500 financial services companies — and the ones we might help build into that.</li> </ul> <p>Founded in October 2022 by <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/johanna-von-geyr-374b81/"><strong>Johanna von Geyr</strong></a> (build-up and led Financial Services Practice for a NASDAQ-listed strategy consultancy) and <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/harald-braunstein/"><strong>Harald Braunstein</strong></a> (serial entrepreneur with exits incl. IPO), we bring together deep functional domain expertise and networks in global Financial Services, with a proven track record in building, scaling, and investing in leading software product companies. </p> <p>Curious what ALAIKA is all about? Explore our <a href="https://www.alaika-advisory.com/">website</a> and <a href="https://drive.google.com/file/d/1pX8HFTMUueKa5bTrP3k22kR1kFjq2Ot9/view">introduction deck</a>.</p> <p><strong>Join the movement — apply now.</strong></p> <h2>The role and what you will work on</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Own.</strong> Own the finance function end-to-end. Accounting, controlling, reporting, tax, and the annual financial statements — and the judgment behind them. The numbers are yours: <strong>accurate, on time, founder-ready,</strong> and built to help the business decide.</li> <li><strong>Lead.</strong> Build the finance team from the ground up. Hire, steer, develop. <strong>Multiply the output</strong> of everyone in it, not just your own.</li> <li><strong>Build.</strong> We're scaling fast, and the finance backbone has to scale with us: systems, processes, controls, forecasting. Build a genuinely automated operation, not a manual one held together by effort. You don't inherit a finished machine —<strong> you build it.</strong></li> <li><strong>Steer. </strong>Own the forward view: planning, budgeting, forecasting. Track cash, runway, and burn. You see what's coming and steer for it.</li> <li><strong>People. </strong>Own the systems that pay and grow the team: compensation, bonus structures, performance reviews, the people operation behind them. In a firm that hires the best, how you reward them is a competitive weapon. <strong>You build it, you make it work.</strong></li> <li><strong>Govern.</strong> Own risk, compliance, and controls as the firm scales across borders. Own the external relationships that come with them: auditors, tax advisors, banks, authorities.<strong> </strong></li> <li><strong>Expand.</strong> The role scales with the firm. New deals, new business units, new ground — you grow with it, and the finance backbone becomes the platform the whole firm builds on</li> </ul> <h2>What you bring</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Background:</strong> Strong degree in finance, business, or a comparably analytical field. A professional qualification (Steuerberater, ACCA, CPA) or an audit background is a plus. A track record that speaks for itself matters more.</li> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> Demonstrated experience in high-performance settings: fast-scaling company, top-tier consultancy, investment banking, or private equity. We don't count years, we count what you can run. Three exceptional years beat ten average ones.</li> <li><strong>Functional Experience.</strong> A minimum of three annual closes under your own responsibility, including the team, deadlines, and sign-off.</li> <li><strong>Finance Craft. </strong>Deep command of accounting and reporting under HGB. Real strength in controlling and corporate finance — cash-flow and scenario modelling, month- and year-end close.</li> <li><strong>People & Comp. </strong>You have designed and run compensation packages and performance-review systems before — not just administered them. You know how to pay people in a way that attracts and keeps the best.</li> <li><strong>Systems. </strong>Hands-on with modern finance and ERP tooling (DATEV, SAP, or comparable), and fluent in using AI to do the work faster and cleaner. You build clean processes instead of working around messy ones, and automate everything that should be.</li> <li><strong>Lead. </strong>You've built and grown teams before — hired, developed, and made the hard calls. And you're an equal to founders, management, and department heads: clear, direct, trusted in the room.</li> <li><strong>Languages. </strong>Fluent in English and German. Additional languages are a plus.</li> </ul> <h2>When you are a fit</h2> <p style="text-align: center;"><em>“Show me an athlete who did well academically. An athlete because they know what it takes to win and they have had to experience loss.”</em></p> <p><em>— Kenneth C. Griffin, Founder of Citadel</em></p> <p>You will work alongside intrinsically driven people who do "what it takes" — and you hold your own among them. You run the finance and operating backbone yourself, pulling the founders in only when it truly matters. Not a talker — a doer who makes things work.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Book-smart. </strong>Strong academic foundation. Think in structures, not gut feel.</li> <li><strong>Street-smart. </strong>Read the room fast. Prioritise ruthlessly. Grasp commercial reality.</li> <li><strong>People-smart. </strong>Communicate with precision — clear, direct, persuasive. Build trust across functions and seniority.</li> <li><strong>Athlete performance mindset. </strong>High aspirations. Grit. Learn faster than the environment</li> <li><strong>Entrepreneurial guts. </strong>You have built something, owned something, or bet on yourself at some point — and it shows in how you operate. P&L is not an abstraction. Ambiguity is not a problem. You move.</li> </ul> <h2>Why join ALAIKA</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Ownership & Impact. </strong>Own the entire finance function of a scaling firm, work directly with the founders, and build the backbone the whole company runs on. A rare scope for a single role.</li> <li><strong> Compensation. </strong>Above market with very entrepreneurial-driven bonus structures.</li> </ul> <p style="text-align: center;"><em>“My biggest economic misunderstanding was that people got rich from high salary, but almost no one on Forbes got there through salary but only with equity.” </em></p> <p><em>— Sam Altman, CEO of OpenAI </em></p> <ul> <li><strong>Stellar Network. </strong>Shoulder-to-shoulder with financial services executives running today’s giants and the founders building tomorrow’s.</li> <li><strong>Offices. </strong>Munich and Barcelona. More coming.</li> </ul> <p><em>Plus: the essentials done right — EGYM Wellpass, bike leasing, a kitchen stocked with healthy food and team events worth showing up for: Oktoberfest, team dinners, and more.</em></p> <p style="text-align: center;"> </p> <p style="text-align: center;"><strong>Build the backbone. Enable what comes next.</strong></p> <p style="text-align: center;"><strong>Invest in the future of Financial Services.</strong></p> <p style="text-align: center;">Apply with CV, transcripts, and references. <strong>Let’s see if you are the one.</strong></p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p style="line-height: 1.5;"><span style="font-family: 'trebuchet ms', geneva, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Equal Opportunities for all (f/m/d)</strong></span></p> <p style="line-height: 1.5;"><span style="font-family: 'trebuchet ms', geneva, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">ALAIKA is an equal-opportunity employer. We hire on merit and welcome applications from people of all genders, backgrounds, ages, and identities. Our team spirit celebrates diversity. We want you to be your true “you” and offer everyone an open culture and safe space</span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: (Senior) Power Platform Architect (m/w/d) - bundesweit
description: <p> </p> <p><strong>Gestalte mit uns, wie Technologie Unternehmen verändert – und deine Karriere gleich mit.</strong><strong> </strong><strong> </strong>  </p> <p>HSO gehört seit über 21 Jahren zum Microsoft Inner Circle – der exklusiven Top 1 % aller Partner weltweit – und wurde 26-mal als Microsoft Partner of the Year ausgezeichnet. Mit über 30 Jahren Erfahrung, 2.800 Mitarbeitenden aus 43 Nationen und 33 Standorten weltweit verbinden wir technologische Exzellenz mit tiefem Branchenverständnis.  </p> <p>Wir gestalten die digitale Zukunft des internationalen Mittelstands und von Großunternehmen. Als treibende Kraft für digitale Transformation implementieren wir komplexe, globale <strong>Microsoft Dynamics 365 Multiworkload-Architekturen</strong> (Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, CE). Dabei gehen wir neue Wege: Wir verknüpfen klassische Projektmethodik mit den modernsten <strong>KI- und AI-Werkzeugen</strong>, um Projekte schneller, transparenter und effizienter zum Erfolg zu führen.</p> <p>Du arbeitest an strategischen, technisch anspruchsvollen Projekten, die Unternehmen auf ein neues digitales Niveau heben. Als <strong>(Senior) Power Platform Architect</strong> gestaltest du nicht nur Anwendungen – du definierst die strukturellen Grundlagen, Architekturen, Governance-Modelle und Plattformstrategien, auf denen ganze Digitalisierungsprogramme basieren.<br>Du arbeitest auf Enterprise-Niveau, berätst Stakeholder auf C-Level, verantwortest Architekturentscheidungen und formst die Power Platform als unternehmensweite Business-Application-Plattform.</p> <p>Damit unterscheidest du dich klar von einer rein entwicklungsorientierten Power-Platform-Rolle:<br><strong>Du gestaltest das große Ganze – nicht nur einzelne Anwendungen.</strong></p> <p> </p> <ul> <li><strong>Strategie, Governance und Plattformarchitektur: </strong>Du verantwortest die strategische Ausrichtung der Power Platform beim Kunden, triffst Enterprise-Architecture-Entscheidungen, definierst Standards und stellst die Integration in die IT-Landschaft sicher. Governance-Modelle, Environment-Strategien und Application Lifecycle Management-Konzepte entwickelst du und unterstützt beim Aufbau eines Centers of Excellence. Workshops mit Architekten und Stakeholdern gehören ebenfalls zu deinen Aufgaben.</li> <li><strong>Anforderungsanalyse und Lösungsarchitektur: </strong>Du analysierst komplexe Geschäftsanforderungen und entwirfst skalierbare Architekturkonzepte auf Basis der Power Platform. Du stellst die langfristige Tragfähigkeit sicher und leitest die Umsetzung durch Projektteams.</li> <li><strong>Power Platform Expertise: </strong>Du nutzt dein End-to-End-Wissen über Power Apps, Power Pages, Power Automate, Dataverse, Connectors, Copilot Studio, AI Builder, um komplette Plattformlösungen zu gestalten. Du triffst technische Grundsatzentscheidungen, entwickelst Plattformstandards und unterstützt die Teams bei der Umsetzung komplexer Anforderungen. Innovationen wie AI, GPT oder neue Power-Platform-Funktionen beobachtest du kontinuierlich und leitest konkrete Empfehlungen für Kunden ab.</li> <li><strong>Datenarchitektur, Integration und Performance: </strong>Du entwirfst Datenmodelle und Integrationskonzepte und bindest Dataverse in bestehende Backend-Systeme ein. Mit Dataflows, Logic Apps und virtuellen Entitäten stellst du konsistente, performante und sichere Datenstrukturen bereit. Du analysierst die Performance komplexer Power-Platform-Lösungen, optimierst Prozesse und sorgst für die Einhaltung von Sicherheits- und Compliance-Richtlinien.</li> <li><strong>Geschäftsprozessanalyse und Enablement: </strong>Du arbeitest eng mit Fachbereichen zusammen, analysierst Geschäftsprozesse und identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale. description: <p></p> <div> <h1>Cloud Solution Architect - Data & AI</h1> <p><strong>Location:</strong> UK (Hybrid)<br><strong>Practice:</strong> Data & AI<br><br></p> <h2>About HSO</h2> <p>HSO is a Business Transformation Partner with deep industry expertise and global reach. As one of Microsoft's leading partners, we help organisations unlock the full potential of Microsoft Dynamics 365, Azure, Data and AI technologies to deliver meaningful business outcomes.</p> <p>With operations across Europe, North America and Asia, HSO combines industry knowledge, technical excellence and a people-first culture to help customers modernise their businesses, transform operations and embrace innovation with confidence.</p> <p>As demand for Data & AI solutions continues to accelerate, we're expanding our Data & AI practice and looking for experienced Cloud Solution Architects to help shape the next generation of customer transformation programmes.</p> <hr> <h1>The Role</h1> <p>As a <strong>Cloud Solution Architect - Data & AI</strong>, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping and qualifying customer opportunities across the Microsoft cloud ecosystem.</p> <p>This is a highly visible role that sits at the intersection of <strong>sales, enterprise architecture and delivery</strong>, combining technical leadership with commercial thinking. You'll work closely with customers, Microsoft and internal stakeholders to understand business challenges, identify opportunities, design compelling solutions and create clear pathways from initial discovery through to successful delivery.</p> <p>You'll help organisations transform the way they use data, analytics and artificial intelligence, translating business ambition into practical, costed and deliverable solutions.</p> <p>Success in this role requires more than technical expertise. You'll need strong consulting and stakeholder management skills, the confidence to challenge assumptions, and the commercial awareness to ensure opportunities are both valuable for clients and aligned with HSO's delivery capability.</p> <hr> <h1>What You'll Be Doing</h1> <h3>Opportunity Qualification & Solution Shaping</h3> <ul> <li>Lead Data & AI opportunity qualification alongside Account Managers, Business Development teams and Enterprise Architects.</li> <li>Facilitate customer discovery workshops, architecture assessments and strategic discussions.</li> <li>Understand customer business drivers, challenges and desired outcomes.</li> <li>Help customers define realistic transformation roadmaps aligned to business priorities.</li> <li>Qualify opportunities using structured sales and consulting methodologies, including MEDDIC/MEDDICC approaches.</li> </ul> <h3>Solution Architecture & Advisory</h3> <ul> <li>Design end-to-end Data & AI solutions using Microsoft You will own the full sales cycle across a focused set of government accounts, from account strategy and first conversation through business case, procurement, negotiation, close, and expansion. You will combine commercial ownership with public-sector credibility. The successful candidate will be comfortable engaging senior civil servants, CIO and transformation leaders, procurement, security, architecture, and business stakeholders. You will translate government priorities into a compelling value case for process orchestration, automation, and agentic workflows, while navigating formal procurement processes and the governance expectations of public-sector customers. What you will own Own the Dutch Government territory and create a clear account and coverage strategy across priority national and public-sector organizations. Build and maintain a healthy, self-generated pipeline, targeting at least 2.5x pipeline coverage through focused outbound activity, executive engagement, partner collaboration, and market development. Develop relationships across complex buying groups, including CIOs, CTOs, transformation leaders, enterprise architects, process owners, procurement, security, legal, and executive sponsors. Lead the full enterprise sales cycle: discovery, qualification, value engineering, technical evaluation, business case, procurement, commercial negotiation, and close. Apply MEDDICC consistently to create deal clarity, strengthen qualification, identify gaps early, and improve forecast reliability. Build business cases connected to public-sector outcomes such as service quality, operational efficiency, transparency, resilience, compliance, and cost control. Developa partner-first motion with relevant global system integrators, regional partners, and public-sector specialists. Share market intelligence on government priorities, procurement dynamics, competitors, partners, and customer needs to improve Camunda’s Dutch public-sector go-to-market strategy. title: Public Sector Sales Lead
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Anthropic</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.</p></div><h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>As Anthropic's Public Sector Sales Lead for France, you will be the face of Anthropic to the French State. This is a founding, zero-to-one role: there is no public sector team in France today, and you will build our strategy, our routes to market and our first strategic relationships from the ground up. Reporting to our EMEA South leadership, you will lead the adoption of safe, frontier AI across central government, starting with the largest ministries. You will work hand in hand with our Public Policy lead in Paris, because in few companies is policy as central to the mission as it is at Anthropic, and with Partnerships, Legal, Security and Product to put in place the commercial and compliance frameworks the State needs in order to work with us at scale.</p> <p>This is a senior individual contributor role. We expect you to have run a public sector business and led teams, and to be energised by stepping back into a hands-on seat where you build it yourself and where the size of your team says nothing about the size of your scope. In the first year, success is measured less by a large number and more by putting Anthropic on the map with the French State: a clear strategy, the right foundations and our first strategic agreements.</p> <h2><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Define and own Anthropic's public sector go-to-market strategy for France: where we play first, how we win, and what we need to build to get there</li> <li>Be the senior face of Anthropic to the French State, building trusted relationships with ministerial cabinets, senior officials and digital and technology leaders across the largest ministries, including defence, finance and justice</li> <li>Own the full sales cycle on our first strategic public sector opportunities, from first engagement through procurement route, close, deployment and expansion</li> <li>Work with Partnerships, Legal and Finance to put in place the routes to market the State needs, including resale and partner channels, framework agreements and central purchasing bodies such as UGAP</li> <li>Partner day to day with our Public Policy lead in France so that commercial and policy engagement reinforce each other, and stay aligned with French and European AI strategy and regulation</li> <li>Lead the conversation with customers on data sovereignty, security and compliance (for example SecNumCloud and the State's cloud doctrine), and work with Security, Legal and Product on how we meet those requirements</li> <li>Prove value with customers alongside a shared Applied AI architect, cloud providers and systems integrators, doing much of the groundwork yourself in the early stages</li> <li>Learn from and contribute to our UK and US public sector teams, bringing what works to France and sharing what you learn</li> <li>Create the playbooks, references and operating rhythm that will let us scale a public sector team in France over time</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You may be a good fit if you have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>15+ years in enterprise technology sales, including significant time running a public sector business unit or leading sales teams that sell to French central government</li> <li>The appetite to move from a leadership role into a hands-on senior individual contributor role with no team at the outset</li> <li>Evidence that you thrive building from zero: a new market, a new business line or an early-stage company, where systems, processes and support were not yet in place</li> <li>A track record of landing large, complex and genuinely transformative agreements with major ministries, as the person leading the deal</li> <li>A deep, senior network across central government, and the credibility to engage at director and cabinet level as well as with technical teams</li> <li>Practical command of French public procurement, including tenders, framework agreements, central purchasing bodies and partner or resale routes</li> <li>Real expertise in data sovereignty, security and compliance requirements in the French State, and experience leading those conversations with customers</li> <li>Experience of, or a clear aptitude for, working closely with public policy or government affairs colleagues</li> <li>Ownership and resilience: you treat what is missing as something to build, and you bring colleagues with you to build it</li> <li>The technical curiosity to learn our products in depth and hold credible conversations with both engineering leaders and senior officials</li> <li>Fluent French and English, with excellent written and spoken communication in both</li> <li>Willingness to go through French security clearance (habilitation) should specific accounts require it </li> <li>A genuine commitment to safe and beneficial AI, and the ability to articulate why it matters for public institutions</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>À propos du poste</strong></h2> <p>En tant que Responsable des ventes secteur public d'Anthropic pour la France, vous incarnerez Anthropic auprès de l'État français. Il s'agit d'un poste fondateur, à construire de zéro : il n'existe aujourd'hui aucune équipe secteur public en France, et vous bâtirez notre stratégie, nos voies d'accès au marché et nos premières relations stratégiques en partant d'une page blanche. Ce poste est rattaché à la direction EMEA Sud. Vous piloterez l'adoption d'une IA de pointe et sûre au sein de l'administration centrale, en commençant par les plus grands ministères. Vous travaillerez main dans la main avec notre responsable des affaires publiques à Paris — dans peu d'entreprises les politiques publiques sont aussi centrales à la mission que chez Anthropic — ainsi qu'avec les équipes Partenariats, Juridique, Sécurité et Produit, afin de mettre en place les cadres commerciaux et de conformité dont l'État a besoin pour travailler avec nous à grande échelle.</p> <p>Il s'agit d'un poste senior de contribution individuelle. Nous attendons de vous que vous ayez dirigé une activité secteur public et encadré des équipes, et que la perspective de revenir à un poste pleinement opérationnel vous enthousiasme : un poste où vous construisez vous-même, et où la taille de votre équipe ne dit rien de l'étendue de votre périmètre. La première année, la réussite se mesurera moins à un grand chiffre qu'à votre capacité à installer Anthropic auprès de l'État français : une stratégie claire, les bonnes fondations et nos premiers accords stratégiques.</p> <h2><strong>Responsabilités</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Définir et porter la stratégie de mise sur le marché d'Anthropic pour le secteur public en France : nos premiers terrains d'action, nos leviers de succès et ce qu'il nous faut construire pour y parvenir</li> <li>Incarner Anthropic au plus haut niveau auprès de l'État français, en nouant des relations de confiance avec les cabinets ministériels, les cadres dirigeants de l'administration et les responsables du numérique et de la technologie des plus grands ministères, dont la défense, les finances et la justice</li> <li>Piloter l'intégralité du cycle de vente sur nos premières opportunités stratégiques dans le secteur public, du premier contact au choix de la voie de passation, jusqu'à la signature, au déploiement et à l'extension</li> <li>Travailler avec les équipes Partenariats, Juridique et Finance pour mettre en place les voies d'accès au marché dont l'État a besoin : canaux de revente et de partenariat, accords-cadres et centrales d'achat telles que l'UGAP</li> <li>Collaborer au quotidien avec notre responsable des affaires publiques en France, pour que les démarches commerciales et politiques se renforcent mutuellement, en cohérence avec la stratégie et la réglementation française et européenne en matière d'IA</li> <li>Mener les échanges clients sur la souveraineté des données, la sécurité et la conformité (par exemple SecNumCloud et la doctrine « cloud au centre »), et travailler avec les équipes Sécurité, Juridique et Produit sur la façon dont nous répondons à ces exigences</li> <li>Démontrer la valeur auprès des clients en vous appuyant sur une expertise d'architecture Applied AI mutualisée, sur les fournisseurs cloud et sur les intégrateurs, en réalisant vous-même une grande part du travail de terrain dans les premiers temps</li> <li>Apprendre de nos équipes secteur public au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis et contribuer à leur travail, en important en France ce qui fonctionne et en partageant vos enseignements</li> <li>Créer les playbooks, les références clients et le rythme opérationnel qui nous permettront de faire grandir une équipe secteur public en France</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Ce poste peut vous correspondre si vous réunissez</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Plus de 15 ans dans la vente de technologies aux grandes organisations, dont une période significative à la tête d'une activité secteur public ou à l'encadrement d'équipes commerciales à destination de l'administration centrale française</li> <li>L'envie de passer d'un poste d'encadrement à un poste senior pleinement opérationnel, en contribution individuelle et sans équipe au départ</li> <li>Un parcours qui montre que vous vous épanouissez en construisant à partir de zéro : un nouveau marché, une nouvelle ligne d'activité ou une entreprise à ses débuts, là où les systèmes, les processus et les soutiens n'existaient pas encore</li> <li>Des accords majeurs, complexes et réellement transformateurs conclus avec de grands ministères à votre actif, en étant la personne à la tête de la négociation</li> <li>Un réseau dense et de haut niveau au sein de l'administration centrale, et la crédibilité nécessaire pour échanger au niveau des directions et des cabinets comme avec les équipes techniques</li> <li>Une maîtrise concrète de la commande publique française : appels d'offres, accords-cadres, centrales d'achat et voies de partenariat ou de revente</li> <li>Une véritable expertise des exigences de souveraineté des données, de sécurité et de conformité au sein de l'État français, et l'expérience de ces échanges avec les clients</li> <li>L'expérience — ou une aptitude manifeste — du travail en étroite collaboration avec les équipes affaires publiques ou relations institutionnelles</li> <li>Le sens de la responsabilité et la ténacité : ce qui manque est pour vous quelque chose à construire, et vous embarquez vos collègues dans cette construction</li> <li>La curiosité technique nécessaire pour apprendre nos produits en profondeur et tenir des échanges crédibles aussi bien avec les responsables d'ingénierie qu'avec les responsables publics de haut niveau</li> <li>Un français et un anglais courants, avec une excellente expression écrite et orale dans les deux langues</li> <li>La disponibilité pour engager une Rather than primarily building foundational platforms, we build products and features on top of our existing platforms to solve real merchant and market needs, including local business requirements, growth opportunities, and operational challenges.</p> <p>📍This open role is based in our tech hubs in <strong>Helsinki</strong> or <strong>Berlin</strong>.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong data-path-to-node="2,0" data-index-in-node="0">Please note:</strong> This role requires being based in Berlin/Helsinki on a hybrid basis. Engineer, you'll contribute to products and services used across the merchant experience. You'll:</p> <ul> <li>Build and maintain production software across backend services and user-facing This role plays a key part in building stronger fraud observability and smarter decisioning for fast growing card issuing and banking volumes across the globe. We are seeking a skilled and passionate Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our talented AI team and lead the development of AI models and algorithms that will drive our customer support service to new heights.</p> <p>As an AI / Machine Learning Engineer at SumUp, you will be responsible for building and optimising state-of-the-art AI models and algorithms. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including backend engineers, data scientists and product managers, to translate business requirements into innovative AI solutions. title: HR People Associate - Working Student
description: <h2>En bref</h2> <p>En tant que HR People Associate chez Picnic, tu prendras en charge l’administration RH du quotidien pour nos équipes à Paris. En lien direct avec notre People Partner France, tu veilleras à ce que chaque étape administrative soit réalisée dans les temps : de la préparation de l’arrivée d’un nouveau collègue au suivi de son contrat, en passant par les demandes RH du quotidien.</p> <p>Tu seras responsable du suivi de tes propres sujets, de la collecte des documents aux dernières relances, en veillant à ce que rien ne passe entre les mailles du filet. Une fois ces responsabilités bien maîtrisées, tu pourras élargir ton périmètre à certaines activités administratives de nos équipes People aux Pays-Bas et en Allemagne.</p> <h2>Tes missions</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Gérer l’administration de l’onboarding</strong> : collecter les documents nécessaires, coordonner les étapes administratives et t’assurer que tout est prêt pour le premier jour de chaque nouvelle recrue.</li> <li><strong>Assurer le suivi des documents RH</strong> : préparer les contrats, avenants, attestations et courriers à partir de nos modèles, coordonner leur validation et leur signature, puis veiller à leur bon classement.</li> <li><strong>Garantir la fiabilité des dossiers RH</strong> : tenir les données et les outils à jour, suivre les échéances et relancer les interlocuteurs concernés jusqu’à la résolution de chaque sujet.</li> <li><strong>Organiser le suivi de la médecine du travail</strong> : planifier les rendez-vous, gérer les convocations et veiller au respect des échéances administratives.</li> <li><strong>Piloter le suivi administratif des véhicules de fonction (lease cars)</strong> : coordonner les échanges avec les prestataires, préparer les documents nécessaires et suivre les livraisons comme les restitutions.</li> <li><strong>Être le premier point de contact pour les demandes RH courantes</strong> : apporter une réponse aux questions administratives, assurer le suivi des demandes et solliciter le People Partner lorsque la situation le nécessite.</li> <li><strong>Améliorer nos processus au quotidien</strong> : identifier les tâches qui pourraient être simplifiées, clarifier les checklists et améliorer nos outils de suivi pour gagner en fiabilité et en efficacité.</li> <li><strong>Élargir progressivement ton périmètre à l’international</strong> : une fois les processus français bien maîtrisés, prendre en charge deux ou trois activités administratives récurrentes pour nos équipes People aux Pays-Bas et en Allemagne, avec un accompagnement adapté. </li> </ul> <h2>A propos de toi</h2> <ul> <li>Tu es actuellement en formation idéalement en master RH, administration, gestion ou dans un domaine proche. </li> <li>Tu maîtrises le français et l’anglais à l’oral comme à l’écrit. Tu utiliseras l’anglais pour échanger avec nos équipes internationales et travailler sur des documents et outils communs. </li> <li>Tu peux travailler deux jours par semaine, pour un total de 14 ou 15 heures, pendant un an, avec un rythme compatible avec tes études.</li> <li>Tu es organisé·e, tu as le souci du détail et tu suis les sujets jusqu’au bout. Tu sais demander de l’aide et signaler un blocage au bon moment.</li> <li>Tu aimes aider les autres et tu traites les informations personnelles avec discrétion.</li> <li>Tu es à l’aise avec les outils numériques, notamment Google Sheets ou Excel, et tu as envie d’apprendre à utiliser de nouveaux outils RH.</li> <li>Une première expérience en RH ou en administration est un plus, mais nous recherchons surtout de la rigueur, de la curiosité et l’envie d’apprendre. </li> </ul> <h2>Avantages Picnic</h2> <p><strong>🍴 Restauration </strong></p> <p>Comme nous sommes implantés au centre de Paris, pas de cantine sur place. Par contre, des tickets restaurant d’une valeur de 11€ par jour sont remis afin de tester tous les délicieux restaurants du coin. Notre petite cuisine est également équipée de savoureux en-cas et rafraîchissements.</p> <p><strong>🚲 Santé et transports</strong></p> <p>Grâce à nos partenariats avec Sidecare et OpenUp, tu as la possibilité de souscrire à notre mutuelle d’entreprise ainsi qu’à un accès facile et gratuit à des psychologues professionnels, des ateliers et des outils pratiques. De plus, si tu te rends au travail en transports en commun, nous te remboursons ton abonnement à hauteur de 50%.</p> <p><strong>✍️ Développement personnel et professionnel</strong></p> <p>Tu auras l’opportunité de développer tes compétences, non seulement au travers de projets stimulants, mais aussi grâce à un environnement dynamique, jeune et international.</p> <p><strong>🎫Sorties et divertissement</strong></p> <p>Profite d'un accès à des offres et avantages exclusifs via notre CSE et partenaire Swile (bons d'achats, places de concert, cinéma, et plus encore). Tu profiteras aussi d'invitations à tous nos événements récurrents comme notre très convoitée Summer Party ! </p> <h2><strong><em>Merci de soumettre votre candidature en anglais et de préparer un CV en anglais.</em></strong></h2> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description: <h2>Description<strong> </strong></h2> <p>En tant qu’<strong>Enterprise Account Executive (F/H/X) pour la France</strong>, vous contribuerez directement à la croissance de Contentful en pilotant l’ensemble du cycle de vente, de la prospection jusqu’à la signature. Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la génération de nouveaux revenus et l’identification d’opportunités d’upsell auprès de nos clients actuels et de nouveaux clients.</p> <p>Vous contribuerez également aux initiatives d’accompagnement et d’adoption de nos solutions par les clients, tout en adoptant une approche commerciale consultative. Vous serez capable de dialoguer aussi bien avec des experts techniques qu’avec des décideurs et dirigeants métier.</p> <p>En collaboration étroite avec nos équipes <strong>Customer Experience, BDR, Partenariats et Marketing</strong>, vous développerez et fidéliserez notre portefeuille de clients sur le marché français.</p> <h2>Ce que vous ferez concrètement </h2> <ul> <li>Collaborer avec notre équipe commerciale transverse afin d’accompagner les clients actuels et potentiels dans l’adoption des différentes fonctionnalités et solutions de Contentful.</li> <li>Identifier, positionner, négocier et conclure des opportunités d’expansion auprès de nos clients existants.</li> <li>Atteindre les objectifs commerciaux trimestriels et annuels en élaborant une stratégie de compte et un pipeline commercial, en pilotant les processus internes et clients, en assurant le suivi des activités commerciales, en développant votre connaissance du marché et de la concurrence, en présentant nos solutions aux clients et en élaborant des propositions commerciales.</li> <li>Collaborer avec les équipes BDR afin d’identifier les clients potentiels et de qualifier les leads.</li> <li>Prospecter et développer de nouvelles opportunités commerciales sur un territoire défini. Effectuer des recherches, identifier les interlocuteurs clés et qualifier les leads entrants afin de développer de nouvelles relations commerciales. Salesforce a récemment fait l'acquisition de Qualified, et nous développons actuellement sa fonction go-to-market pour la région EMEA en partant de zéro. Il s'agit d'une opportunité rare de rejoindre une région pour une entreprise en forte croissance et récemment acquise, alors qu'elle s'intègre au sein de l'un des plus grands éditeurs de logiciels d'entreprise au monde — combinant l'agilité et le rythme d'une start-up avec l'échelle et les ressources de Salesforce.</p> <p>Nous recherchons un Enterprise Account Executive pour stimuler les revenus issus de nouveaux clients à travers la France, en pilotant l'ensemble du cycle de vente sur un territoire défini. Vous serez l'un des premiers Enterprise AEs sur le terrain pour Qualified, ce qui signifie que vous aurez une influence directe sur la façon dont la stratégie territoriale et les playbooks de vente prennent forme, au moment où cette activité s'établit au sein de l'écosystème plus large Agentforce/Data360 de Salesforce.</p> <p>Ce rôle convient à une personne qui s'épanouit dans l'ambiguïté et apprécie le défi de construire quelque chose de nouveau — quelqu'un qui voit une opportunité là où d'autres pourraient voir de l'incertitude. Faire partie d'une toute nouvelle équipe apporte son propre mélange stimulant de liberté et de défis.</p> <p>Ainsi, parallèlement à la croissance des revenus, vous apporterez curiosité, débrouillardise et un esprit collaboratif — en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec la direction d'Agentforce, les AEs Data Cloud et des équipes transversales plus larges pour aider à établir la place de Qualified au cœur de la stratégie go-to-market de Salesforce.</p> <p>L'expérience En tant qu'Enterprise Account Executive, vous serez responsable de l'élaboration et de l'exécution d'un plan stratégique de compte/territoire complet, ainsi que du pilotage des ventes sur un territoire et/ou une liste de comptes définis afin d'atteindre les objectifs de chiffre d'affaires. ferez concrètement</p> <ul> <li> <p>Être un expert de la phase de découverte et un partenaire commercial stratégique pour les prospects, tout en gérant l'intégralité du cycle de vente.</p> </li> <li> </li> <li> <p>Travailler de manière active sur vos comptes cibles identifiés tout en développant et maintenant constamment un pipeline de ventes solide.</p> </li> <li> <p>Orchestrer le cycle de vente pour vos prospects et savoir quand faire intervenir les bonnes parties prenantes.</p> </li> <li> <p>Collaborer de manière transversale avec des partenaires clés tels que le Marketing, l'Ingénierie Avant-Vente, le Produit et le Customer Success.</p> </li> <li> <p>Comprendre la concurrence pour vous positionner de manière stratégique sur notre marché.</p> </li> </ul> <h2><strong>Expérience requise</strong></h2> <p>Pour réussir dans ce poste, vous disposez de :</p> <ul> <li>4 ans ou plus d’expérience dans la vente d’une plateforme technologique.</li> <li>4 ans ou plus d’expérience dans contrats de 150 000 $ ou plus auprès d’organisations générant plus d’1 milliard de dollars de chiffre d’affaires.</li> <li>Une maîtrise courante du français  et de l’anglais.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Ce title: Associate Director, Biostatistics Consultant – Oncology - (Remote in UK- Outside IR35)
description: <p></p> <p style="line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Are you interested in working directly for a single sponsor while having the security and additional career opportunities that working for a global CRO can bring? Our team says it’s the best of both worlds….</span></p> <p style="line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">ClinChoice is searching for a <strong>Associate Director, Biostatistics Consultant  – Oncology</strong> <strong> </strong>to join one of our clients. </span></p> <h2 style="line-height: 1.2;" data-pm-slice="1 1 []"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Position Summary</span></h2> <p style="line-height: 1.2;" data-pm-slice="1 3 []"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">We are seeking an experienced <strong>Associate Director, Biostatistics</strong> with strong expertise in <strong>oncology drug development and clinical trial strategy</strong>. The individual will provide strategic statistical leadership across development programs and work closely with Clinical Development, Regulatory, Medical, Commercial, and Portfolio teams.</span></p> <p style="line-height: 1.2;"><strong><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">The ideal candidate should have experience in:</span></strong></p> <ul> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Selecting Trial Types: decide if a trial should be superiority, non-inferiority, or equivalence-based depending on what regulators and payers need to prove the drug beats a placebo or standard of care.</span></li> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Endpoint Selection: define and validate primary and secondary endpoints (e.g., overall survival, biomarker response rates, quality-of-life scores) to ensure they are measurable, clinically meaningful, and statistically robust.</span></li> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Innovative Designs: statisticians frequently design <strong>adaptive trials</strong> (e.g., seamless Phase II/III designs, group sequential designs, or biomarker-driven basket/umbrella trials) to save time and patients.</span></li> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Sample Size & Power Calculations</span></li> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Balancing Risk and Resources:  use power calculations to ensure a trial has a high probability of detecting a true clinical effect without enrolling excess patients, which drives up costs and exposes unnecessary individuals to experimental risks.</span></li> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Subgroup Powering: They determine if the study is large enough to analyze specific patient subsets (e.g., biomarker-positive patients or specific age groups).</span></li> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Establishing <strong>Go/No-Go Decision Gates</strong></span></li> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Proof-of-Concept Criteria: establish quantitative thresholds for Phase II trials (e.g., "If the hazard ratio is below 0.70 with a p-value , we proceed to Phase III").</span></li> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Futility Stopping Rules: Experience in build rules into trial protocols to stop a failing trial early, preventing sunk costs on a drug that is unlikely to succeed.</span></li> </ul> <ul> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Regulatory Strategy and Health Authority Negotiations : experience in preparing and reviewing data packages and attending meetings with regulatory bodies (like the FDA or EMA) to defend trial designs, proposed endpoints, and statistical analysis plans (SAPs).</span></li> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Mitigating Regulatory Risk: Experience in anticipating and addressing statistical objections from health authorities regarding missing data handling, multiplicity adjustments (controlling for false positives when looking at multiple endpoints), and bias.</span></li> </ul> <p style="line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">At the macro–Strategic Drug Development level, statisticians should have experience working with <strong>commercial and portfolio management teams</strong>.</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Quantifying Uncertainty: Experience in using historical benchmark data and simulation models to estimate the Probability of Technical Success (PoS) for an asset at each development phase.</span></li> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Pipeline Prioritization: Using risk models to help executive leadership in deciding whether to advance, partner, or kill an asset based on its statistical likelihood of clearing regulatory and market hurdles.</span></li> </ul> <h2 style="line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Qualifications</span></h2> <ul data-spread="false"> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Master's or Ph.D. in Statistics, Biostatistics, or a related quantitative discipline.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Significant experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or CRO environments with strong <strong>oncology experience</strong>.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Demonstrated experience in <strong>strategic drug development and clinical trial design</strong>, beyond traditional study-level responsibilities.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Strong knowledge of oncology endpoints, adaptive designs, sample size/power, simulations, and statistical methodology.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Experience supporting <strong>regulatory submissions and health authority interactions</strong>.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Excellent communication and leadership skills with the ability to influence senior cross-functional stakeholders.</span></p> </li> </ul> <p style="line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>The Application Process</strong></span></p> <p style="line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Once you have submitted your CV, you will receive an acknowledgement that we received it. If you have the requirements we need, you will be invited for phone interview as the first step.  Unfortunately, due to the number of applications we receive, we cannot reply to everyone individually if you are not successful.</span></p> <p style="line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Who will you be working for?</strong></span></p> <p style="line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>About ClinChoice</strong></span></p> <p style="line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">ClinChoice is a global full-service CRO specializing in clinical development and functional solutions for pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, and consumer health companies. We have over 28 years of proven high-quality delivery and results across all our services, with over 4,000 professionals in more than 20 countries across the Americas, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.           </span></p> <p style="line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Our Company Ethos</strong></span></p> <p style="line-height: 1.2;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Our mission drives our culture: to contribute to a healthier and safer world by accelerating the development and commercialization of innovative drugs and devices. Our employees are the most valuable company asset and they are the fulcrum around which all ClinChoice activities are built and close management and training is the core instrument to develop and maintain highly-qualified personnel. The continuous training keeps the resources qualified in terms of competence and expertise and gives all personnel the clear tools needed to manage both internal and client processes with the same methodology.   The success of these core values is evidenced by our below industry average turnover rates.</span></p&g

title: Customer Success Manager - Landwirtschaft
description: 🌎 What we do Root is Europe’s #1 primary data collection platform for F&B companies. We help our customers to measure and reduce farm-level emissions. ~31% of global GHG emissions originate from food-related activities. For the first time in history, climate performance has become an overall business performance indicator. Enterprises are mandated by regulatory bodies to disclose their climate performance, which leads to increasing pressure from investors, competitors, retailers, and consumers to prevent and reduce their CO2e emissions. Over the next 10 years, companies have set ambitious reduction targets that need to be met. Unlike other industries, the vast majority of F&B emissions originate from farms (known as Scope 3.1 emissions) and are highly complex to address. Root exists to help overcome this challenge. We raised >€10m in funding in the first 2 years of our existence, we launched our enterprise product, signed and onboarded some of the largest F&B players in Europe, and put together what we believe is the best-suited early-stage tech team in Europe. Will you be the next to join us? 🚀 🔭 What you will work on Your mission Drive customer success by supporting a customer portfolio, ensuring smooth project execution and tool adoption, and helping build strong, trust-based relationships that maximize long-term value and advocacy. 📅 Over the next months, you will… Drive Customer Success and Long-Term Value for Root's Customers Own the success of a defined customer portfolio , acting as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor, guiding customers through key success milestones (onboarding, data collection, verification, reporting, reduction readiness) and ensuring they clearly understand and realize the value of the Root Platform Plan, manage, and execute customer projects end-to-end , driving primary data coverage at scale through increased user engagement and data completion, serving as the first point of contact for agricultural users when needed, and ensuring high data quality, clear milestones, and on-time delivery Design and run farmer-facing enablement , including digital webinars to drive participation, improve data quality, and build trust at the farm level Collaborate with Account Management to relay customer feedback while building trust-based customer relationships that drive long-term satisfaction, retention, and advocacy Collaborate with Product to bring agricultural and agronomic expertise into our products, translating practical farming knowledge and farmer needs into actionable product feedback and clear, farmer-facing recommendations. 🧺 What you bring along Agricultural background (practical farm experience, agricultural studies, or prior work with agricultural users such as advisors, cooperatives) Hands-on and detail-oriented, you thrive in fast-changing, early-stage environments, can juggle multiple tasks, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks First experience in Customer Success, Operations or other fast-paced environments, where you supported or executed customer-facing processes end-to-end People-centric and proactive, empathetic, approachable, and able to communicate clearly while keeping customer outcomes and business priorities in mind Comfortable working with data in Excel and digital platforms, with an eye for completeness and consistency Fluent in German and English; additional languages (Polish, French, Portuguese, Spanish) are a plus Work from our Berlin office 5 days a week 🤗 You don't feel like you fulfill all the criteria? We get it: confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But guess what?! There is no such thing as a “perfect” candidate. The only thing you need to ensure along the recruiting process and beyond is that the problem that we are solving with Root is one you cannot wait to get out of bed for on Monday morning! description: Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. description: Your Mission: As a Senior Propulsion Engineer – Electric Engine, you will drive the development of the electric engine for the VÆRIDION Microliner. You will act as VÆRIDION’s internal technical expert for the complete electric engine, including the motor and controller. You will be responsible for decomposing aircraft-level requirements into engine requirements, guiding technical decisions, and ensuring compliance with applicable certification requirements. Working closely with the engine supplier, you will critically review and challenge the engine architecture, detailed design, technical analyses, test results and certification evidence. You will maintain a holistic technical overview of the complete electric engine, including the electric machine, engine controllers, power electronics, thermal management, mechanical interfaces, control functions and supporting hardware and software. As a senior member of the Propulsion team, you will play a key role in technical decision-making, supplier management, testing and certification activities, helping to bring one of the world's most advanced electric aircraft propulsion systems into service. Define, maintain and manage electric engine requirements, interfaces, operating limitations and verification strategies. Review and challenge supplier architectures, designs, calculations, simulation models, and substantiation reports, identifying technical gaps and proposing solutions. Evaluate the electric engine performance across its operating envelope, including efficiency, dynamic response, control stability, thermal limits and performance margins. Contribute to system safety activities, including Functional Hazard Assessments (FHA), Failure Mode Effect Analyses (FMEA) and System Safety Assessments (SSA), in accordance with applicable airworthiness and safety standards. Identify and assess applicable certification requirements, means of compliance and industry standards, including relevant aspects of EASA SC E-19, and ensure that certification considerations are addressed throughout the development cycle. Coordinate the electric engine development and qualification test campaigns, in collaboration with the testing team, including the definition of test plans, objectives, and success criteria. Review and assess test results, identify technical risks and deviations, and coordinate the resolution of issues encountered during testing. Prepare and review technical documentation, including specifications, interface documents, design reviews, qualification reports, and compliance statements. Support prototype build, aircraft integration and ground/flight testing activities throughout the maturation of the propulsion system Your Profile: Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics or a related technical field. At least 8 years of relevant professional experience in the development, integration or testing of electric motors, engine controllers/inverters or integrated electric-drive systems. Strong knowledge of electric machines and power electronics, including motor topologies, inverter architectures, operating characteristics & limits, losses & thermal behaviour, motor control strategies & protection functions, and manufacturing processes. Broad understanding of electric engine development, including thermal management, insulation systems, high-voltage systems, EMC, mechanical integrity, reliability & durability, and system integration. Experience defining and managing technical requirements, specifications, interfaces and verification strategies for electric engines or electric-drive systems. Experience collaborating with external development partners, engineering service providers or aerospace suppliers. A high degree of self-motivation, resilience, reliability and precision, combined with a strong sense of ownership. Strong analytical, technical-writing and written communication skills. Excellent verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in another European language is an asset. Passionate about aviation and the electrification of the aviation industry. Previous experience as a Certification Verification Engineer or in a comparable compliance-related role is a plus. Familiarity with EASA SC E-19 and its application to electric or hybrid propulsion systems would be an advantage. Experience in verification, validation and qualification of electric engines, including performance, thermal, endurance and environmental testing, would be a plus. Previous experience working within an EASA Part 21J Design Organisation or an international equivalent is a plus. Knowledge of systems engineering and safety assessment methodologies, such as SAE ARP4754A and ARP4761, would be beneficial. title: UI/UX Software Engineer
description: Join SE3 Labs as a UI/UX Software Engineer Design and build intuitive, high-performance interfaces for autonomous systems, turning complex operational capabilities into software that people can use confidently in the real world. About SE3 SE3 Labs builds spatial intelligence and autonomy software for unmanned systems. We combine 3D computer vision, state estimation and AI to help autonomous platforms perceive their surroundings, know where they are and operate when GPS and other sensors become unreliable. Defence is a core application of our work today. We are growing to a team of 100+ people. Join at a stage where you can shape our future, help us build the team and grow your responsibilities as the company expands. Our founding team’s research has received more than 90,000 citations. You will work closely with technical founders and engineers with deep experience in computer vision and autonomous systems, turning that research depth into systems that work in the field About the Role As a UI/UX Software Engineer at SE3 Labs, you’ll take ownership of how our software looks, feels and performs. Your core challenge is to build one coherent interface system that works across many contexts: different devices, screen sizes, plugins and product features, from large command displays to small field devices with limited computing power. You’ll combine UX/UI design with hands-on front-end development, working closely with our software team. From integrating 3D visualisations to building interfaces for military personnel in the field, you’ll help shape a product from the ground up and see the direct impact of your work. What You’ll Work On Coherent UI System & Front-End Architecture: Design and build a modular, well-structured front-end and a consistent design language that spans our whole product range. Make it easy to add new plugins and features, and to run on different systems and devices, without losing consistency or maintainability. UX/UI Design & Implementation: Work with the team to understand user needs, design and wireframe interfaces, and turn them into working software. Own both the user experience and the code that brings it to life. Multi-Device & Performance: Build interfaces that adapt across small screens, tablets and large displays, and stay responsive on resource-constrained hardware. Identify bottlenecks, optimise rendering and deliver a smooth experience without relying on high-end devices. 3D Visualisation Integration: Integrate 3D visualisations into the user interface so that they work smoothly alongside other features, including on devices with limited computing resources. Plugin & Feature Interfaces: Build reusable UI components for different plugins and product features, so that third parties and internal teams can extend the platform in a consistent way. Usability for Operational Environments: Help design interfaces for military personnel working in demanding conditions. Consider intuitive workflows, clear information hierarchy and established conventions such as NATO symbology. Learn from real user feedback and improve continuously. Collaboration & Product Evolution: Work closely with the software team to understand customer needs and translate them into design and engineering decisions. Help shape how the interface evolves as the product grows, and look for ways to simplify workflows and make new capabilities easier to understand. Your Profile You enjoy building a coherent system rather than a single screen: one design language and one component structure that works across many plugins, systems and devices. You bring hands-on experience designing and implementing user interfaces for software products, with a focus on intuitive, usable experiences across different devices and screen sizes. You have built structured, responsive and maintainable front-end applications, not just static designs or isolated prototypes, and you know how to organise code into reusable components and modular structures. You can move between UX/UI design and software development, turning wireframes and requirements into working interfaces and making informed decisions about both usability and implementation. You care about performance as well as appearance, and you work methodically to improve the experience across different hardware. You work well with engineers and other stakeholders, explore different approaches and turn ideas into practical solutions. You take initiative, enjoy open-ended problems and want to help build and shape a product rather than maintain an established interface. You’re interested in software for real-world use, where clarity, reliability and ease of use matter as much as visual design. You’re happy to work on-site with the team in Munich. Especially Valued Bonus Skills 3D Visualisation: Experience integrating interactive 3D visualisations into software interfaces, particularly using Unreal Engine or similar technologies. Performance on Constrained Hardware: Experience optimising front-end applications for low-compute devices, limited resources or demanding real-time requirements. Complex Operational Interfaces: Experience designing interfaces for complex systems where users need to interpret spatial information, symbols or multiple sources of information quickly. Gaming or Real-Time Visualisation: Experience in 3D gaming, motorsport, simulation or other fields where responsive interfaces and real-time visual feedback are important. Building from Scratch: Experience establishing a front-end architecture, reusable component system or coherent design language for a new product or platform. Perks & Benefits Real Ownership: Participate in SE3’s growth through our employee participation programme Work Environment to Excel at: Find a high-quality and modern toolset, flat hierarchy and a skilled, driven team which will push the limits together with you AI-boosted workplace: We empower every employee with best-in-class AI tools and agents, giving you unlimited access to the latest advancements and a true productivity edge 31 Paid Days Off: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off Well-being Access: Free membership to gyms, yoga, and wellness through EGYM Wellpass Team Offsites: We go on 2 company retreats per year, our last ones were in Italy and Greece Mentorship: Work closely with experienced engineers and get paired with a professional mentor to support your growth Our Process Intro Call (30 minutes): An initial conversation to discuss your experience, motivation and interest in SE3 Labs, alongside an introduction to the role and our working environment. Hiring Manager Interview (45 minutes): Discuss your experience, approach to software development and UX/UI design, and how you would contribute to the team. Technical Deep Dive (90 minutes): Explore your technical capabilities in more detail, including front-end architecture, interface design and implementation, responsive development and problem-solving. Team Lunch or Dinner: Meet members of the team, get a feel for how we work together and learn more about life at SE3 Labs. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Applied AI
description: Join SE3 Labs as Forward Deployed Engineer, Applied AI Help bring applied AI into the real world by building Python and LLM-powered solutions for defence customers, owning client relationships and turning real operational needs into software that works. About SE3 SE3 Labs builds spatial intelligence and autonomy software for unmanned systems. We combine 3D computer vision, state estimation and AI to help autonomous platforms perceive their surroundings, know where they are and operate when GPS and other sensors become unreliable. Defence is a core application of our work today. We are growing to a team of 100+ people. Join at a stage where you can shape our Forward Deployed team, help build the team and grow your responsibilities as the company expands. Our founding team’s research has received more than 90,000 citations. You will work closely with technical founders and engineers with deep experience in computer vision and autonomous systems, turning that research depth into systems that work in the field. About the Role As a Forward Deployed Applied AI Engineer at SE3 Labs, you’ll work at the intersection of software engineering, applied AI and customer delivery. You’ll collaborate directly with defence customers to understand their challenges, build LLM-powered solutions, and take ownership of projects from first requirements through to deployment. Our solutions are built to work in real operational environments, so you’ll also test and demonstrate them with customers in the field, not just at your desk. This is a hands-on role where you combine coding with client engagement, helping shape both the solutions we deliver today and the opportunities we develop for tomorrow. What You’ll Work On Applied AI Development: Build, test and integrate applications in which LLMs and other AI technologies play a central role, to solve practical customer problems. Python is our main language, but we care about the right solution, not the language. Turn emerging capabilities into usable software that can be deployed in real operational environments. Customer Discovery & Project Ownership: Work directly with customers to understand their workflows and to distinguish between what they ask for and what they actually need. Own your projects from scoping and realistic planning through development, testing and delivery. Coordinate with the Forward Deployed Team, handle changing requirements and keep customers informed. Field Testing & Troubleshooting: Test our solutions under realistic conditions, at our facilities in Erding but also at customer sites, training areas and exercises together with the armed forces. Observe how users actually work with the software, investigate issues on the spot and adapt quickly, so that you can show something better the next day.
