title: Business Systems Engineer
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a Business Systems Engineer to own the systems that turn a signed deal into a correct invoice and accurate revenue numbers. You’ll work across our go-to-market and finance stack: CRM, quoting and CPQ, billing, the data warehouse, and the integrations between them. Salesforce is one important part of that stack, not the whole job. This is an engineering role with business ownership: you’ll design how data and money move between Sales, Finance, Billing Ops, and Data teams, build the automation that keeps them in sync, and use AI to remove manual work and surface timely signals to reps and operators. You’ll partner closely with Sales, Deal Desk, Billing Ops, Revenue Accounting, and Data Engineering. This role is based in one of San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE - The big bet: Create a reliable GTM and quote-to-cash foundation across CRM, CPQ, billing and finance systems, marketing automation infrastructure, the data warehouse, and the integrations between them. - By day 90, build a clear understanding of the critical data flows between GTM systems, finance systems, and the warehouse, then ship an initial improvement to a high-value integration or workflow. - By day 90, develop AI-powered and agent-based workflows that reduce manual work for reps, Deal Desk, and Billing Ops while improving the quality of signals available to reps and operators. - By the end of your first year, automate billing-critical workflows such as upgrades and prorated refunds, early renewals, true-ups, and credit deferment, with audit trails Finance can trust. - By the end of your first year, improve data integrity and reporting through clear data models, deduplication, validation rules, reconciliation, and monitoring—including accurate ARR, pipeline, dashboard, and forecasting infrastructure. - Raise the bar for how the team ships and operates: sound access, change management, and release practices; thoughtful documentation and tool decisions; reusable tests, runbooks, code review, and AI-assisted development practices. SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING - Demonstrated experience in business systems engineering, GTM engineering, revenue operations, or a technical sales or marketing operations role, with the ability to own problems end to end and work effectively across functions. - Strong SQL skills and experience working with a data warehouse such as Snowflake or BigQuery; you design for clean, traceable data and understand how to protect its integrity across systems. - Experience building integrations with APIs, webhooks, event-driven services, reverse ETL, or automation platforms such as Zapier, Workato, or Tray.io http://Tray.io. Scripting in Python or JavaScript, or building serverless integrations, is a plus. - Familiarity with finance systems and concepts such as quote-to-cash, billing, invoicing, and revenue recognition, and the ability to work effectively with Finance and Billing Ops. Experience with an ERP such as NetSuite is a plus. - Hands-on Salesforce development experience with Apex, triggers, Lightning Web Components, and Salesforce automation, following the team’s development and release practices: source control, pull requests, code review, automated testing, and the deployment pipeline - is a plus. - Hands-on experience with Salesforce CPQ, Revenue Cloud, or a similar CPQ tool — including product and pricing data models, price books, bundles, and approval rules — is a plus. - Genuine curiosity about AI, with experience applying it to day-to-day work through AI-assisted development, agents, or workflow automation. Familiarity with Salesforce administration and customization—including objects, flows, permissions, and integrations—is a plus, not a requirement. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco and NYC, the estimated base salary range for this role is $167,000 - $228,000 per year. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Frage, wie unsere Software funktioniert und wie Menschen mit ihr interagieren. Welche Informationen benötigt ein Nutzer in welcher Situation? title: Solutions Engineer

Get paid to take part in voice interviews. We’re inviting web and front end developers based in the UK to take part in a research study run by an institution focused on global policy change. This is a paid research participation opportunity, not a job as a web or front end developer. Quick signup, flexible schedule, real payouts. </p> <p>Your voice can help build a picture of how people across the UK think and talk about important issues, and that evidence is designed to inform real policy decisions. Every participant counts, and together we’re working toward a shared research goal.</p> <p>The project launches in about one week, and places are allocated on a first come, first served basis, so please sign up as soon as you can.</p> <p><em><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Taking part in a short voice conversation with another participant</li> <li>Completing a short online survey sharing your views and experiences</li> <li>Giving honest, considered responses based on your own perspective</li> <li>Watching the community research goal progress as more participants take part</li> </ul> <p><em><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Residence in the UK</li> <li>Fluent English</li> <li>A device with a working microphone</li> <li>No research experience or specialist research qualifications required. We want a genuine cross-section of the UK population.</li> </ul> <p><em><strong>Why join this project?</strong></em><strong><br></strong>This is a chance to be part of something meaningful and have a say in research aimed at shaping policy. Once the findings are published, we’ll share them with participants so you can see the impact of your contribution.</p> <p><em>Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again. Simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for this and future opportunities.</em></p> <h4 style="text-align: center;" data-start="2302" data-end="2362"><em>Why Prolific is a great platform to join as a Participant</em></h4> <p data-start="2364" data-end="2679">Joining our platform as a Prolific participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future using your professional expertise. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes, and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.</p> <p data-start="2681" data-end="2975">We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioural data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.</p> <p data-start="2977" data-end="3349">We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviours into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.</p> <h4 style="text-align: center;" data-start="3351" data-end="3391"><em>Links to more information on Prolific</em></h4> <p style="text-align: center;" data-start="3393" data-end="3402"><a href="https://www.prolific.com/">Website</a></p> <p style="text-align: center;" data-start="3404" data-end="3413"><a href="https://www.youtube.com/@JoinProlific">Youtube</a></p> <h4 style="text-align: center;" data-start="3415" data-end="3435"><em>Privacy Statement</em></h4> <p data-start="3437" data-end="3863" data-is-last-node="" data-is-only-node="">By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organisation planning. Prolific's <a href="https://www.notion.so/prolific/Policy-Privacy-Notice-for-Candidates-f94a136a67544388b4888bc436451b57">Candidate Privacy Notice</a> explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific use of your personal personal information.</p> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p> </p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Global Structure</strong></p> <p><br>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p></div><h2><strong>Why Deliveroo (part of DoorDash)</strong></h2> <p>Deliveroo, part of the DoorDash group, is building the leading local commerce platform, connecting consumers, merchants, and couriers in real time. Paris is one of our most strategic and complex markets globally, with unmatched density, brand concentration, and competitive intensity.</p> <p>As we move towards our <strong>2026 ambition</strong>, we are evolving our commercial organisation to match the scale and sophistication required to win in Paris. This includes increased seniority, clearer regional ownership, and stronger execution across Inner and Outer Paris.</p> <p>The <strong>Senior Client Partner – Paris Inner Ouest</strong> role is a newly strengthened position, designed to combine <strong>strategic partner leadership, regional ownership, and organisation building</strong>.</p> <h2><strong>The Role</strong></h2> <p>As a Senior Client Partner, you'll lead a team of Account Management Lead, Senior Account Manager and Account Manager and you will report to the Regional Director of Paris, part of the Commercial team. The position is based in Paris. </p> <p>You are accountable for the <strong>growth and performance of strategic brand portfolios</strong> across one of Paris’ most critical zones. You will act as the <strong>senior commercial owner</strong> for your territory, ensuring alignment between Paris-wide strategy and local execution. Beyond partner management, this role plays a central part in <strong>aligning the organisation to business challenges and ambitions</strong>. You will design, lead, and continuously evolve the account management setup to ensure the right level of seniority, coverage, and execution quality across the territory. </p> <p>This is a <strong>senior leadership role </strong>with direct impact on revenue, partner satisfaction, and team development.</p> <h2><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h2> <p><strong>1. Lead Commercial Strategy & Execution Excellence </strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Own the end-to-end growth of brand portfolios within your Paris Inner cluster</p> </li> <li> <p>Ensure 5★ account management standards across the team, with clear portfolio sizing</p> </li> <li> <p>Build and maintain relationships with senior and C-level stakeholders</p> </li> <li> <p>Lead contract negotiations, renewals, and upsell strategies</p> </li> <li> <p>Create and execute joint business plans addressing partner growth, profitability, and operational performance</p> </li> <li> <p>Act as a trusted advisor, providing insights on Deliveroo capabilities, competitors, and market trends</p> </li> <li> <p>Responsible for a commercial initiative for Paris : engage team, drive performance and proactively adjust structure, focus, or processes</p> </li> </ul> <h3>2. Regional & Portfolio Ownership</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Own a zone cluster, defining and executing the strategy to win</p> </li> <li> <p>Translate Paris-wide and national priorities into clear, actionable regional strategies</p> </li> <li> <p>Improve Client Value Proposition (CVP) across the territory in collaboration with other commercial departments</p> </li> </ul> <h3>3. Talent Development & Succession</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Lead and develop a team of up to 10 AMs / SAMs, either directly or through mid-management</p> </li> <li> <p>Coach and mentor high-potential talent, building a strong internal succession pipeline</p> </li> </ul> <h3>4. Cross-Functional Leadership</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Partner closely with Operations, Marketing, Product, Strategy, and Finance</p> </li> <li> <p>Represent your portfolio and organisation in Paris and France leadership forums</p> </li> <li> <p>Influence roadmap and prioritisation through structured partner and market feedback</p> </li> </ul> <h2><strong>What We’re Looking For</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Experience</strong></h3> <ul> <li>10+ years in commercial, client partnership, or account management roles</li> <li>Proven experience managing <strong>complex, strategic brand portfolios</strong></li> <li>Demonstrated success leading <strong>multi-layered teams</strong> in fast-paced environments</li> <li>Experience in F&B, Hospitality, Retail, FMCG, or Marketplace businesses preferred</li> <li>Strong commercial and financial acumen (P&L understanding)</li> <li>Excellent negotiation and stakeholder management skills</li> <li>Ability to design and scale <strong>organisations and coverage models</strong></li> <li>Data-driven, structured, and execution-focused</li> <li>Senior, credible, and resilient leader</li> <li>High ownership mindset with a bias for action</li> <li>Comfortable navigating ambiguity and driving change</li> <li>Passionate about people development and raising standards</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Life at Deliveroo</strong></h2> <p>At Deliveroo, you’ll work on some of the most complex and impactful challenges in local commerce. We move fast, value ownership, and believe that strong teams build great outcomes.</p> <p>This role offers <strong>significant scope, visibility, and influence</strong> in shaping how Deliveroo wins in Paris.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Diversity, Equity and Inclusion</strong><br><br>At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.</p> <p>We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.</p> <p>If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.</p> <p>If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p><em data-renderer-mark="true"><br>Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at</em> <a class="_ymio1r31 _ypr0glyw _zcxs1o36 _mizu194a _1ah3dkaa _ra3xnqa1 _128mdkaa _1cvmnqa1 _4davt94y _4bfu18uv _1hms8stv _ajmmnqa1 _vchhusvi _kqswh2mm _2rkolb4i _ect4ttxp _syaz13af _1a3b18uv _4fpr8stv _5goinqa1 _f8pj13af _9oik18uv _1bnxglyw _jf4cnqa1 _30l313af _1nrm18uv _c2waglyw _1iohnqa1 _9h8h12zz _10531ra0 _1ien1ra0 _n0fx1ra0 _1vhv17z1" href="http://careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness" data-renderer-mark="true" data-is-router-link="false" data-testid="link-with-safety"><em data-renderer-mark="true">careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness</em></a><em data-renderer-mark="true">.</em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Marketing Lead (m/w/d) – Content, LinkedIn & Video | KI-Software für Bau & Immobilien
description: Über neoBIM neoBIM entwickelt KI-Software für die Bau- und Immobilienbranche. Unser Konfigurator macht aus einem Grundstück Gebäudevarianten mit Wirtschaftlichkeitsrechnung, unser zweites Produkt liest Gemeinderatsprotokolle und findet Bauvorhaben, bevor sie ausgeschrieben werden. Unsere Kunden sind Systembauer, Generalunternehmer und Bauträger. PLIERA (pliera.com) ist unsere Produktmarke. Unsere Gründer sind Pioniere der Architektursoftware und wissen, wie man ein Produkt zum Branchenstandard macht. Bisher entstehen fast alle Gespräche über unseren Outbound-Vertrieb und Messen. Das änderst du: Als erste Marketing-Person baust du Inbound auf, bis Systembauer, Generalunternehmer und Bauträger von sich aus eine Demo anfragen. Du arbeitest täglich eng mit Marko zusammen, unserem Principal Architect. Brand Book, Website, Newsletter und klare Regeln für öffentliche Aussagen gibt es schon. Für wen ist die Rolle ideal? • Du willst Marketing selbst aufbauen, nicht verwalten • Du schreibst, drehst und schneidest lieber selbst, als zu briefen • Du willst sehen, was dein Content im Vertrieb bewirkt • Du hast Lust auf eine Branche, in der Marketing noch fast niemand richtig macht Deine Aufgaben • Positionierung & Story – mit den Gründern festlegen, wie wir über neoBIM und PLIERA sprechen • LinkedIn – unser wichtigster Kanal: Unternehmensseiten, Posts für die Gründer, Unterstützung für Markos Feed, dein eigener Feed • Video – kurze Clips, Videos (gerne mit dir vor der Kamera), App-Walkthroughs für YouTube. Selbst produziert • Website & Blog – Texte, Formulare für Demo und Test, jede Anfrage mit Quelle im CRM. Inhalte, die bei Google und in ChatGPT oder Perplexity gefunden werden • Newsletter – übernimmst du • Content aus Kundengesprächen – zweimal pro Woche bei Vertriebsgesprächen dabei. Daraus werden Posts, Videos, Kundengeschichten und Zitate, jeweils mit Freigabe • Messen – BAU, EXPO REAL, BIM World: Content vorher, währenddessen und danach. Du bist mit am Stand Nach sechs Monaten • Gründer und Vertrieb erzählen dieselbe Story, die du entwickelt hast • Mehr Demo-Anfragen von Unternehmen, die uns selbst gefunden haben • Jede Woche LinkedIn-Posts vom Team und von dir • Regelmäßig neue Videos, kurz und ausführlich • Klarer Weg zur Demo auf der Website, bei jeder Anfrage ist die Quelle bekannt • Erste Blogartikel ranken, KI-Suche getestet Dein Profil • Aufbau von null – mindestens fünf Jahre B2B-Marketing mit Schwerpunkt Content, mindestens einmal die erste Marketing-Person (Startup oder neue Unit) • Hands-on – Texte, Grafiken und einfacher Videoschnitt kommen von dir. Du zeigst Arbeiten, die zum großen Teil deine sind, und was sie gebracht haben • Kamera – du hast schon eigene Videos produziert • SEO & KI-Suche – du hast ein Unternehmen für einen selbst gewählten Suchbegriff sichtbar gemacht und weißt aus eigenen Tests, wie Inhalte in ChatGPT, Perplexity und Googles AI Overviews landen • KI ja, KI-Sprech nein – du arbeitest täglich mit Claude, ChatGPT o. Ä., unser Content-Workflow ist KI-basiert, aber mit deinem Input und deinem Stil • Faktentreue – keine ungeprüften Zahlen, keine Kundenlogos ohne Freigabe • Deutsch & Englisch – in Wort und Schrift so, dass niemand mehr gegenlesen muss Nice to have • Du hast selbst schon gegründet • Systembauer, Generalunternehmer, Bauträger oder Baustoffhersteller als Kunden, PropTech oder ConTech • Texte für Gründer geschrieben oder Webinare moderiert • Du hast schon Messen bespielt • Englisch und Deutsch auch vor der Kamera • Weitere Fremdsprachen (gerne Koreanisch) sind ein Plus • Figma, Premiere oder CapCut, Beehiiv, Zoho CRM Wichtiger als dein Lebenslauf: Eigeninitiative, Persönlichkeit und Lust aufs Machen. Arbeitsumfeld und Benefits • Marketing von Grund auf aufbauen und prägen, wie neoBIM klingt • Kurze Wege: Du berichtest an unseren Principal Architect und die Gründer, Entscheidungen fallen in einem Gespräch • Live-Produkt und echte Kundengespräche als Rohstoff für deinen Content • Remote in Deutschland oder hybrid in Karlsruhe, dazu Team- und Messetage • Vollzeit, Start so bald wie möglich • Gute Hardware und die Tools, die du brauchst • Echte Einarbeitung und Feedback Fragen? Ruf gerne an: Felix, +49 176 95422094 (Telefon oder WhatsApp). Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: People & Culture - Working Student (all genders)
description: About us At GotPhoto, we are freeing photographers to be more successful. Through our platforms GotPhoto.com and fotograf.de , we help professional photographers simplify and transform the way they work — from photo management and client communication to ordering and payment processing. Our end-to-end workflow and e-commerce solution gives photographers more time to focus on what matters most: being behind the lens. Since 2012, we’ve built a sustainable and profitable business driven by entrepreneurial spirit, innovation, and a deep understanding of photographers’ everyday challenges. Today, thousands of photographers trust our software , creating their own success stories along the way. As the leading e-commerce engine for professional volume photographers and a business backed by EQT, one of the world’s leading private equity firms, we’re powered by a team of 150+ talented and international people building technology that simplifies photographers’ everyday work and helps them focus on capturing meaningful moments. Join us on our journey to empower photographers like never before. Your Role Do you want to drive turn everyday People administration into a seamless, high-quality experience for every single employee? Are you ready to support both the operational engine and the talent growth of a fast-paced tech scale-up? If you are a detail-oriented student who loves supporting people and keeping processes sharp by bringing employees and business needs together, then you are our perfect match! Expect a steep learning curve, with experienced colleagues by your side. You will gain deep in-depth knowledge of the entire employee life cycle, from initial recruitment to the final stage of a successful career. What You’ll Do Support People Admin: You help our People Operations with everyday employee inquiries, such as holidays, workations and learning budgets, and you keep our Jira Service Management tickets moving with speed and care. Help Keep Data Accurate: You support the maintenance of employee master data and digital personal files, following clear guidelines, so that everything stays accurate and up to date. Document Support: You prepare employment certificates, reference letters and other essential HR documents in German and English. Talent Spotlight: You help us look after the perfect candidate, from the first review of applications for junior roles to taking notes in interviews, so that the experience stays world-class. Process Coordination: You help the recruiting process run smoothly by scheduling interviews and following up with stakeholders to keep the momentum high. What You’ll Bring Experience You are currently enrolled and studying Business Administration, Human Resources Management, Psychology, or a related subject. Initial experience in fast-paced companies or HR environment is a plus. Experience in a Tech Scale-up environment is a bonus. Skills Bilingual Proficiency: You speak and write German and English at a professional level (C1/Native). Organizational Talent: You can juggle multiple tasks and projects without losing your cool or your attention to detail. Tech Savvy: You are comfortable (or eager to learn) working with tools like Personio, Leapsome, Jira, and Google Workspace. Mindset Detail Lover: Accuracy is your quiet superpower. Discreet & Trustworthy: You handle sensitive data with care. Eager Learner: You see feedback as fuel. You enjoy both working as part of the People Team and collaborating with it: You come to our Berlin-Mitte office at least twice a week to work alongside us. Why You’ll Love Life at GotPhoto Best of Both Worlds: We live and breathe a flexible hybrid model. Our beautiful office at Hausvogteiplatz is our vibrant Berlin hub for collaboration, but you have the freedom to leverage the setup that works best for you. Work from (Almost) Anywhere: We believe in flexibility that respects your lifestyle. Once you have completed your probation, you have the option to work remotely from within Europe for up to 40 days per year. Whether you are visiting family or simply seeking a change of scenery, we support a work-from-anywhere culture that helps you stay inspired. Recharge & Unwind: We value your downtime. You start with 26 days of leave, plus we love to top that up with additional discretionary "X-days" to make sure you’re truly rested. Multicultural & Inclusive Team: We thrive on diverse perspectives. Our international team fosters a culture of mutual respect and professional exchange, ensuring that fresh ideas and tolerance are at the heart of everything we build together. Fuel Your Growth: We’re big on learning. You’ll get a dedicated education budget to explore new ideas and grow professionally. Exclusive Employee Discounts: Get more for your money with access to the "Benefits at Work" platform, offering significant discounts on top global brands. Your Benefits, Your Choice: Through Probonio, you get a monthly budget to spend on what matters to you—whether that’s your public transport pass or other flexible perks that fit your lifestyle. What Matters to Us Research shows that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds may refrain from applying for positions if they feel they don't meet all qualifications. We strongly encourage you to apply if you’re interested: we're excited to discover how your distinctive experience can enhance our team! We work as one team. Wherever you come from. However, you identify. We believe in equal opportunities. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Digitale Lohnbuchhaltung (w/m/d)
description: SKALAR – Wir bauen die Steuerkanzlei der Zukunft Radikal einfach. Voll digital. 100% mandantenfokussiert. Wir denken Steuerberatung komplett neu: einfacher, schneller und transparenter für Mandanten und Kanzleiteam zugleich. Wo andere Kanzleien mit manuellen Prozessen, langen Wartezeiten und intransparenter Kommunikation kämpfen, bauen wir ein völlig neues Erlebnis - digital, proaktiv, KI-gestützt. Mit automatisierten Prozessen im Hintergrund und digitalen Schnittstellen zum Mandanten laufen repetitive Aufgaben weitgehend von selbst - damit du Zeit hast für das, was wirklich zählt: anspruchsvolle Beratung, Sonderfälle und strategische Mandantenfragen. Der Unterschied zu anderen "Digitalkanzleien": Über die Hälfte unseres Teams sind Softwareentwickler. Du gestaltest direkt mit, was sie bauen - und damit, wie KI-gestützte Steuerberatung in dieser Branche überhaupt aussehen wird. Dein Steuerwissen prägt das Produkt, nicht nur dessen Anwendung. Wir sind ein erfahrenes Gründerteam aus Steuerberatern, Digital-Unternehmern und Softwareentwicklern mit einem Exit-Track-Record von 140 Mio. €. Mit dir gemeinsam möchten wir eine der führenden Kanzleien Deutschlands aufbauen. Aufgaben Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnung: Du verantwortest die monatliche Entgeltabrechnung deiner Mandanten in DATEV Lohn und Gehalt – unterstützt durch KI- und Automatisierungstools, die Routine minimieren und Tiefe ermöglichen. Meldewesen & Compliance: SV-Meldungen, Lohnsteueranmeldungen, Beitragsnachweise, Bescheinigungswesen sowie die Kommunikation mit Finanzämtern, Krankenkassen und Behörden – termingerecht und prüfungssicher. Mandantenbetreuung: Du richtest neue Mandanten ein, begleitest sie langfristig und bist erste/r Ansprechpartner/in für lohnsteuer- und sozialversicherungsrechtliche Fragen. Sonderfälle & Beratung: Bearbeitung komplexer Sachverhalte – von betrieblicher Altersvorsorge über Sachbezüge und Pfändungen bis zu Kurzarbeit und neuen regulatorischen Anforderungen (z. B. Mindestlohn, korrekte Lohnsteuerberechnung). Entwicklung neuer Beratungsleistungen: Du bestimmst mit, welche KI-gestützten Leistungen wir rund um Lohn und Personal entwickeln. Dein Lohn-Wissen + die Unterstützung durch unsere Softwareentwickler = Services, die klassische Kanzleien nicht anbieten können. Prozess- & Qualitätssicherung: Du gestaltest unsere Lohnprozesse aktiv mit – von der Mandanten-Schnittstelle über die Datenübernahme bis zur Lohnauswertung – und sorgst für gleichbleibend hohe Qualität. Qualifikationen Fachliche Basis: Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellte/r, Lohnbuchhalter/in, Fachassistent/in Lohn und Gehalt oder vergleichbare Qualifikation. Lohn-Praxis: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Entgeltabrechnung, sicher in Lohnsteuer- und Sozialversicherungsrecht. Sicherer Umgang mit DATEV LODAS oder Lohn und Gehalt. Mandantenkompetenz: Empathische und klare Kommunikation mit Mandanten und deren Mitarbeitenden – auch bei komplexeren Themen. Sorgfalt & Termintreue: Der Lohn muss stimmen. Du arbeitest präzise, strukturiert und zuverlässig – auch unter Druck. Unternehmerisches Mindset: Du willst direkt mitgestalten, wie KI-gestützte Lohnbuchhaltung aussieht – und mit Softwareentwicklern bauen, was es so noch nicht gibt. Tech-Begeisterung: Du probierst neue Lösungen aktiv aus und siehst Technologie als Hebel – nicht als Bedrohung. Benefits 🧠 Du baust mit, was Steuerberatung morgen ist - KI-gestützte Beratungsformate, die es so noch nicht gibt. Du entscheidest mit, wie Top-Beratung in der Zukunft aussieht 🤝 Steile Lernkurve mit Gründern und Tech-Team - Direkte Zusammenarbeit im Alltag, gegenseitiges Sparring auf Augenhöhe 🚀 Volle Verantwortung ab Tag 1 - Eigene Mandate, Leistungsportfolio, Wachstumsstrategie - du gestaltest mit 🛠️ Modernes Tech-Setup — Digitale Prozesse, KI-gestützte Tools, klare Strukturen 💰 Kompetitives Gehaltspaket 🏠 Hybrides Arbeiten - Homeoffice und Büro flexibel kombinieren 📍 Büro im Herzen Münchens , top angebunden 🎁 3.000 € p.a. Benefitsprogramm + Firmenhandy Bereit, Steuerberatung neu zu definieren? Werde Teil von Skalar — und gestalte mit uns das modernste Mandantenerlebnis Deutschlands. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité (Télétravail complet possible)
description: Et si ton expertise comptable devenait un véritable levier pour aider les entrepreneurs et les cabinets à mieux piloter leur activité ? Chez Pennylane, nous construisons le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PME européennes. Notre plateforme aide les entrepreneurs à gagner du temps sur les tâches comptables et financières, et permet aux cabinets d’expertise-comptable de se concentrer davantage sur le conseil et l’accompagnement de leurs clients. Aujourd’hui, nous recrutons une personne ayant exercé comme collaborateur ou collaboratrice comptable en cabinet, et souhaitant mettre son expertise métier au service de l’accompagnement de nos utilisateurs. Ta connaissance de la comptabilité et des réalités quotidiennes des cabinets te permettra de comprendre rapidement leurs problématiques, de leur apporter des réponses adaptées et de les aider à tirer pleinement parti de Pennylane. 🌍 Pennylane, c'est quoi ? Pennylane est une fintech française parmi les plus dynamiques du pays, actuellement en pleine expansion à l'échelle européenne. En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à : 💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant 💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoia, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leurs débuts 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1 000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs qui recommanderaient Pennylane à leurs proches 🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail vraiment flexible 🚀 Déjà plus de 900 000 TPE/PME et plus de 6 000 cabinets d'expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France ! 🎯 Ton rôle Tu rejoins l’équipe Support applicatif et technique en tant qu’expert métier et plateforme. Tu es l’interlocuteur privilégié des dirigeants, des comptables internalisés et des cabinets d’expertise-comptable qui utilisent Pennylane pour gérer leur comptabilité et leurs finances. Au quotidien, tu analyses leurs problématiques, les accompagnes dans la résolution de leurs demandes et les aides à tirer pleinement parti de la plateforme. Tu contribues également à l’amélioration du produit en faisant remonter des retours structurés aux équipes internes. 📋 Tes missions Support et résolution de problèmes Réceptionner, qualifier et analyser les demandes des utilisateurs Comprendre leur problématique et leur contexte métier Apporter des réponses claires, pédagogiques et adaptées Assurer le suivi des tickets jusqu’à leur résolution complète Escalader les sujets complexes aux équipes techniques ou produit Garantir un haut niveau de qualité de service Accompagnement des migrations Aider les comptables en entreprise et en cabinet à intégrer leurs données dans Pennylane Comprendre les enjeux liés à la migration depuis un autre logiciel comptable Identifier les éventuelles difficultés et coordonner leur résolution Participer à l’amélioration des processus et de la documentation associés Amélioration continue et partage d’expertise Créer et mettre à jour les supports d’aide destinés aux utilisateurs Identifier les questions récurrentes et favoriser l’autonomie des clients Partager tes connaissances comptables avec l’équipe Faire remonter les irritants et les besoins aux équipes produit Proposer des améliorations sur les process et les outils internes 🚀 Tes premiers mois chez Pennylane Tu te formes sur le produit et les process de l’équipe Tu découvres l’entreprise, sa vision et ses différents départements Tu apprends à identifier les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement Tu commences à traiter des demandes liées à la comptabilité Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends en charge tes demandes de bout en bout Tu traites des problématiques de plus en plus complexes Tu contribues aux supports d’aide et au partage de connaissances Tu deviens un relais de la voix du client auprès des équipes produit Et ensuite Tu deviens progressivement un expert produit et métier, capable d’identifier les axes d’amélioration et de porter des projets. Des évolutions vers des sujets Support plus complexes, la gestion de comptes ou la mise en œuvre de Pennylane sont également possibles. 🙋 Le profil que nous recherchons Formation comptable : BTS CGO, DCG, BTS Assistant de gestion PME-PMI, Bachelor Responsable administratif et comptable, Master CCA ou équivalent Au moins 3 ans d’expérience en cabinet d’expertise-comptable Idéalement, au moins trois périodes fiscales réalisées Une expérience en contact direct avec des dirigeants est un plus Solides connaissances des principes comptables et de la réalité des cabinets Appétence pour les outils numériques et les nouvelles technologies Autonomie, curiosité et capacité à résoudre des problèmes Excellentes qualités rédactionnelles et pédagogie Sens du service et aisance dans la relation client Capacité à travailler en équipe et à s’adapter rapidement Envie d’apprendre et de suivre les évolutions du produit Anglais professionnel (compréhension écrite, orale et expression écrite) La connaissance de Pennylane est un plus ⚙️ Le process de recrutement Un premier échange avec un recruteur, 30 minutes Un entretien et un cas pratique avec un membre de l'équipe, 1 heure Un entretien final avec la manager d'équipe, 45 minutes 🎁 Ce que l’on peut t’offrir Une mutuelle Alan Blue et Alan Mind Des tickets restaurant via Swile Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés Un budget mensuel pour travailler depuis chez toi ou dans un espace de coworking Des bureaux situés à quelques minutes de Saint-Lazare, à Paris Une enveloppe de BSPCE Un accès à 8 000 salles de sport et plus de 300 activités bien-être via Gymlib Un Mac Un accès à Busuu pour perfectionner ton anglais Des Tech Days tous les 3 mois et un séminaire annuel Des activités sportives et des événements réguliers entre collègues 🌱 Pour t’épanouir chez Pennylane Tu apprécies évoluer dans un environnement en changement constant Tu fais de la collaboration une priorité Tu sais prendre du recul et prioriser les actions à fort impact Tu es à l’aise avec l’idée d’apprendre et d’améliorer continuellement tes pratiques Tu peux travailler en anglais, selon les exigences du poste Tu ne coches pas toutes les cases ? Postule quand même. Les parcours les plus intéressants ne sont pas toujours linéaires. Ce qui compte, c’est ta trajectoire, ton expertise, ta façon de réfléchir et ton envie de contribuer. 🔒 Information importante à destination des candidats Les candidatures doivent être envoyées uniquement via nos canaux officiels, notamment notre site carrière et les pages officielles de nos partenaires. Nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles se terminant par ----- ou ----- style="min-height:1.5em">Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement ni d’informations financières dans le cadre du recrutement. Si une telle demande vous est adressée, ne répondez pas et signalez-la-nous immédiatement. Pennylane encourage la diversité, l’équité et l’inclusion sous toutes leurs formes. Nous offrons un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux comme à distance. 🇫🇷 Données personnelles Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à : Notre data policy 🇬🇧 Personal Data Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more 🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren 🇪🇸 Datos personales Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. title: RWE Biostatistician
description: 🏨 The company Resilience Care is a leading French remote patient monitoring (RPM) company and a clinical research partner, founded in 2021 with a mission: better care. We provide RPM solutions in oncology, gastroenterology and psychiatry, combining ePRO collection with AI techniques. Our platform supports healthcare professionals with early side‑effect detection for continuous and proactive care, and our patient mobile app helps measure and manage symptoms with tailored resources. Our solutions improve care pathways, enrich continuous patient understanding, and accelerate clinical research through the collection, structuring and in‑depth analysis of real‑world data. They are currently deployed in routine care for 35,000 patients across 200+ healthcare institutions, and also support around twenty academic and industry clinical studies. We put data at the service of care and therapeutic innovation, with the ambition to enable every patient to benefit from personalized medicine. 📝 Your role In a nutshell : you will help build and deliver robust statistical work for Real‑World Evidence (RWE) and Medical Affairs studies — from analysis planning (SAP) to reproducible programming and clear interpretation. Your impact : make study execution more reliable, faster and more reproducible (plans, code and reporting), enabling cross‑functional teams to make informed decisions. Your day‑to‑day Draft and/or contribute to Statistical Analysis Plans (SAP) and methodological documentation. Program analyses in R and Python; concept of SQL/Postgre. Contribute to RWE studies : design, methods and execution. Set up data quality checks (consistency, cohort rules) and document assumptions. Produce decision‑ready deliverables (tables/figures/reporting) and explain results to non‑statisticians (internal or external actors). ✨ Your team Your future teammates : Dynamic team with medical and pharma expertise Your manager : Nicoleta - Director Translational Research – RWE & Biostatistics 👤 Profile ⚙️ You are a good fit if you can : Apply biostatistics (survival analysis: Kaplan‑Meier, log‑rank, Cox; regression; GLM/GLMM; matching/weighting). Write clean, reproducible code ( R, Python; basic SQL). Work with patient healthcare data (quality, traceability, constraints). Produce clear statistical/methodological documentation (protocole, SAPs, reports). Build meaningful data visualisations. Communicate insights to diverse audiences. 🙂 You are a good fit if you have : High methodological rigor and attention to detail. Autonomy and ownership mindset. Ability to prioritize and handle multiple studies in parallel. Clear communication and collaborative approach. Resilience when facing methodological push‑back. 📃 You are a good fit if you have already : 2–4 years of experience in biostatistics/RWE (CRO, consultancy or similar environments). Delivered analyses on healthcare datasets. Built reusable outputs (codebases, pipelines, reporting templates). Worked closely with non‑technical stakeholders. A plus if you: Know good practices/guidelines (GxP, ICH E9/E9(R1)). Have exposure to machine learning applied to healthcare data. Have worked with external vendors (Pharma, CRO’s etc). 💛 Why join us? High‑impact healthcare mission at the intersection of care, data and clinical research. Broad scope: RWE, Medical Affairs studies, standardisation and automation. title: Senior Backend Engineer, Platform (f/m/d)
description: Join Apaleo and shape the future of hospitality tech Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform, powering the next generation of hospitality operations. If you're driven by the idea of making hospitality smarter, more human and powered by cutting-edge technology, we'd love to hear from you. About the role You'll join our Platform team as an individual contributor, working directly with our Platform Lead, who sets Platform's technical direction. Platform owns infrastructure, developer experience and security foundations for the whole engineering organisation. It's a small team, so you'll cover a wide surface area, with no dedicated DevOps or QA function to hand work to. This is a high-ownership seat. You'll take on substantial, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives, agree the direction with the Platform Lead, then drive them from first analysis through to completion with real autonomy over how you get there. We don't run a groomed backlog or sprint planning. We assign a significant topic to someone who owns it end to end. If you thrive with structure handed to you, this isn't the role. If you love spotting the problem worth solving and driving it yourself, you'll fit right in. What you'll be up to Designing and building scalable, reliable and maintainable backend systems. Spotting and scoping problems and initiatives yourself, not just picking up assigned tickets: weighing impact, priority and timing. Contributing to architectural decisions and design discussions, and bringing other teams along. Driving substantial, cross-cutting initiatives end to end, coordinating with stakeholders across engineering. Building and maintaining internal tools and infrastructure (AWS, Terraform) that help teams deliver faster and more reliably. Owning observability, logging and operational excellence to keep the platform highly available. Sharing knowledge through code reviews, design reviews and pairing, and helping raise technical standards. Spotting where AI and automation can improve how we build and run software. Some of the challenges waiting for you You'll take ownership of one of these as your first initiative, with no other distractions. Solving horizontal write-scaling for our database. Modernising our CI/CD pipeline for faster, more reliable delivery. Migrating our infrastructure-as-code fully from CloudFormation to Terraform. Extracting and reworking common services to get us ready for our next scale level. What you'll bring to the team 5+ years of backend development experience, with a track record of owning significant technical work from ambiguity through to completion. Substantial hands-on ownership of infrastructure, reliability or performance, ideally on a platform or infrastructure team rather than a pure product team. Strong engineering fundamentals that transfer across languages and cloud platforms. We care more about how you think than which stack you've used. Experience designing and scaling distributed systems in cloud-native environments (AWS preferred; strong Azure fundamentals and genuine enthusiasm for the switch work just as well). Comfort with containerised services and infrastructure-as-code (Docker, Terraform; CloudFormation exposure is relevant given our current stack). Confidence writing your own unit and integration tests, as we don't have a dedicated QA function. A project you can talk about in depth: the problem, what you did and the impact it had. Fluent English. Nice to have Direct experience with C# (.NET), PostgreSQL, AWS and ECS or Kubernetes: a great fit, though not a hard requirement if your fundamentals are strong. Experience setting up infrastructure-as-code from scratch and working with it day to day, ideally with Terraform, including migrating or consolidating from other approaches (like CloudFormation). Experience with Kafka or other event-driven and streaming systems (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ or SQS are good transferable equivalents). title: Director Brand Marketing & Community (all genders)
description: Meet Urban Sports Club We are among the leading platforms for sports and wellness in Europe, dedicated to inspiring people to live active, healthy lives. With just one membership we offer access to thousands of fitness and wellness experiences across the continent. But what truly sets us apart? We believe our people are at the heart of everything we do. If you're curious about how we work, what we value and how you might grow with us, explore our Culture Hub & Career Opportunities . *Big news: Wellhub and Urban Sports Club unite!* Urban Sports Club is now a proud part of Wellhub, creating a global wellbeing ecosystem. Together, we connect 39,000 corporate clients and 97,000 wellness partners across 18 countries, offering millions of people even more ways to stay active and take care of their health. The opportunity We look for a visionary Director of Brand & Community to report directly to our CEO . This is an extraordinary opportunity to shape the next chapter of an already immensely strong brand. As we enjoy incredible brand equity and awareness – particularly in our home market of Germany – you won't be starting from zero. Instead, you will inherit a premium, high-performing base to steer our consumer brand into its next major iteration: moving toward a broader, lifestyle and community-driven positioning. A core focus of this role will be emphasizing the "Club" in Urban Sports Club. We are a community-driven concept, not just a utility app for solo check-ins. In this hybrid role, you will sit firmly on both the strategic/conceptual side and the operational frontlines. You will champion the evolution of the brand to maximize consumer appeal, while simultaneously developing and executing the concrete marketing strategies that bring our community vision to life. Your most exciting challenge? Internationalization – translating our proven local formula into scalable, culturally resonant consumer strategies for diverse international markets. What you will do Drive Brand Evolution: Architect the long-term conceptual development and narrative of Urban Sports Club, pivoting the brand toward a holistic, community-centric consumer lifestyle identity. You'll define the brand positioning, value propositions, messaging frameworks and audience strategies in collaboration with our Strategy team. Strengthen the "Club": Ensure campaigns and activations reinforce the community aspect of our brand, creating emotional connections that highlight shared experiences and lifestyle rather than just functional access. We see community as driving both new member acquisition as well as member engagement. Balance Strategy & Execution: Own the brand marketing strategy end-to-end, steering its execution across multi-channel campaigns, PR, Content, and Social Media. Lead Internationalization: Translate, adapt, and scale the core brand strategy across international B2C markets, balancing global consistency with deep local cultural relevance. Steer the Creative Studio & Teams: Oversee and mentor our multi-disciplinary brand teams and internal creative studio, fostering innovation, efficiency, and high-impact creative excellence. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the primary strategic brand stakeholder across the organization, collaborating closely with all marketing leaders to align brand priorities with business objectives. Insights & Budget Management: Efficiently manage the global brand budget while monitoring key health metrics (awareness, sentiment, share of voice) to turn consumer insights into optimized campaign performance. What you will need to succeed 10+ years of experience leading brand management, marketing, or integrated communications, ideally within lifestyle, community or fast-paced B2C consumer industries. Proven track record of developing scalable international brand strategies and managing large-scale, multi-channel campaigns. Strategic & Execution Hybrid Mindset: Ability to alternate seamlessly between high-level conceptual brand building and concrete, hands-on campaign delivery. Community-First Approach: A strong understanding of consumer brand positioning, audience engagement, and culturally relevant storytelling that builds community. Exceptional Leadership: Strong experience leading cross-functional creative teams, PR specialists, and content creators, alongside managing external agencies. Analytical & Financial Rigor: A data-driven approach to tracking brand performance metrics, translating market research into action, and managing complex global budgets. Language Proficiency: Full fluency in English is required; German language skills are a significant plus. What's in it for you Free Urban Sports Club L Pro Membership + Friends and Family Discount: Stay active with free membership, plus discounts for friends and family. Flexible Work Model: Enjoy a hybrid work setup, balancing on-site and remote work options to fit your lifestyle. Extended Remote Work Options: Work up to 120 days remotely within the EU, the UK, and Switzerland, including 30 days outside the EU. You'll also have the option to desk-swap at our other European offices. WorkOUT Life Balance: Take advantage of 30 days of paid vacation annually, plus two additional days for volunteering, flexible working hours, and complimentary access to our mental health provider Open Up. Personal Development: Receive an annual budget of €1,000 for professional growth, with regular internal training sessions and weekly German and English language classes. Engaging Team Culture: Participate in regular team and company events along with wellness initiatives that help you stay productive, healthy, and engaged in a hybrid work environment. Urban Sports Club is committed to providing a friendly, safe, and welcoming environment for everyone who applies for a position or already works with us, regardless of their sports preferences, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, disability, physical appearance, body size, race, age, or religion (or lack thereof). networking</strong>. </li> <li>Understanding of <strong>QEMU/KVM virtualization</strong> and managing virtualized environments. </li> <li>Experience with <strong>deep learning frameworks</strong> such title: Enterprise Account Executive
description: <p>SingleStore is looking for an accomplished sales professional to join our Sales Team. You will own a broad territory, build a majority self-sourced pipeline, create demand in an emerging category, and close greenfield enterprise opportunities.</p> <p>This is a true hunting role. You will engage customers before they have a defined project, develop customer-specific points of view, create urgency around business and technical problems, work with technical experts to land first production workloads, and build a measurable new-logo business with broad ownership. Direct AI sales experience is valuable, but proven selling ability and technical curiosity matter more than a narrow “AI seller” title.</p> <h2>Role and Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Build and execute a territory strategy for net-new customer acquisition.</li> <li>Prospect fearlessly across a broad account universe using proactive, persistent outbound, account-based, partner, and market-education motions; own the stakeholder plan, mutual action plan, close plan, value case, stage gates, forecast, and commercial outcome.</li> <li>Lead complex sales cycles through technical validation, security, legal, procurement, negotiation, and close.</li> <li>Partner with Solutions and Forward Deployment Engineers and cross-functional teams to validate technical fit and establish the first production workload.</li> <li>Navigate competitive displacement and maintain disciplined activity management, CRM hygiene, reporting, qualification, forecasting, and opportunity management; showcase clear metrics such as pipeline created, meetings, conversion, quota attainment, and new-logo performance.</li> <li>Be AI fluent: use AI and research tools productively and responsibly while applying judgment, validating outputs, and separating facts from hypotheses.</li> <li>Travel within the assigned territory as required. </li> </ul> <h2>Required Skills and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>5+ years of quota-carrying B2B enterprise software sales experience, ideally selling to large or technically sophisticated organizations; experience in data, cloud, analytics, AI, or adjacent technical domains is a plus.</li> <li>Repeated, quantified quota success with clear ownership of new-logo wins and self-sourced pipeline.</li> <li>Experience closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals involving executives, technical evaluators, security, legal, finance, procurement, and partners.</li> <li>Ability to sell measurable business outcomes and build ROI, TCO, or operational-impact cases.</li> <li>Technical fluency in an adjacent domain such as databases, data infrastructure, analytics, AI/ML, cloud, Kubernetes, developer tools, cybersecurity, observability, or open-source software.</li> <li>Strong qualification, account planning, forecasting, CRM, negotiation, and deal-management skills.</li> <li>Learning velocity and coachability, demonstrated through specific behavior change after feedback; ability to explain technical concepts clearly to technical and executive audiences.</li> <li>Executive presence, customer trust, resilience, intellectual honesty, and excellent communication skills.</li> <li>B.A., B.S. degree or equivalent in a related field.</li> <li>Experience with Fortune 500 or security-sensitive organizations, cloud ecosystems, open-source or consumption-based products, or emerging categories is preferred.</li> </ul> <p><em>To all recruitment agencies: SingleStore does not accept agency resumes. We trade crypto derivatives and spot markets across global venues, 24/7. Our traders don't just watch the systems. They own them end-to-end. About BlockTech BlockTech is an algorithmic trading firm headquartered in Amsterdam, with a second office in Singapore. We specialize in market making and trade cryptocurrency derivatives and spot markets globally, using our own capital. We're growing fast and expanding into new markets. Our traders work side by side with quantitative researchers and engineers. Research, engineering, and trading happen a few meters apart, so the path from a market read to live PnL is short. What will you do? You'll be responsible for our day-to-day trading operations, from running the automated systems to managing positions to shaping the strategies that come next. You will: Run the systems. Monitor and operate our automated trading systems and dashboards in live markets. Tune the pricing. Adjust pricing and parameters as market behavior shifts. Own the risk. Manage positions and the risk that comes with them. Build new strategies. Develop and deploy new strategies together with quantitative researchers and engineers. Spot what’s next. Research new business opportunities and stay on top of market news and changes. What we're looking for You'll need: A strong academic background in a quantitative field such as mathematics, physics, statistics, or computer science. Proficiency in Python. Focus and composure behind the screen when markets get busy. A strong sense of ownership and excellent collaboration skills. Bonus points for: Professional trading experience at a high-frequency trading firm Pay, location, and relocation Compensation: a competitive base salary plus a very attractive performance bonus based on individual and company results. Trading fund: strong performers get the opportunity to buy into the trading fund. Location: On-site on our trading floor in Amsterdam Visa: BlockTech sponsors the Dutch highly skilled migrant visa. Relocation: All-in relocation package and Dutch classes for international hires. Eligible hires may qualify for the 30% ruling. What else is in it for you Pension plan, company laptop, and home internet reimbursement An extensive in-house training program and an annual learning and development budget An environment that embraces AI, both to speed up your work and to advance our systems Gym reimbursement and sports during working hours: kickboxing, CrossFit, fitness, and soccer Weekly Friday drinks, monthly outings, quarterly sports competitions, and two trips abroad a year Daily breakfast and warm lunch, plus snacks and drinks all day How we work We're a team of trading and tech enthusiasts with a flat hierarchy. Have an idea today, and it can ship tomorrow. The best idea wins, whoever it comes from. This role comes with a high degree of autonomy. You'll own hard problems from concept to production and solve them your way. We promote reverse leadership, give everyone an equal playing field, and invest in personal and professional development. Our culture At our core, we are a team of passionate trading and tech enthusiasts committed to revolutionizing trading through automation. Our collaborative approach ensures that everyone contributes to achieving our ambitious goals. In this role, you will be both challenged and stretched, with ample opportunities for growth and development, both within and beyond your main responsibilities. We invest in our people by offering competitive compensation and benefits, fostering innovation, and celebrating success. Our commitment to personal development transcends traditional norms; we provide an equal playing field, promote reverse leadership, and offer boundless growth opportunities for all our employees. Join us to unlock your potential and drive innovation in the exciting world of algorithmic trading. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
description: About the Role We are hiring a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our team. You will own how DataSnipper’s products are understood and chosen in a crowded AI landscape. You will be the voice of competition, the buyer, and the message across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Product. You will join a small Product Marketing team where your work directly affects pipeline growth globally. About DataSnipper We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable. At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals to make those judgements. With Alwin by DataSnipper, our new agentic platform, AI agents now take on end-to-end audit and finance procedures, while every conclusion stays traceable to its source. That frees professionals to focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important. We're trusted by Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. Today, more than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on our platform, and in 2025 alone DataSnipper delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to its customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, we've built a strong foundation for what's next. And as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast. What You Will Do Competitive Intelligence Own competitive intelligence end-to-end: track competitors, draft the insight, and turn it into positioning. Build and maintain battlecards, objection handling, and playbooks for Sales and Marketing. Partner closely with Sales and Product leadership to ensure content is used, measurable, and effective. Set up a feedback loop between Sales, Marketing, and Product, and bring market input into roadmap discussions. Buyer Personas Create and maintain buyer personas for our key audiences. Ground them in customer research, win-loss, and sales input. Keep them current. Work with Sales to sharpen ICP and qualification criteria. Messaging Evolve product positioning, value propositions, and messaging that set us apart from competitors. Translate complex AI capabilities into clear customer value. Keep messaging consistent across web, content, campaigns, and sales. What Success Looks Like Sales teams are fully equipped with enablement content they actually use. Product messaging is consistent and clearly different from competitors. Personas and messaging reflect what we hear in the market. DataSnipper’s value proposition becomes easier to understand, harder to compete with, and stronger across all channels. What You Bring 6–8 years of B2B SaaS Product Marketing, ideally within a scale-up. Proven competitive intelligence and positioning work that helped win deals. Experience building battlecards and sales content that teams use. Ability to translate complex product capabilities into clear customer value stories and compelling narratives. Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing, and influencing stakeholders without direct authority. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a sharp eye for storytelling, structure, and clarity. Nice to have: audit, finance, or other regulated-industry buyers. What We Offer Be part of one of the fastest-growing, profitable unicorn scale-ups in the Netherlands with a global impact Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights) to share the company's success and growth Pension plan with a 6% contribution on top of your base salary 28 vacation days per year (full-time) to support your work-life balance Hybrid work model with at least 3 days onsite in our dynamic Amsterdam office Daily, freshly prepared lunches by our in-house chef to keep you energized NS business card for easy commuting to the office if applicable Access to continuous learning and development initiatives to grow your skills Engage with a vibrant international team spread across five global offices Company-wide events like DataSnipper GO, where global teams come together Access to a mental health and wellness platform supporting your wellbeing Recruitment Process Recruitment Screen (30 minutes, online) Hiring Manager Interview (45 minutes, online) Assessment Interview (60 minutes, on-site) Final Interview (30 minutes, online) At DataSnipper, we believe great ideas come from different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and providing every candidate with a fair and equitable hiring experience. Our hiring decisions are merit-based and grounded in the skills, experience, potential, and capabilities relevant to the role. We welcome applicants regardless of age, race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes you, you. title: Senior Software Engineer, Billing & Monetization
description: We are looking for a skilled and passionate Senior Software Engineer, Billing & Monetization to join our Billing team in the Amsterdam office. Working in a high-growth scale-up, you’ll have the unique opportunity to drive innovation at scale while contributing to a company transforming the world of audit and finance. About the role: Every customer's path through DataSnipper, from first sign-up to first agent run to renewal, runs on the systems this team owns: how customers get in, what they are entitled to, and how AI usage turns into revenue. As we move from seats to usage and credits for our agentic products, these systems become as strategic as the product itself, and they have to be fast, accurate and trustworthy. This is a hands-on role for an engineer who cares about correctness as much as speed, and wants to see the commercial impact of their code. Why DataSnipper? The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust. We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable. At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important. For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it. And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers . Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast. If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way. What You Will Do: Metering & Billing Build real-time usage metering and credit consumption for our agentic products, accurate down to the individual agent run Design pricing and rating logic that supports seats, usage, credits and enterprise contract terms without a rewrite for every new plan Integrate with billing, payment and finance systems (e.g. Stripe , CRM and ERP), and keep them reconciled Licensing & Onboarding Build the entitlements service that decides what every user and tenant can do, enforced consistently across the Excel add-in and Alwin Own the onboarding flow end-to-end: sign-up, trials, provisioning, SSO and SCIM, and the first-run experience Instrument activation and conversion, and work with Product and Design to remove friction Engineering & Collaboration Build systems where correctness is non-negotiable : idempotent, auditable, observable and secure Own it end-to-end , from design to production in our Python stack on Azure through to the web and add-in front ends. Anticipate issues, and shape the team's technical direction without waiting to be asked Influence across functions : partner with Product, Finance, Sales and Customer Success, using data and empathy to turn pricing, packaging and licensing decisions into robust implementation Raise the bar through code reviews, mentorship and clear, balanced feedback, and ask for the same in return What You Bring: Must-Have 6+ years in software engineering, with strong, production-grade backend experience (ideally Python ) Experience building billing, metering, licensing or entitlement systems in production Solid experience building data-driven web APIs and distributed systems on a major cloud platform A strong grasp of financial correctness : idempotency, consistency, reconciliation and audit trails Strong fundamentals in software architecture , system design and data modelling Product mindset: you care about activation, conversion and revenue as much as uptime Sound judgment under ambiguity: you balance speed and accuracy, stay calm when plans change, and reprioritise without being told Proficient with AI-assisted engineering (we use Claude Code) Excellent communication; you can work directly with Finance and commercial teams to define what "correct" means Nice-to-Have Usage- or credit-based billing in production, including AI token metering and cost attribution Billing and payment platforms (e.g. Stripe ), CRM (e.g. Salesforce ) and ERP integrations Identity and provisioning: SSO , SCIM , multi-tenant account models Product-led growth : self-serve sign-up, trials, in-product upgrades Revenue recognition, invoicing and tax basics Event streaming and high-volume data pipelines Scale-up experience, ideally in SaaS, fintech or audit tech What We Offer: Be part of one of the fastest-growing, profitable unicorn scale-ups in the Netherlands with a global impact Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights) to share the company's success and growth Pension plan with a 6% contribution on top of your base salary 28 vacation days per year (full-time) to support your work-life balance Hybrid work model with at least 3 days onsite in our dynamic Amsterdam office Daily, freshly prepared lunches by our in-house chef to keep you energized NS business card for easy commuting to the office if applicable Access to continuous learning and development initiatives to grow your skills Engage with a vibrant international team spread across five global offices Company-wide events like DataSnipper GO, where global teams come together Access to a mental health and wellness platform supporting your wellbeing Recruitment Process: Recruitment Screen (30 minutes, online) Hiring Manager Interview (30 minutes, online) Live coding Interview (75 minutes, online) System design interview (60 minutes, on-site) Final Interview (30 minutes, online) At DataSnipper, we believe great ideas come from different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds.
