title: Backend Engineer – Real-Time Video
description: About Stream Stream powers real-time Chat , Video , Activity Feeds , and AI Moderation for more than 1 billion end users across 4,000+ apps, from Strava and Bumble to eBay and Patreon. Our platform processes billions of API requests per month and supports applications with millions of concurrent users, while delivering highly reliable, low-latency services and a great developer experience. The role We're looking for a Staff Backend Engineer to join Stream on our mission of elevating the quality of apps for billions of users globally. You'll own the technical direction of Stream Video's media plane and the infrastructure it runs on. This is a full-time role, hybrid with 3 days a week in our Amsterdam office, or remote from anywhere in the EU. What you'll work on Stream Video runs on an SFU we built in Go on top of Pion, plus ingest and recording fleets, all on a global edge network we own across more than one cloud. Nobody at Stream has owned this media plane end to end before. Our central infrastructure team is tuned for request-based services, and video breaks in different ways: live sessions can't be dropped, bandwidth is the biggest cost, and placement is the main lever. That's why this is a Staff role. You'll set the direction for the video backend and its infrastructure with your own roadmap, reporting to our Director of Engineering with a direct line to our CTO. The Video SDK teams own the client side, and you'll work closely with them and with infrastructure. Part of the fleet is mid-move to Kubernetes. Job responsibilities: Architecture: write the architecture and roadmap for Stream Video's backend and media infrastructure, and decide what ships. Scale livestreaming: architect the SFU and media pipeline (WHIP, WHEP, RTMP, SRT, HLS, SVC), including the path from WebRTC to CDN-backed HLS for very large audiences. Own the fleet: reliability, autoscaling, placement, rollouts, observability and cost for long-lived sessions across clouds, with cost per gigabyte as a first-class metric. Gate production changes: define the validation that decides which changes, including AI-generated ones, reach live media, using behaviour tests on realistic networks, nightly telemetry scans and a public quality benchmark. Take the final escalation: handle the hardest quality, latency and production incidents, and work with enterprise customers on advanced integrations. Raise the bar: mentor senior engineers through design review, code review and hiring. About you You've owned systems where a dropped session or a bad rollout is visible to users within seconds, and you think about cost and reliability as much as features. You'd rather write the hard design doc than wait for one. A founder background is an asset here. The team is small, so you'll still write and review plenty of code. If you're looking for a large organisation with a platform team to hand problems to, or a management track, this role won't suit you. You have: Extensive backend engineering experience, including significant time owning architecture for high-scale production systems Expert proficiency in Go or an equivalent systems language (Rust, C++, Java) A track record owning real-time, stateful or latency-sensitive systems at very high scale Deep knowledge of distributed systems and networking: failure modes, placement, capacity planning and cost Strong experience with real-time media or streaming: WebRTC, SFU/MCU concepts, RTP/RTCP, DTLS, or RTMP, SRT and HLS Clear written communication: design docs and RFCs that others can act on Hands-on experience adopting AI coding and agent tools, and judgement on how to make them safe in production Bonus points: Built or operated an SFU, or contributed to Pion or another WebRTC stack Moved a stateful fleet to Kubernetes, or ran media workloads across more than one cloud Knowledge of bandwidth estimation, congestion control, simulcast, SVC and codecs (Opus, VP8/VP9, AV1) CockroachDB/PostgreSQL, RocksDB, Raft and Redis at scale Experience at developer tooling, API or SDK companies Founder or early-stage startup experience building real-time products Python or Rust alongside Go Conference talks, technical writing or notable open-source work in real-time media What makes this role exciting Scope: the infrastructure direction for video is yours to run as a product, with the authority to decide what ships. Impact: Video is Stream's most complex product, and many customers run it alongside Chat, Feeds and Moderation, so this work matters across the company. Stack: Go, Pion, WebRTC, WHIP/WHEP, RTMP, SRT, HLS, Protobuf, CockroachDB/Postgres, RocksDB, Raft and Redis, with Claude, Cursor and ChatGPT Codex in daily use. Starting point: a concrete first 90 days. Ship a validation gate on every infrastructure change that reaches production media, and move part of the fleet to Kubernetes with a cost-per-gigabyte number attached. Why join Stream? We're a Series B company with offices in Boulder, Amsterdam, Skopje and Toronto, and a team of 140+ people from 37 nationalities. We're backed by Felicis Ventures, GGV Capital, 01 Advisors, Techstars, and Arthur Ventures, with angels including Dick Costolo (ex-CEO of Twitter), Olivier Pomel (CEO of Datadog), Tom Preston-Werner (co-founder of GitHub), and Nicolas Dessaigne (co-founder of Algolia). We'll be straight with you: a startup is more demanding than a large company. There's no fixed playbook, you'll own things end to end, and you'll sometimes pick up work outside your title. That's also what makes it a fast place to grow. If you want real ownership and high scale more than structure and a set career ladder, you'll feel at home here. What we offer Company equity 28 days paid time off plus Dutch public holidays Pension plan with a company contribution NS Business Card or a company bike, covered Personal development budget of EUR 500 per year Catered lunches in the office MacBook Pro Up to EUR 60 a month toward a gym or sports club membership of your choice Highly skilled migrant (kennismigrant) visa sponsorship and relocation support if you're moving to Amsterdam This list applies to Netherlands-based employees and is adjusted to your location of residence. If you work remotely from another EU country, you'll be employed through our Employer of Record partner and get company equity plus local benefits depending on your country of employment. Our culture Stream is a casual, transparent team that aims high and supports each other. In engineering, we care about ownership and quality, and our goal is to ship stable software. Management stays hands-on, with less middle management and more time spent doing the work. If that sounds like the environment you want next, apply now. Stream is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on skills and experience, and we don't discriminate based on age, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, nationality, religion or belief, political opinion, disability or chronic illness, marital status, working hours, type of contract, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need an adjustment at any point in our hiring process, let us know. Hybrid office policy: applicants based (or relocating to) one of our office locations are expected to work according to the applicable local office attendance policy. title: Senior Data Engineer
description: About Orakl Oncology At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world’s largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine , helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions. Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology. The role We are looking for a curious engineering mind to lead the scaling of Orakl’s omics data within the Computational Biology team. Every organoid grown in our lab is sequenced (WGS and RNA-seq). Our pipelines turn the raw reads into processed molecular profiles, and our models turn those profiles into clinical trial predictions, patient segments and new target candidates. Your mission will be to make omics data available to computational biologists and research engineers in a form they can build on. You will gather their needs and, in coordination with the Data & Infra team, design the data representations, storage layouts and access patterns that make model training and experimentation fast and reproducible. As our biobank expands, this will become a massive omics corpus that must efficiently serve client contracts, strategic partnerships and internal R&D projects. Starting from processed omics data, you will assess how it is stored and served today, propose solutions to scale it, and drive their implementation, so our scientists and models can rely on it. You will build this hand in hand with our data engineering team, keeping our omics infrastructure consistent with the rest of the company’s stack. You will report to the Head of Computational Biology. Experience with omics data is a strong plus, not a prerequisite. If you come from the conventional tabular data world and want to master data that is massive, multi-layered and regularly reprocessed, this role is built for you. What you will do Design and build the omics data architecture. Together with our data engineering team, define and evolve how omics data is stored as the corpus grows: what lives in a database, what stays in columnar files on S3, and how it all fits the company’s stack. Guarantee reliable ingestion. Make sure every new batch of processed omics data (variant calls, expression, CNV, QC metrics, sample and sequencing tracking) lands reliably and consistently with our data model definition. Build and maintain the omics data model. Maintain a curated reference layer as the single source of truth, keep model-ready datasets derived from it separate, and track lineage between the two so every model input can be traced back to its source. Make the data easy to use. Build and evolve the access layer so scientists and models get what they need for client contracts, strategic partnerships and internal R&D, without writing joins or asking someone. What you bring Must-haves 4+ years as a data engineer, with ingestion pipelines you built running in production. Master’s in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering (or equivalent experience) Hands-on experience setting up and maintaining CI/CD for data pipelines and code libraries. Strong data modeling experience: you have designed schemas that handle evolving identifiers, versioning and lineage. Deep relational database expertise: schema design, partitioning, indexing, query plans, migrations on a live database. Deep cloud infrastructure skills: AWS (S3 and core services), infrastructure as code (Terraform or equivalent) and containers (Docker), with sound judgment on what belongs in a database and what stays in files. Strong experience in Python and SQL; comfortable with Git, CI and the command line. You can propose architecture choices, defend them and converge with engineering peers. A real drive to understand omics, including how our data is processed, so you can step in for our Senior Bioinformatician when they are away. Nice-to-haves Omics experience: you have loaded VCF/MAF files or expression matrices. Familiarity with Nextflow / nf-core pipelines. Columnar formats and engines (Parquet, Arrow, DuckDB) and an orchestrator (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect). Metabase or another BI layer on top of a relational database. LIMS or biobank sample-tracking integration. A tech-bio background, or prior work next to bioinformaticians. What we offer Mission: work in a cutting-edge environment, on the forefront of cancer research. Role: be the engineer behind the data backbone of a distinctive oncology discovery platform — designing, with our data engineering team, how one of the world’s rarest PDO multi-omics and functional datasets is stored, served and scaled, so that scientists and models can build on it every day. Impact: take ownership of a critical piece of an early-stage, fast-moving company, with the opportunity to shape it; your engineering decisions will carry through to our science and, ultimately, to patient outcomes. Team: join a collaborative, multidisciplinary team where you’ll work alongside stellar clinicians, biologists, and engineers towards a common mission. Interview Process Hiring Manager Call: Getting to know each other, aligning on expectations and context. Technical Deep Dive: A deep conversation on your experience with production data pipelines, data modeling, and scientific data processing. Technical Case: A system-design and problem-solving exercise representative of the real wet-lab data challenges you'll face at Orakl. Reference Call: A conversation with one or two people you've worked with closely. Founder Interview: A final discussion with our founders on vision, culture fit, and mutual ambitions. 👉 More about Orakl here and here Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Head of Solution Consulting R&D / Field CSO
description: We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era. When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. title: Senior ML Engineer
description: For this role, we will only consider candidates who are currently based in the Netherlands. About SkinVision Skin cancer is highly treatable when caught early, but limited access to specialist care and long wait times delay diagnosis, increasing the risk of late-stage cases and driving up treatment costs. SkinVision, founded in Amsterdam in 2012, exists to close that gap. Our proprietary AI — certified as a Class IIa medical device under EU regulation, with over 90% sensitivity and 89% specificity — has already helped over 3 million people worldwide. Today, SkinVision has a database of more than 6 million skin cancer images and can reach 20 million people through insurer partnerships. Where needed, cases are reviewed by a team of dermatologists, who support users in taking the right next step — from urgent care to a specialist referral. We are extending this further, connecting users faster to the specialist care they need. We're a focused, international team, active globally, united by one goal: making early detection accessible to everyone, everywhere. If you join us, you're not just building a product — you're helping close the gap between a person noticing something and getting the care they need. Senior Machine Learning Engineer at SkinVision We're on the lookout for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer based in our Amsterdam office with the right skills and experience to ensure the Machine Learning team releases models with exceptional performance making use of state-of-the-art techniques. Not only are ML models vital to our product and hence for our end users, e.g., enabling early detection of skin cancer, they also enable our internal team to perform optimally. The ideal candidate possesses strong expertise in training new and optimizing existing Machine Learning and computer vision models (Python), has hands-on experience in MLOps and deploying models to production (preferably in AWS) and is able to gather requirements and communicate results to the stakeholders directly involved in the model development and deployment. Moreover, in this senior role, it is vital that you can mentor other team members, own the technical processes and actively contribute to the ML roadmap. Knowledge of data orchestration tools (Apache Airflow), data modeling (dbt) and working in a regulated and/or medical environment are a plus! What you will do Drive the full ML model development lifecycle: from understanding and co-defining the problem to providing inputs on data collection, assessing the quality of data, model training, validation, deployment and monitoring. Create requirements for data collection for both new and existing models. This includes data for model training and testing. Develop and improve efficient ML training pipelines in the cloud (AWS or similar). Involve stakeholders appropriately during the entire development, deployment and monitoring lifecycle. Scale the ML environment and processes to multiple models being developed and deployed simultaneously. Ensure ML development aligns with medical device standards if applicable, including ML best practices, experiment tracking, traceability, data lineage and documentation. Support and mentor team members. Showcase ML models and capabilities both internally and externally, by giving presentations, workshops, training, etc. Stay abreast of the latest industry standards, best practices and emerging trends in Machine Learning and AI and share insights with the broader team. Your profile 8-10 years of proven professional experience as a Machine Learning Engineer or similar role, showcasing exceptional proficiency in model training, deployment within a consumer product, data analysis, stakeholder management and teamwork/mentoring. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Econometrics, Statistics, Computer Science or a related field. Skills Ability to translate user needs and requirements into technical requirements and a development plan. Hands-on expertise with modern deep learning architectures and other ML architectures, ideally but not restricted to image data. Hands-on experience with MLOps practices for scalable training, deployment and monitoring. Experience in developing and deploying ML models for a consumer product (mature development processes), ideally in the healthcare space or a regulated environment. Ability to iterate quickly from ideas to experiments, learning from results and making data-driven decisions. Strong analytical mindset, problem-solving skills and the ability to extract actionable insights from intricate datasets. Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the capacity to effectively convey technical concepts to diverse audiences. Proven ability to thrive in a collaborative, cross-functional team environment, managing multiple priorities and deadlines. Experience with mentoring and leading team members. title: Business Development Intern
description: Big changes start with people who want to achieve more. How do employees get to work? Why do company cars sit idle while parking spaces are scarce? And how can we make sustainable mobility the most attractive choice? At Urban Connect , we turn these challenges into practical solutions. We bring shared e-bikes and company cars, public transport, mobility budgets and digital parking management together on one platform. We help companies reduce costs, make better use of resources and give their employees greater freedom. Companies such as Roche, Google, SWISS and Lonza already rely on us. Our ambition goes further: we want to transform how companies manage mobility. To make that happen, we are looking for curious minds who take ownership and want to make a difference together. Your internship: accelerated learning, real responsibility Want to understand how a technology company grows—and help make it happen? During this six-month internship, you will work closely with our Sales and Account Management team, as well as Product and Operations. You will learn to understand customer needs, develop compelling solutions and turn data into tangible business opportunities. Your initiative matters. You will contribute your own ideas, take on increasing responsibility and see the impact of your work. How you will make a difference Turn data into opportunities: analyse usage and market data, including vehicle and parking utilisation, and translate your findings into recommendations for better corporate mobility solutions. Drive your own projects: Work with the team lead to take ownership of clearly defined projects, such as analysing products, assessing sales opportunities and developing corporate mobility concepts. Understand the product: learn how customers are set up on our platform, how bookings and billing work, and how vehicles and parking barriers are connected. Work smarter with AI: use AI tools thoughtfully, test new applications and help us improve research, analysis and everyday processes. Help drive growth: identify prospective customers, research their challenges and support the team in winning new business and expanding existing partnerships. Make a compelling case: create clear presentations, well-founded proposals and insightful quarterly reviews that demonstrate the value of our solutions. Keep things moving: maintain accurate customer data and activities in HubSpot, ensuring good conversations lead to clear next steps. Connect teams: resolve technical questions with the Product, Operations and Technology teams and communicate the answers clearly to customers and the Commercial team. What you bring An excellent degree, for example in business, economics, data science, engineering or industrial engineering. We are looking for excellence, curiosity, creativity and courage - not to have studied a perfect subject. Some practical experience through an internship, part-time job, personal project or entrepreneurial initiative. An analytical mindset, confidence with Excel and the ability to understand and communicate complex ideas and interdependencies clearly and simply. Ability to think outside of the box and to question conventional ways of doing things. Experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot - and the excellent judgement to critically assess their output. In fact, good judgment is a key criterion for success with us. An interest in technological progress, the curiosity to truly understand how things work, and the confidence to contribute your questions and ideas to a highly motivated team. Excellent German and good English skills. French is a big plus. Above all, we value your mindset: you learn quickly, ask thoughtful questions and think ahead. You take initiative, develop suggestions and seek support when you need it. You care about the details, strive to make good work even better and are willing to take a risk sometimes to try something new - even when that means making a mistake and learning from it. What you can expect High standards - and an environment of smart, kind people to challenge you to grow. We are ambitious, give direct, constructive feedback and support one another. Excellence shows up in our everyday work: in thoughtful solutions, careful execution and the drive to keep improving. A view of the whole business. You will work at the intersection of sales, customer success, technology and operations, learning how an idea becomes a solution that customers value. Direct access and room to take initiative. Good ideas get heard quickly here. Your responsibility grows with your capabilities and commitment. The opportunity to build a future with us. If we are a good fit for each other, there is an opportunity to join Urban Connect beyond the internship and grow with the company. You will also benefit from: Flexible working hours and a beautiful office in Zurich. A monthly mobility budget and access to our e-bikes and shared electric cars. A motivated team that enjoys working together (mostly in person), sharing knowledge, growing together, and celebrating success together! Ready to make a difference? Send us your CV and a few personal lines: Why Urban Connect? And what are you proud of having initiated, solved or improved yourself? We look forward to meeting you. Unternehmerischen Antrieb, Kreativität und den Mut, Neues auszuprobieren, auch wenn der Ausgang offen ist. Ein gutes Verständnis dafür, wie Softwareprojekte funktionieren, und Neugier für die Veränderungen durch KI. title: Account Executive, Strategic (Paris, France)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!</p></div><div class="section page-centered"> <p>We are looking for a Strategic Account Executive who will play a critical role driving sales and maximizing expansion opportunities with a defined list of top-tier Enterprise customers. You will be responsible for targeting, building and nurturing positive relationships with key C-level decision-makers, understanding complex business needs, and delivering innovative solutions across our product suite. This is an opportunity to accelerate your career, learn from leading sellers in the industry and build an incredible network of cross functional partners throughout Figma. This role is based in our Paris hub.</p> <h4><strong>What you'll do at Figma:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Manage a defined list of named strategic accounts to consistently meet or exceed quarterly and annual sales targets</li> <li>Apply effective discovery and value-selling techniques to build and strengthen C-level relationships for every account in your book</li> <li>Align with executives on business challenges and gain sponsorship for enterprise wide deployments for a suite of products, identifying where Figma’s roadmap and innovations fit in the long term</li> <li>Conduct thorough analysis to create strategic account plans that outline company priorities and initiatives, multi-threading at a senior level to build on expansion opportunities</li> <li>Co-create with cross-functional partners to expertly position Figma, drive deals forward and ensure customer success</li> <li>Leverage opportunities to advance executive level relationships through in-person meetings and networking opportunities</li> </ul> <h4><strong>We'd love to hear from you if you have:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Experience closing sales, over multiple years, for a software or SaaS business with the highest tier of Enterprise customers (5000+ FTEs), selling to executives</li> <li>Consistent performance meeting pipeline generation targets for net new business</li> <li>Demonstrated experience successfully managing complex sales cycles (9 months+)</li> <li>Proficiency in a sales methodology and process that creates value for customers</li> <li>Fluency in French and English.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Experience selling solutions to technical audiences at the highest level in Engineering, Product and Design teams</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to succeed in a changing environment</li> <li>Certified in deal qualification and prospect discovery</li> </ul> <div class="section page-centered"> <div> <div>At Figma, one of our values is Grow as you go. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.</div> </div> </div> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><p>At Figma we celebrate and support our differences. We know employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, our product and our community to flourish. Figma is an <a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/sites/default/files/2022-10/EEOC_KnowYourRights_screen_reader_10_20.pdf">equal opportunity workplace</a> - we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity/expression, veteran status<strong>, </strong>or any other characteristic protected by law. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. ⭐ Alan Precision: why this exists Your body knows before you do. The signals are there years before symptoms. And yet, in 2026, the system around us isn't catching them. 50% of non-communicable diseases (cardiovascular disease, type 2 diabetes, many cancers) are preventable with lifestyle changes, and we're not capturing them. Western countries have seen healthspan flatline for years, meaning we live longer, but not better. 46% of Europeans report mental health issues. The kind of deep, personalised health reading that could change this has been reserved for the few who could afford a 3,000€ check-up, and built for filing reports rather than changing lives. We don't accept that. Alan Precision is our bet on advanced prevention as the new norm of care. We combine biology, wearables, medical history, and lifestyle context, read it all as a connected system with AI supervised by physicians, and turn the result into a personalised protocol the member actually executes across sleep, nutrition, movement, stress, and supplementation. Then we retest, learn, and adapt. Health is a moving target. We move with it. Our ambition: make Alan Precision the reference for advanced prevention in Europe by 2030. ⭐ The Founding Growth opportunity Alan Precision is live, with fast week-over-week growth. Now we need to turn a new category into a habit: hundreds of thousands of customers in the coming years, and a measurable impact on their health. You will be the first growth and go-to-market person on the crew, accountable for two numbers: how many members subscribe to Precision, and how many stay, retest and renew. The crew was launched by the founding team of ARO, acquired by Alan in 2026, to move fast and apply their learnings from building a preventive health company. It is a unique playground. You get the means of one of France's biggest scale-ups (1M+ members reachable from day one, an ecosystem of products like Mo, Play and Clinic, and a brand carried by ambassadors like Kylian Mbappé) with the culture and pace of a fast-growing startup: small crew, short loops, everything still to invent. 🔭 Scope: Three go-to-market engines 1. Direct-to-member: turn Alan's 1M+ members into Precision subscribers. Offering paid services that members subscribe to by themselves inside Alan is a pretty new go-to-market for us, and you invent it. Build the CRM and lifecycle engine: segments, triggers, sequences, in-app moments. Use product data to decide who to push Precision to, when and where: which actions, traits or life moments make it relevant, and which do not. Position Precision inside the surfaces of other product crews (Mo, Play, Clinic, Shop), with their teams and push the right message at the right time. Own recurrence: activation after the first check-up, retests, renewals, reactivation. Acquisition without retention does not count. 2. B2B: get Alan's client companies to offer Precision to their employees. Almost everything is to define: business model, offer format, pricing logic, sales motion. Work with our B2B Marketing team to understand the constraints of our Sales and Account Management teams, give them the right pitch and materials, and set the right targets with them. Meet HR buyers yourself to learn what makes them pay. 3. Beyond Alan: take Precision to the open market. Once the internal engine runs: Apply the full B2C health and e-commerce playbook to acquire users that are not insured by Alan Your levers will be numerous, across paid acquisition, influence, partnerships, brand. Across all three: Create demand in a market that is still being created. Talk to members every week, define the value proposition and the messages that make people want advanced prevention, and push for the product changes that go with them. Build a brand people want, and explain it simply. Make advanced prevention desirable and easy to understand, with our Brand team, without overpromising. Say what can be said. Health communication is regulated: medical biology, health claims, influencer rules, use of health data for targeting. You work with our medical and legal teams and turn these constraints into sharper, more credible messages. Measure and decide. Funnels, cohorts, holdouts, channel performance. Pick the next bet, cut what does not work, share what we learned. Own it end to end. From the idea of a strategy to the campaign live in production: you design it, write it, build it, ship it and iterate on it yourself. Sharp copywriting is a core part of the job. ⭐ Is it you we're looking for? Fluent in French and English. You have grown a B2C product from its early days. Ideally as the first growth or go-to-market person, on a subscription in health, wellbeing or e-commerce. You can tell us which channels you picked, which ones you cut, and why. A creative Swiss army knife who prioritises. You can do a bit of everything and you find channels and angles nobody has thought of yet. You know the job is to pick the right one, execute it, measure it and move to the next. Lifecycle and CRM at scale. Customer.io , Braze or equivalent: segmentation, behavioural triggers, in-app moments. Analytical rigour. You read a funnel, build a cohort, set up a holdout and call a result. You measure success in subscribers, retention and revenue. Hands-on, and a great writer. You love taking an idea all the way to production yourself: the strategy, the copy, the campaign, the dashboard. You write well and fast, and you turn a complex medical topic into a clear, desirable promise. Customer-obsessed. You talk to members every week and you are just as comfortable in front of an HR director. Fluent with AI. You build with AI every day: assets, copy variants, segments, analyses and even building your own tools. You use it to go faster, and you keep your judgment on what ships. Driven by health, and rigorous about it. Health matters to you, and when something blocks, you find a way. You make people want to act with messages that hold up in front of a physician. Nice to haves Experience with regulated health communication (claims, health data, medical services). B2B2C, employee benefits or HR tech. Paid acquisition and influencer marketing in B2C. Pricing and packaging of subscription offers. You own your own health: Whoop, Oura, blood tests, supplements are no secret for you. 🌍 How we work Location: Paris Remote work: We offer remote work flexibility, but we value in-person collaboration. 🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles. description: Who We Are You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today. As stakeholder expectations and regulations evolve, we’re building the future of sustainability intelligence. We’re looking for someone passionate about the intersection of tech and sustainability, who’s eager to simplify systems and data by developing digital-first tools. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast-paced, global teams and wants to shape the next generation of ESG reporting. What you bring Strong interest in sustainability, ESG reporting, and emerging regulations (e.g., CSRD, ESRS, ISSB). Experience in application or through studies is a plus. Passion for technology and AI, with experience or interest in process automation, data integration, or reporting systems. Comfortable with systems such as G-suite, Microsoft Office, etc. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to distill complexity into clarity. Strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and present ideas to technical and non-technical stakeholders. A self-starter mindset: proactive, adaptable, and comfortable navigating ambiguity. Fluent in English; additional languages are a bonus. Bachelor’s degree or higher. Why Prosus? title: Lead Backend Engineer, Service Standards
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Brief info about Vinted </strong></h2> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1"><span data-sheets-root="1">Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. <br>The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:<br><br><strong><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/marketplace" target="_blank">Vinted Marketplace</a></strong> is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedgo" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Go</strong></a> enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedpay" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Pay</strong></a> is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.<br><br>Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. </span></p></div><h2><strong>Information about the position </strong></h2> <p>As a <strong>Lead Backend Engineer </strong>in the <strong>Service Standards</strong> team, you will shape how services are built, deployed, and operated across all of Vinted. You will work closely with a team on the development of our core service framework—providing engineering teams with golden paths, robust service contracts, standardized tooling, and performance benchmarks to ensure high reliability and developer velocity at scale.</p> <p><br>You will sit in the Service Standards team, part of the Service Ecosystem domain, reporting to the Engineering Manager of that team.</p> <p><br>The Service Standards team is responsible for standardizing service startup, consumer APIs, and foundational backend frameworks across Vinted's engineering landscape. Within it, this is a senior individual-contributor role combining technical leadership with high autonomy—you will define architectural directions, establish best practices, and guide engineers across domains without requiring full management overhead.</p> <p><br>You will collaborate closely with platform, observability, and product engineering teams to ensure our service framework and standards seamlessly integrate into daily workflows. Your work will directly impact developer experience, platform reliability, and system performance as Vinted continues to scale.</p> <h2><strong>In this position, you’ll </strong></h2> <ul> <li>Lead the technical direction and design around service standards and golden paths.</li> <li>Define and evolve company-wide service standards, including consumer APIs, service contracts, startup routines, and performance guidelines.</li> <li>Build reusable backend libraries, tools, and scaffolding to streamline new service creation and maintenance.</li> <li>Partner with backend engineers across domains to drive adoption of framework updates and gather continuous feedback.</li> <li>Evaluate pragmatic trade-offs between architectural consistency, delivery speed, and technical debt across the platform.</li> <li>Collaborate with Observability and Infrastructure teams to integrate telemetry, SLOs, and resilience practices into standard service templates.</li> <li>Ensure security, privacy, and compliance guidelines are embedded directly into service contracts and framework templates.</li> <li>Mentor senior backend engineers, participate in architectural design reviews, and foster high engineering standards across teams.</li> <li>Drive architectural proposals (RFCs/ADRs) for platform-wide backend standardization.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About you </strong></h2> <ul> <li>Have deep backend engineering experience and strong architectural intuition, with proven success building scalable services and frameworks.</li> <li>Demonstrate a track record of driving cross-team technical alignment and leading complex initiatives across multiple engineering groups.</li> <li>Possess expert knowledge in designing API contracts, service startup patterns, and performance optimization.</li> <li>Understand trade-offs in platform design and know how to build golden paths that engineers love to use.</li> <li>Communicate technical vision and architectural choices clearly to both technical leads and engineering leadership.</li> <li>Enjoy mentoring engineers, conducting design reviews, and sharing best practices to level up the backend engineering community.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Work perks  </strong></h2> <ul> <li>The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme</li> <li>25 days of paid annual leave</li> <li>Newest MacBook models</li> <li>Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family</li> <li>Frequent team-building events</li> <li>Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture</li> <li>Lunch benefit per working day</li> <li>A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted</li> <li>Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan</li> <li>NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport</li> <li>Company bike leasing scheme</li> <li>Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform</li> <li>Work from Home allowance </li> <li>A dog-friendly office</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Working at Vinted </strong></h2> <p><strong>Workation policy</strong></p> <p>Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.</p> <p><strong>Individual learning budget</strong></p> <p>Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.</p> <p><strong>Hybrid work</strong></p> <p>Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.</p> <p><strong>Equal opportunity</strong></p> <p>We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">The annual gross salary range for this position excluding 8% holiday pay is:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€93.500</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€126.500 EUR</span></div></div></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>Our Purpose<strong><br></strong></h3> <p>At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. working knowledge of SentinelOne’s full product capabilities.</li> <li>Assist in recruiting, hiring, and onboarding top commercial sales talent, and invest deeply in the growth and long-term success of each team member through mentoring, career development, and a genuine commitment to both individual and collective goal attainment.</li> </ul> <h3>What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?</h3> As a Senior Scrum Master, you'll work closely with Market Product Managers, engineers, Tech Writers and leadership teams to support the delivery of mission-critical software used by defence organisations worldwide. title: Senior Consultant (Account Director) - B2B Technology
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>Who we are:</strong></h3> <p>Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.</p> <p>WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit <a href="WPP.com">WPP.com</a> </p> <p>For more information visit <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/">bursonglobal.com</a> and follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/burson/posts/?feedView=all">LinkedIn</a> and <a href="https://www.instagram.com/burson.global/?hl=en">Instagram</a>.</p></div><p><strong>More about the role:</strong></p> <p>As a Senior Consultant (Account Director) in the Burson Tech PR team you will be heading up business technology accounts for some of the biggest businesses in this space. You’ll be someone who thrives in fast paced environments and experienced in working with globally recognised businesses who lead their fields and expect their communications to as well.  </p> <p>We treat our Senior Consultants as both client and business leaders, expecting strong client counsel, energetic and committed team leadership, ambition to create award-winning work, and a consistent problem solver</strong>: Apply strong analytical and problem-solving skills, confidently challenging senior members and/or clients in pursuit of strategic integrity.</li> <li><strong>Team Knowledge:</strong> You’ll have a nose for news and know how to develop excellent and insightful media strategies.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Experience that contributes to success:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong> </strong>Established B2B Tech Senior Manager or Account Director experience, with broad expertise across areas such as Enterprise Tech, Cyber Tech or Fintech preferred.</li> <li>A strong understanding of how to build and deliver effective media strategies for the new media era.</li> <li>Demonstrated knowledge of media tech and enterprise technology with a 'nose for news'.</li> <li>A robust network of relevant media contacts.</li> <li>Proven ability to manage fast-paced, ambitious clients and dynamic portfolios, providing exceptional client counsel.</li> <li>Energetic and committed team leadership experience, capable of inspiring and motivating teams.</li> <li>High levels of Intelligence, Initiative, and Integrity, with an ambition to create award-winning work.</li> class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>You belong at Burson:</strong></h3> <p>Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging title: Director, EMEA Ocean Operations
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Flexport: </strong></h2> <p>At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. </p> <p>The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.</p></div><h3><strong>About the role:</strong> </h3> <p>Your responsibilities as a <strong>Director, EMEA Ocean Operations</strong> include, but are not limited to the following:</p> <ul> <li>Lead and develop a leadership team of Senior Managers and Managers, who in turn run Ocean Operations teams across EMEA. You are accountable for organisation design, hiring plans and succession planning at every level beneath you. You build a culture of high performance and psychological safety, and you make sure the organisation scales with the business rather than just adding people.</li> <li>Own end-to-end EMEA ocean gateway operations (FCL and LCL) across all markets, both insourced and partner-operated countries. You set one operating standard for how work is done, and you decide where it makes sense for local markets to differ.</li> <li>Define and deliver the multi-year EMEA ocean strategy and the planning cycles that support it (biannual planning and quarterly check-ins). You separate what the core operation needs to keep running well from what is expansion, and you turn that into clear choices on investment, team size and priorities, aligned with EMEA operations goals.</li> <li>Build and drive the EMEA ocean automation roadmap with your teams. You decide where to remove manual work first, so that volume growth does not need proportional growth in manual work, and you work with Product, Engineering and Operational Excellence to deliver it.</li> <li>Act as the senior operations voice to EMEA Operational Excellence, Global Product and Engineering. You turn operational pain points across EMEA into clear product priorities, and you help decide what gets built.</li> <li>Report to the EMEA Head of Operations and serve as a member of the EMEA Senior Leadership Team. You help set the direction for EMEA as a whole, not just for your own area.</li> <li>Partner with EMEA commercial leadership (GMs) and global operations leaders in other regions. You make sure commercial promises and operational reality match, you flag deal and delivery risk early, and you share what works across regions.</li> <li>Hold executive-level relationships with key clients, carriers and partner operators. You lead major escalations, negotiate service commitments with partners, and represent EMEA operations in client business reviews.</li> <li>Use data to find the biggest bottlenecks and root causes across markets, not just fix individual cases. You set the metrics the organisation runs on and make sure leaders at every level are held to them in regular reviews (weekly, monthly and quarterly business reviews).</li> <li>Own the long-term capacity plan. You work with Operations Excellence and Finance on staffing models that cope with seasonal peaks and multi-year growth, including the balance between insourced teams and partners.</li> <li>Own the P&L and operational health of EMEA ocean gateway operations. You set the financial discipline for your area, stop revenue and cost leakage at scale (for example, billing accessorials), and make sure your leaders do the same in their teams.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Prerequisites:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>BA/BS degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management or equivalent experience</li> <li>Proven track record of measurable business results, including quantified impact on quality, productivity, efficiency and customer service</li> <li>10+ years of experience in cross-border supply chains, logistics and/or freight forwarding, with ocean freight experience</li> <li>5+ years of people management experience, including managing managers</li> <li>3+ years in customer-facing roles, with experience managing senior client or partner relationships</li> <li>Experience running operations across several countries</li> <li>Technology (and AI) first mindset, comfortable in a fast-paced environment</li> <li>Excellent English; ideally other European languages</li> <li>Excellent technical skills (e.g. Claude, N8N, Looker, Excel)</li> <li>Owner's mindset and strong discipline across the whole organisation</li> <li>Customer obsession, with high standards as a point of pride</li> <li>An operator at heart who removes waste and redesigns processes for lean, scalable efficiency</li> <li>Dives into metrics to fix root causes while delivering the short-term wins that stabilise operations</li> <li>Builds trust through transparent, concise communication and encourages the team to challenge the status quo</li> </ul> <p><strong>What's in it for you:</strong></p> <ul> <li>An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, where you’ll have the chance to create a global impact while being a part of a  thriving multinational environment </li> <li>Daily catered lunches incl. vegetarian options, breakfast, snacks and soft drinks available in our office on daily basis </li> <li>Commute expenses: Flexport will cover  home-office commuting costs for employees living outside of Amsterdam</li> <li>Amazing office in the heart of Amsterdam. </li> <li>25 working days as vacation days based on full time employment.</li> <li>Health insurance: Flexport offers a collective health insurance plan including a basic package and any available additional packages. Your monthly premium is fully paid by Flexport. </li> <li>A defined pension contribution scheme</li> <li>Equity program: every team member becomes a shareholder, aligning our success with yours. As a private company in a multi-trillion dollar industry, you have a direct stake in our collective growth and success.</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program through Aetna Resources for Living: Flexport provides an employer-sponsored program at no cost to you and your household members</li> <li>Parental leave benefit: Flexport is here to support you and your families in one of the most important times in life – the birth of a child! Our parental leave program allows both mothers and partners to take time off from work for pregnancy, childbirth, and to bond with your new child. <br><br> <p>#LI-onsite</p> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">#LI-AS1</span></p> </li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><div id="1704749847.557549" class="c-virtual_list__item" data-qa="virtual-list-item" data-item-key="1704749847.557549"> <div class="c-message_kit__background p-message_pane_message__message c-message_kit__message" data-qa="message_container" data-qa-unprocessed="false" data-qa-placeholder="false"> <div class="c-message_kit__hover" data-qa-hover="true"> <div class="c-message_kit__actions c-message_kit__actions--default"> <div class="c-message_kit__gutter"> <div class="c-message_kit__gutter__right" data-qa="message_content"> <div class="c-message_kit__blocks c-message_kit__blocks--rich_text"> <div class="c-message__message_blocks c-message__message_blocks--rich_text" data-qa="message-text"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer" data-qa="block-kit-renderer"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper--first"> <div class="p-rich_text_block"> <h4>Commitment to Equal Opportunity</h4> <p>At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. title: Stage Chef.fe de projet migration applicative en santé
description: Dans le cadre de la migration de notre application desktop, nous recherchons un.e stagiaire pour piloter le suivi de l’adoption et accompagner nos clients tout au long de leur transition vers la nouvelle solution. L’objectif sera de permettre au plus grand nombre de clients de migrer dans les meilleures conditions avant le transfert progressif du suivi à notre équipe Support, à l’issue du stage. Ce stage combine gestion de projet, communication client, accompagnement au changement, analyse de données et compréhension des environnements informatiques hospitaliers. Tes missions Piloter la communication autour de la migration Tu construiras et déploieras un plan de communication adapté aux différentes étapes de la migration : Identification des clients à contacter et segmentation des populations ; Préparation des messages de premier contact ; Organisation des relances et suivi des réponses ; Adaptation des communications selon le niveau d’avancement des clients ; Gestion des objections, questions et éventuels points de blocage ; Formalisation des bonnes pratiques et des argumentaires. Prioriser les migrations Tu contribueras à définir une stratégie de priorisation des clients en fonction de différents critères : Taille et typologie des établissements ; Niveau de maturité ou de préparation technique ; Contraintes liées à l’environnement informatique ; Niveau d’engagement et de réponse des interlocuteurs ; Risques identifiés et complexité de l’accompagnement nécessaire. L’objectif sera de concentrer les efforts sur les clients présentant le meilleur potentiel de progression ou nécessitant un accompagnement spécifique. Mettre en place un tableau de suivi et des outils de reporting Tu concevras et maintiendras un tableau de bord permettant de suivre l’avancement global de la migration, notamment : Nombre de clients contactés ; Taux de réponse et de relance ; Clients migrés, en cours de migration ou non encore engagés ; Principales raisons de blocage ; Actions réalisées et prochaines étapes ; Indicateurs d’adoption et d’utilisation. Tu t’appuieras notamment sur Mixpanel et sur les outils internes disponibles afin de fiabiliser le suivi et de produire des reportings réguliers à destination des équipes concernées. Accompagner les clients Selon les besoins identifiés, tu pourras également participer directement à l’accompagnement des clients : Réponse aux questions liées à la migration ; Coordination avec les équipes techniques et Support ; Aide à la préparation des étapes de migration ; Suivi des situations nécessitant un accompagnement personnalisé ; Remontée des irritants et des besoins récurrents ; Contribution à l’amélioration continue du parcours de migration. Préparer le transfert à l’équipe Support Une partie importante du stage consistera à préparer la reprise du suivi par l’équipe Support : Documentation du processus de migration ; Centralisation de l’historique et du statut de chaque client ; Formalisation des procédures et réponses types ; Identification des cas particuliers et des risques résiduels ; Transmission des outils, méthodes et indicateurs de pilotage. Profil recherché Tu es étudiant.e en école d’ingénieur ou en formation supérieure spécialisée en informatique, systèmes et réseaux, gestion de projet ou domaine équivalent. Tu disposes idéalement de connaissances en : Administration système et réseau ; Environnements informatiques d’entreprise ; Analyse et suivi de données ; Gestion de projet ou conduite du changement ; Outils de reporting et d’analyse produit, notamment Mixpanel. Je helpt bijvoorbeeld bij de planning, coördineert vertrekkende boten en begeleidt gasten bij het instappen. Zo zorg je er samen met je collega's voor dat alles goed verloopt en gasten een fijne ervaring hebben. Je stage is afwisselend, met een combinatie van organiseren en praktisch aanpakken. Wat ga je leren? Helpen bij de voorbereiding en uitvoering van het Amsterdam Light Festival; Ondersteunen bij de planning, roosters en administratie; Gasten ontvangen, instappen begeleiden en wachtrijen op de kade coördineren; Contact onderhouden met planners, duty managers, hosts, schippers en havenpartners; Checklists en registraties bijhouden en operationele gegevens verwerken; Meewerken aan projecten en verbeteringen binnen Operations. Praktisch Startdatum: zo snel mogelijk; Duur: 3 tot 6 maanden; Type stage: meewerkstage; Werktijden: Een combinatie van kantoortijden en operationele diensten. Beschikbaarheid in avonden en weekenden is vereist; Stagevergoeding: € 500 per maand; Locatie: kantoor in hartje Amsterdam en de kade. Wat we aanbieden Een afwisselende meewerkstage waarin je zowel organisatorische als praktische ervaring opdoet; De kans om mee te werken aan de vaarten van het Amsterdam Light Festival en een uniek kijkje achter de schermen te krijgen bij een van de grootste rondvaartoperaties van Amsterdam; Een centraal gelegen kantoor op ca. 15 minuten lopen van Amsterdam Centraal; Legendarische vrijdagmiddagborrels, sportieve uitjes en bedrijfsfeesten; Een heerlijke verzorgde lunch op kantoor; 25% personeelskorting op rondvaarten en andere activiteiten binnen Flagship Holding. Functievereisten Een mbo-, hbo- of wo-opleiding in operations, events, hospitality, toerisme of bedrijfskunde; Een betrouwbare, praktische en gastgerichte instelling; Het vermogen om rustig te blijven bij drukte en flexibel omgaan met wisselende taken; Goede beheersing van het Engels, kennis van het Nederlands is een pre; Beschikbaar tijdens het Amsterdam Light Festival (ALF), ook in de avonden en weekenden; Kennis van Excel is een plus. Over Flagship Amsterdam Flagship Amsterdam is een snelgroeiende rederij in het hart van Amsterdam. Wat in 2017 begon met drie boten, is inmiddels uitgegroeid tot een vloot van meer dan 70 boten, en we groeien nog steeds elke dag verder! Jaarlijks verwelkomen we gasten uit meer dan 55 verschillende landen, en we varen het hele jaar door. Dit doen we met een gedreven en ambitieus team van meer dan 800 (seizoensgebonden) medewerkers. Maar Flagship is meer dan alleen rondvaarten. Vanuit dezelfde energie bouwen we aan verschillende concepten die allemaal draaien om beleving, gastvrijheid en de stad Amsterdam. Zo ontdek je de stad op de fiets met Flagship Bike Tours, proef je de sfeer bij Flagship Waffle Experience Amsterdam, en werken we bij Shipyard aan creatieve projecten op en rond het water. Daarnaast hebben we labels zoals Voyage Amsterdam, Captain Jack en Aemstelland, elk met hun eigen stijl en doelgroep. Samen vormen ze één organisatie, maar met verschillende manieren om mensen de stad te laten ervaren. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior contractmanager (domein IT)
description: Wil jij ervoor zorgen dat belangrijke contracten niet alleen goed zijn afgesloten, maar gedurende de hele looptijd ook daadwerkelijk waarde leveren? En krijg jij energie van leveranciers uitdagen, risico’s beheersen en samen met de business sturen op prestaties en verbetering? Kies dan voor Univé! Wie zijn wij? Het mooie van Univé? Dat zijn de mensen, de resultaten, de geschiedenis, de cultuur, het ontstaan en de betrokkenheid. Dat is samenwerken. Een coöperatie zijn zonder winstoogmerk. Dicht bij onze leden staan. En samen bouwen aan een organisatie die betrouwbaar, toekomstbestendig en wendbaar is. Wij richten ons op het voorkomen van risico’s, het beperken van gevolgen en we verzekeren alleen als het echt nodig is. Coöperatie Univé bestaat uit zeven verschillende Regionale Univé’s, zodat we op landelijk én lokaal niveau altijd dichtbij onze leden zijn. Dat is het mooie van Univé. Waar kom je te werken? Je komt te werken binnen de afdeling Inkoop & Facilitaire Zaken, in het team Inkoop & Contractmanagement. Dit team voert binnen Univé de regie op inkoop-, contract- en leveranciersmanagement. Ons doel? Grip op uitgaven en risico’s, professionele en efficiënte processen én optimale ondersteuning van de business. We zijn volop in ontwikkeling. Inkoop & Contractmanagement groeit verder naar een professionele, businessgerichte en datagedreven regiepartner. Dat betekent dat we niet alleen kijken naar wat er contractueel is afgesproken, maar vooral ook naar de waarde die contracten en leveranciers gedurende de looptijd daadwerkelijk voor Univé realiseren. Als contractmanager speel jij daarin een belangrijke rol. Je werkt intensief samen met contracteigenaren, management, inkopers, Risk, Compliance en Juridische Zaken. En natuurlijk met onze leveranciers. Jouw uitdaging Als contractmanager ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het realiseren en bewaken van contractwaarde gedurende de volledige looptijd van onze contracten. Je voert regie op het contract- en leveranciersmanagement van de aan jou toegewezen contracten en leveranciers. Daarbij stuur je op naleving van afspraken, kosten, kwaliteit, risico’s, performance, compliance en duurzaamheid. Je zorgt ervoor dat Univé grip houdt op de ingekochte dienstverlening en dat afspraken niet alleen op papier goed geregeld zijn, maar in de praktijk ook worden nagekomen. Daarbij ben je een stevige gesprekspartner voor zowel de business als leveranciers. Je organiseert en leidt leveranciersoverleggen, maakt prestaties en risico’s inzichtelijk en zorgt dat acties daadwerkelijk worden opgevolgd. Zie je afwijkingen, kansen of risico’s? Dan wacht je niet af, maar kom je in actie. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: regie voeren op complexe, risicovolle en/of strategische contracten; sturen op contractnaleving, kosten, kwaliteit, performance, risico’s, compliance en duurzaamheid; organiseren en leiden van leveranciersoverleggen; bewaken van SLA’s, KPI’s, afspraken en verbetermaatregelen; begeleiden van wijzigingen, indexaties, evaluaties, verlengingen en beëindigingen; signaleren en beheersen van contractuele, leveranciers- en continuïteitsrisico’s; initiëren en begeleiden van verbeterplannen, disputen en escalaties; ondersteunen van contracteigenaren en management bij besluitvorming over contracten en leveranciers; opstellen van analyses en managementrapportages over contractstatus, prestaties, risico’s, acties en besluitpunten; tijdig signaleren wanneer hercontractering of een nieuwe marktbenadering nodig is; bijdragen aan de verdere professionalisering van contract- en leveranciersmanagement binnen Univé. De inhoudelijke beoordeling van de dienstverlening ligt primair bij de business en contracteigenaar. Jij zorgt ervoor dat deze prestaties periodiek worden beoordeeld en voert regie op de contractuele borging, opvolging en eventuele escalatie. Je kijkt daarbij verder dan één overleg of één contractmoment. Wie ben jij? Je bent een contractmanager die regie pakt. Je brengt structuur, houdt overzicht en weet wanneer je moet verbinden, adviseren, onderhandelen of juist escaleren. Je voelt je comfortabel in een omgeving waarin verschillende belangen samenkomen. Je kunt schakelen tussen de dagelijkse praktijk en tactisch-strategische vraagstukken en bent een stevige gesprekspartner voor contracteigenaren, management en leveranciers. Je bent analytisch en risicobewust, maar vooral ook gericht op resultaat. Een contract is voor jou geen statisch document: je gebruikt het als instrument om prestaties te verbeteren, risico’s te beheersen en waarde voor Univé te realiseren. Je bouwt aan professionele leveranciersrelaties waarin transparantie, voorspelbaarheid, continue verbetering en wederzijdse aanspreekbaarheid centraal staan. Je durft leveranciers uit te dagen en weet tegelijkertijd hoe je een constructieve langetermijnrelatie onderhoudt. Verder breng je mee: HBO/HBO+ werk- en denkniveau, bijvoorbeeld in bedrijfskunde, rechten, economie of een vergelijkbare richting; minimaal 5 jaar relevante ervaring binnen contractmanagement, bij voorkeur domein IT; aantoonbare ervaring met complexe, risicovolle en/of strategische contracten en leveranciers, binnen het domein IT; kennis van contract lifecycle management, leveranciersrelatiemanagement, prestatiesturing en contractgovernance; ervaring met leveranciersoverleggen, prestatiebeoordelingen, contractevaluaties en escalatiemanagement; kennis van risicomanagement, compliance-eisen en interne beheersing; kennis van relevante wet- en regelgeving en uitbestedingskaders; bij voorkeur een aanvullende opleiding op het gebied van contractmanagement, zoals CATS, NEVI 2 of vergelijkbaar. Daarnaast herkennen we in jou initiatief, regievoering, risicobewustzijn en resultaatgerichtheid. Je bent communicatief sterk, kwaliteitsgericht en analytisch, kunt goed samenwerken en beschikt over overtuigingskracht en onderhandelingsvaardigheden op tactisch-strategisch niveau. Wat bieden wij? We vragen veel van je, maar daar geven we je ook graag veel voor terug: een salaris passend bij jouw kennis, opleiding en ervaring op basis van een 38-urige werkweek, inclusief vakantiegeld en een dertiende maand; een collectieve prestatiebeloning; een arbeidsvoorwaardenkeuzesysteem: tijd voor geld of geld voor tijd; 26 vakantiedagen bij een 38-urige werkweek; een studiekostenregeling en volop ruimte om jezelf professioneel verder te ontwikkelen; een goede pensioenvoorziening; hybride werken: thuiswerken is bij ons heel normaal en je hebt de vrijheid om samen met je team je ideale werkplek te bepalen; een reiskostenvergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer en een thuiswerkvergoeding op de dagen dat je vanuit huis werkt; een laptop en telefoon; korting op schade- en zorgverzekeringen. Maar minstens zo belangrijk: je krijgt bij ons ruimte om impact te maken. Contract- en leveranciersmanagement is binnen Univé volop in ontwikkeling. Je krijgt daarmee de mogelijkheid om niet alleen contracten professioneel te managen, maar ook actief bij te dragen aan hoe we ons vakgebied verder vormgeven. Enthousiast? Wil jij samen met ons bouwen aan professioneel contract- en leveranciersmanagement binnen Univé? Solliciteer dan via de sollicitatiebutton. Je kunt tot en met 30 november 2026 reageren. title: Senior Projectmanager
description: Jouw Missie bij CCS Geen dag is hetzelfde in deze rol. Samen met je collega’s zorg je ervoor dat wij succesvol onze softwareoplossingen bij klanten implementeren en dat onze klanten een excellente dienstverlening krijgen! Voor deze complexe systeemimplementaties en integratieprojecten zoeken we een zeer ervaren projectmanager. Je leert de verzekeringsbranche kennen en klanten helpen. Dat doe je niet alleen: je werkt samen met enthousiaste collega’s in een projectteam. Voordelen voor de sollicitant Als projectmanager krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid, help je klanten en samen met je projectteam zet je mooie resultaten neer. Je kunt deels thuiswerken, deels op ons kantoor in Woerden en bij verschillende klanten in Nederland. Tijdelijk werken vanuit het buitenland kan ook dankzij onze workation-regeling (maximaal 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar). Bij ons draait het om klantgericht werken én werkplezier. Daarom is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Denk aan een levend tafelvoetbaltoernooi, pubquiz en een bier- & wijnproeverij. Ons actieve Fun-team zorgt elke maand weer voor iets leuks. En als je reislust nog niet is gestild met 25 vakantiedagen en een workation, dan kun je zelfs tot 20 extra verlofdagen bijkopen. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch? Een voorbeeld van je werkdag Opstarten: Aan het begin van je werkdag heb je een dagstart met zowel collega’s als projectteamleden van de klant. Hierin bespreken jullie de voortgang, resultaten en eventuele hulpvragen. Na de dagstart: Allereerst neem je nog wat tijd met een van de consultants naar aanleiding van de dagstart. Je coacht en begeleidt de consultant en helpt deze met een hulpvraag. Vervolgens ga je aan de slag met het opstellen van de voortgangsrapportage. Hiermee zorg je voor proactieve en transparante rapportage over het project aan de klant. De stuurgroep met de klant is volgende week, vandaag spreek je samen met de delivery manager deze stuurgroep voor. Wat zijn de belangrijkste punten voor de klant en voor CCS en hoe vliegen we die aan. Na de lunch: Je checkt nog een paar tickets qua voortgang op het planboard, waarbij je de samenhang met de planning checkt. Vervolgens ga je naar de werksessie met het CCS projectmanagement guild. Hier werken jullie aan tickets om de CCS Prince2Agile projectmethodiek verder te verbeteren. Hierna heb je nog een afspraak met je collega van sales voor afstemming over een mogelijk vervolgproject bij de klant. Wie jij bent De ideale kandidaat beschikt over daadkracht, doorzettingsvermogen, enthousiasme en drive om projecten succesvol te leiden en verbeteringen door te voeren om te komen tot nog efficiëntere en klantgerichte projecten. Jij herkent jezelf in de volgende punten: · Je wordt blij van projectmanagement en blijft kalm bij verschuivende prioriteiten; · Je hebt bewezen ervaring met het succesvol uitvoeren van productsoftware-implementaties in een complexe, maar klantgerichte omgeving, binnen budget, planning en scope; · Je hebt ruime ervaring met diverse projectmanagement en delivery methodieken, bij voorkeur een Prince2-, Ipma of PMI of Agile / scrum certificaat; · Je vindt, net als wij, klanttevredenheid het uitgangspunt. Daarbij ben je in staat om de klantverwachtingen helder te analyseren, te managen en actief bij te sturen waar nodig; · Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift; · Jouw persoonlijkheid kenmerkt zich door: gestructureerd, motiverend, communicatief sterk, duidelijk, open, tikje eigenwijs, enthousiast, relativerend, creatief en pragmatisch; · Je haalt energie uit het opstellen en bewaken van planningen, analyseren van gegevens en opstellen van duidelijke, gestructureerde rapportages en presentaties; · Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde bachelor, bij voorkeur richting bedrijfskunde, bedrijfseconomie en/of informatica. Wat bieden wij jou? Naast de genoemde leuke functie binnen een groeiend en innovatief bedrijf bieden wij: · Salaris : We bieden je een salaris tussen € 5.590 en € 7.958 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van je ervaring en kennis; · Middelen : Leaseauto, laptop, telefoon; · Werkdagen : Je bent minimaal 4 dagen per week beschikbaar, al heeft 5 dagen onze voorkeur; · Vergoeding voor thuiswerken : Je kunt gedeeltelijk thuiswerken en krijgt een onkostenvergoeding van € 2,40 per thuiswerkdag. Ook krijg je een budget van € 750,- om thuis een ergonomische werkplek in te richten; · Workation : Je kunt tot 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar vanuit het buitenland werken; · Leuke teamactiviteiten : Leer je collega’s beter kennen door deel te nemen aan maandelijkse evenementen georganiseerd door ons energieke Fun-team, zoals een pubquiz, Zomer BBQ, wine & beer tastings en movie night; · Vakantiedagen : Je krijgt 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om maximaal 20 extra dagen bij te kopen; · Groei en ontwikkelin g: De mogelijkheid om je vaardigheden en verantwoordelijkheden te ontwikkelen binnen de functie, middels opleidingen en Linkedin learning, of door te stromen naar een van de andere functies binnen CCS; · Vakantiegeld : Jaarlijks 8,33%; · Voordelen : Je krijgt een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling met een lage eigen bijdrage en kunt gebruikmaken van collectieve verzekeringen met korting. Ook is er een bedrijfsfitnessregeling voor een gezonde levensstijl en een fietsregeling voor duurzaam vervoer. Waarom CCS? Omdat wij geloven dat werk meer is dan een baan. Het is een plek waar je jezelf kunt zijn, impact kunt maken en kunt groeien. Het is een omgeving waar je wordt geïnspireerd om het beste uit jezelf te halen en samen te werken aan een duurzame toekomst. Kom bij ons en ontdek wat er mogelijk is als je een carrière bouwt vol passie, plezier en betekenis. Jij bent de ontbrekende schakel in ons team. Word onderdeel van ons verhaal. 🚀 Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Interim Chief Privacy Officer | RVO
description: Omschrijving Wij zijn voor de Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland (RVO) op zoek naar een ervaren Interim Chief Privacy Officer (CPO) . Binnen de afdeling CIP speel je een sleutelrol in het verder ontwikkelen en professionaliseren van de privacyfunctie binnen een grote en complexe overheidsorganisatie. Vanwege het vertrek van de huidige plaatsvervangend CPO is tijdelijke versterking nodig om de continuïteit van de privacyorganisatie te waarborgen. Op termijn wordt de functie structureel ingevuld. In deze opdracht ben je verantwoordelijk voor het verder inrichten en uitbouwen van de CPO-functie, het versterken van de privacy governance en het adviseren van management bij complexe privacyvraagstukken. Je begeleidt en stuurt privacyfunctionarissen functioneel aan, verbindt verschillende stakeholders binnen de organisatie en draagt actief bij aan de verdere professionalisering van privacy, compliance en gegevensbescherming. Taken en verantwoordelijkheden Verder ontwikkelen, inrichten en positioneren van de Chief Privacy Officer-functie. Functioneel aansturen van privacyfunctionarissen en privacyaanspreekpunten binnen de organisatie. Adviseren van hoger management over complexe privacyvraagstukken. Opstellen, uitvoeren en bewaken van het privacyplan. Doorontwikkelen van privacy governance, privacybeleid en bijbehorende processen. Uitvoeren, begeleiden en beoordelen van Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIA's). Deelnemen aan strategische en tactische overleggen op het gebied van privacy en gegevensbescherming. Begeleiden van privacy-audits, onderzoeken en opvolging van verbetermaatregelen. Wat vragen wij? Eisen Afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding op het gebied van gegevensbescherming, privacy of een vergelijkbare richting. Minimaal 2,5 jaar aantoonbare ervaring als Chief Privacy Officer (CPO) of plaatsvervangend CPO binnen de Rijksoverheid. Aantoonbare ervaring met de toepassing van privacywetgeving, waaronder de AVG, binnen grote organisaties met meer dan 1.000 medewerkers. Aantoonbare ervaring met functionele aansturing van privacyfunctionarissen of privacyadviseurs. Aantoonbare ervaring met het ontwikkelen of doorontwikkelen van privacy governance en privacybeleid. Aantoonbare ervaring met het adviseren van hoger management over privacyvraagstukken. Pré Relevante privacycertificering, zoals CIPP/E of CIPM. Ervaring met het uitvoeren of beoordelen van DPIA's. Ervaring met het opzetten, vastleggen, inrichten en vervullen van een CPO-functie. Ervaring met privacygerelateerde audits en onderzoeken. Ervaring met Privacy by Design binnen organisatieprocessen of digitale producten. Kennis van en/of ervaring met de EU AI Act en de relatie tussen AI-governance en privacy. Competenties Overtuigend en verbindend. Bestuurlijk en organisatiesensitief. Analytisch en doortastend. Integer en onafhankelijk in de oordeelsvorming. Informatie Opdrachtduur: 7 maanden met optie verlengen Locatie: Den Haag, met werkzaamheden in Utrecht en Zwolle en deels hybride Inzet: 24 tot 36 uur per week (voorkeur voor 32 uur per week( Contractvorm: ZZP Start: Zo spoedig mogelijk Geïnteresseerd?
