description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Mavericks Wanted</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":true,"134233118":true,"201341983":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">When was the last time you achieved the impossible? If that thought feels overwhelming, you might want to pause here, but if it sparks excitement...read on</span> <br><span data-contrast="auto"> </span> <br><span data-contrast="auto">In 2015, we pioneered a “moneyball for biotech” approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare disease, and develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible. </span> <br><span data-contrast="auto"> </span> <br><span data-contrast="auto">Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. If you're someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. Together, we'll ask "why not?" and help reengineer the future of biopharma. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical & thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":true,"134233118":true,"201341983":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p></div><h3><strong><u>What You’ll Do</u></strong></h3> <p>The Associate Director, Patient Advocacy, Skeletal Dysplasia will develop and execute patient advocacy activities that support BridgeBio’s work in skeletal dysplasia, primarily focusing on Europe, Latin America and other international markets as needed, and requires fluency in both Portuguese and Spanish. The role has responsibility for the development and execution of the skeletal dysplasia patient advocacy activities in support of clinical development and commercialisation, while safeguarding long-term patient trust and community relationships in support to the Global and International Patient Advocacy strategy</p> <p>Reporting to the Executive Director of International Patient Advocacy, this role drives engagement across the skeletal dysplasia community in Latin America, Europe and supports other relevant international and local markets as needed, ensuring community insights inform company strategy and decision-making. The Associate Director supports the development of external international partnerships and advocacy and educational initiatives, strengthening meaningful outreach across the region.</p> <h3><strong><u>Key Responsibilities</u></strong></h3> <ul> <li>Serve as the primary liaison to patient advocacy organizations in Latin America, Europe and other international markets as needed, establishing and strengthening compliant, long-term relationships built on trust, transparency, and alignment</li> <li>Support the development of the patient advocacy strategy and implement an international patient advocacy plan for skeletal dysplasia, aligned with the international plan and local priorities</li> <li>Represent BridgeBio at patient advocacy and community meetings across Europe, Latin America and other international markets as needed, building and strengthening relationships with patient organizations and local communities</li> <li>Bring patient and caregiver perspectives into clinical development, medical affairs, regulatory, market access, and commercial planning, as appropriate to the stage of each program</li> <li>Plan and deliver appropriate engagement activities, such as advisory boards, patient organization meetings, educational initiatives, community surveys, patient videos and opportunities to provide input on patient-facing materials</li> <li>Adapt engagement and communications for Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking and other international communities, ensuring materials and interactions are culturally relevant and accessible</li> <li>Support the Executive Director of International Patient Advocacy in strategic planning and oversight of advocacy-related budgets, including grants, sponsorships, advisory engagements, and educational initiatives</li> <li>Work with local and international teams to understand differences in care pathways, access barriers, community priorities, and advocacy environments across international markets</li> <li>Coordinate international grants, sponsorships, advisory engagements, and program budgets in line with applicable policies and local requirements</li> <li>Share clear, actionable community insights with internal partners while protecting individual privacy, preserving patient trust, and maintaining appropriate boundaries</li> <li>Monitor and report changes in relevant policies and industry requirements for patient organization engagement and ensure external activities meet company standards and local laws</li> <li>Promote a patient-first culture by communicating patient and caregiver perspectives, unmet needs, and appropriately consented stories and imagery through internal activities and company materials</li> <li>Strengthen BridgeBio’s role as a trusted partner in the skeletal dysplasia advocacy community through presentations and participation in relevant external forums</li> </ul> <h3><strong><u>Where You Will Work</u></strong></h3> <ul> <li>This role is based in Europe</li> <li>Frequent travel across Europe, Latin America and other relevant geographies is required; travel will vary with community and business needs</li> </ul> <h3><strong><u>Who You Are</u></strong></h3> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in a scientific field; advanced degree preferred.</li> <li>5+ years of patient advocacy or community engagement experience, including 3+ years within biotech/pharma.</li> <li>Experience working with rare disease communities; experience with skeletal dysplasia or other genetic rare conditions is preferred.</li> <li>Fluency in both Spanish and Portuguese is required to engage effectively with patient communities and partners in both languages. Strong professional English is also essential for international collaboration. Knowledge of German and French is an advantage.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to build trusted partnerships with patient organizations across countries and cultures, ideally including Latin America.</li> <li>Understanding of patient engagement requirements, healthcare systems, and access considerations across international markets; familiarity with Europe and Latin American markets is preferred.</li> <li>Strong cross-functional collaboration, clear communication, and the ability to manage multiple priorities independently in a matrixed organization.</li> <li>Willingness and ability to travel frequently across Europe, Latin America and other relevant geographies.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Rewarding Those Who Make the Mission Possible</strong></p> <p>We have high expectations for our team members. We make sure those working hard for patients are rewarded and cared for in return.</p> <ul> <li>Market-leading compensation.</li> <li>Remote/Hybrid work model - we value your flexibility in how you work but encourage time in the office to strengthen our culture, collaboration, and sense of community.</li> <li>We provide career development through regular feedback, continuous education and professional development programs.</li> <li>We celebrate strong performance with financial rewards, peer-to-peer recognition, and growth opportunities.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>As a global company, our comprehensive benefits may vary based on location.  <span data-contrast="auto">We have high expectations for our team members. title: Werk Student Recruitment
description: Werkstudent Recruitment (Nederlandstalig) — Den Haag of Berlijn, hybride (v/m/x) Wil je weten hoe recruitment echt werkt? Bij Eye ga je niet alleen cv's archiveren. Je helpt een groeiend recruitmentteam bouwen aan de manier waarop we mensen aannemen. En als het klikt, willen we je graag laten doorgroeien tot recruiter. Over Eye Eye Security maakt cybersecurity van topniveau, met een ingebouwde cyberverzekering, bereikbaar voor elk bedrijf in Europa, niet alleen voor de grote spelers. We zijn met ruim 190 collega's, met ons hoofdkantoor in Den Haag en een kantoor in Berlijn. Ons team komt uit de inlichtingenwereld, defensie, tech en consultancy. We groeien hard, dus er is veel te bouwen en veel te leren. Wat ga je doen? Je helpt onze recruiters kandidaten te vinden voor lastig in te vullen functies Je screent sollicitaties voor onze junior functies, waarvan veel in het Nederlands Je maakt van recruitmentdata heldere rapportages waar het team en managers echt iets aan hebben Je verbetert hoe we ons ATS gebruiken en houdt de data op orde Je brengt structuur in onze recruitmentkennis, te beginnen met alle vacatureteksten op één plek Je zorgt dat sollicitatiegesprekken soepel verlopen: plannen, afstemmen en contact met kandidaten Je helpt onze contacten met hogescholen en universiteiten op te bouwen De functie is nieuw en groeit mee met jou en met wat het team het hardst nodig heeft. Wie ben jij? Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en redt je goed in het Engels Je zit in het derde of vierde jaar van je hbo- of wo-opleiding en kunt 20 uur per week werken, waarvan 2 à 3 dagen op ons kantoor in Den Haag of Berlijn Je hebt minstens een half jaar administratieve of kantoorervaring (een bestuursjaar telt ook mee) en je bent handig met Excel Je wilt een carrière in recruitment opbouwen en bent benieuwd hoe het vak in elkaar zit Je pakt dingen zelf op: je ziet wat er moet gebeuren, zoekt hulp als je die nodig hebt en stelt goede vragen Mooi meegenomen Je vindt het leuk om met data te werken, of wilt daar beter in worden Je hebt al wat ervaring met recruitment, HR of een ATS Wat krijg je? Vanaf de eerste week echte verantwoordelijkheid, met een recruiter naast je van wie je het vak leert Een duidelijke kans om door te groeien naar junior recruiter Flexibele uren die passen bij je studie, en hybride werken Een team dat successen samen viert, van maandelijkse teamactiviteiten tot onze jaarlijkse "Eye-cation" Over Eye Security Eye Security biedt cybersecurity met een ingebouwde cyberverzekering aan organisaties in heel Europa. Ons hoofdkantoor staat in Nederland en we zijn gegroeid naar ruim 170 medewerkers. We blijven internationaal uitbreiden. We combineren geavanceerde technologie met praktische expertise om cyberdreigingen in realtime te detecteren, erop te reageren en de schade te herstellen. Ons team bestaat uit professionals met een achtergrond in de inlichtingenwereld, defensie, tech en consultancy. We werken allemaal aan dezelfde missie: cybersecurity van topniveau bereikbaar maken voor elk bedrijf, niet alleen voor de grote spelers. Bij Eye werk je aan internationale projecten, los je echte vraagstukken op en help je onze klanten aan een veiligere digitale toekomst. Kleine noot: in de Engelse en Nederlandse vacature in het document staat “ruim 190 collega’s”, wat recentere vacatures van Eye ook noemen. Kijk even welk getal je wilt aanhouden, zodat beide versies hetzelfde zeggen. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Fullstack Engineer
description: Who we are Comand AI is building a global technology leader focused on defense & security. The company was co-founded in 2023 by Loïc Mougeolle, Marie Inuzuka and Quentin Le Pape, drawing from their unique experience at defense industry leaders and world-class tech companies. The world of defense & security are being entirely renewed by AI and robotisation: new classes of threats, new levels of autonomy and speed demands radically new solutions to protect our societies. Comand AI is at the forefront of the rebuilding of these verticals to serve our countries resilience. Comand AI core product is a next generation command and control software platform, which allows militaries to operate at machine speed in a communication and GNSS denied context. A few facts to anchor you: €45M raised from seed to Series A, Blossom Capital leading the series A and Saab as a strategic investor Software platform combat proven and deployed in Ukraine A lean team of operators with backgrounds from Palantir, OpenAI and world-class tech experience, alongside unique expertise from the defense sector Live business with governments and defense industry leaders across Europe Paris (HQ), London, Munich and Kyiv subsidiaries The Role You'd join the engineering team to own features end to end, with a strong lean toward the interfaces and workflows clients interact with directly. This is a product engineering role. Unlike our Forward Deployed Engineers, you are not embedded with clients or responsible for running deployments in the field. You turn operational needs and field feedback into a durable core product. What this looks like in practice: Own end-to-end features on Prevail, our operational planning platform, from scoping and interaction choices through backend implementation and production Spend significant time on the front end, building clear, reliable workflows for users working with complex information under pressure Solve real geospatial problems: move data between backend and frontend through tile servers and use PostGIS for demanding spatial queries Build and harden ML and LLM workflow orchestration, including retries, queueing, and long-running jobs with LangGraph and LangChain Design for on-prem and appliance deployment, where hardware, connectivity, and resource constraints matter as much as cloud scalability Work closely with product, design, and forward-deployed teams to turn user signal into features that work across clients Who We're Looking For We filter hardest on mission drive, low ego, attention to detail, and first-principles problem solving. We want builders who can move across the stack while keeping the user-facing experience sharp. Must-have: Strong full-stack production experience, with genuine comfort owning both interfaces and backend systems Solid TypeScript and React, plus Python experience or the ability to become productive quickly with FastAPI A track record of taking features from an ambiguous problem through release and iteration Product judgement and attention to detail, especially in workflows used directly by customers Comfort deciding what to build now, what to make durable, and what to leave out EU or UK citizenship (contractual requirement tied to our defence contracts) Nice to have: Experience with PostGIS, GIS, mapping, or other geospatial systems Experience with LangGraph, LangChain, or multi-step ML and LLM workflows Experience deploying software on-prem, offline, or as an appliance Experience with front-end performance and data-dense interfaces Prior work in defence, government, or dual-use technology What's In It For You Competitive package (top 0.1% of compensation in Europe: base + equity) Paris or London based End-to-end ownership of product used in real operational environments The Process Talent screening : 30 min, online. Background and motivation. Technical screening : 45min, online. Skills assessment. Onsite in Paris : half day (3 hours). System Design, Re-engineering and Project Presentation. Roundtable. title: Corporate Paralegal
description: About Mistral Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. About the Role Mistral AI's corporate legal team is looking for a Corporate Paralegal to join our growing legal function in Paris. This is a newly created role designed to centralize and streamline the administrative backbone of our corporate legal operations as we scale internationally. This is a high-autonomy role. You will own several critical workstreams end-to-end — from KYC and entity housekeeping to cap table management and contract administration — and you will be expected to exercise sound judgment, escalate when needed, and drive automation wherever possible. What you'll do 1. Cap Table & Share Register Own the cap table across different systems with rigor and precision. Record all share movements — issuances, transfers, ESOP/BSPCE, funding rounds. Maintain the legal share register and reconcile against articles, shareholders' agreements, and board minutes. Produce cap table extracts, shareholder lists, and ownership reports for KYC, audit, board packs, and investors — always under NDA and with judgment on what can be disclosed. Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, reconciliation) are essential. 2. Entity Management, Corporate Formalities & Notarisation Handle entity creation from incorporation to corporate maintenance across jurisdictions (SAS, Inc, Ltd, Pte, GmbH, etc.) with confidentiality and attention to detail. Manage the annual formalities calendar, board/shareholder minutes, resolutions, powers of attorney, and the entity housekeeping file for each group company. Coordinate notarial formalities — share transfers, capital changes, statutory modifications, pledges. Handle apostilles, legalisation, and certified translations for documents used abroad via the Legal Vision Platform. Maintain up-to-date KYC packs for each entity: Kbis, articles, directors, beneficial ownership, administrative certificates. Respond to inbound KYC requests from banks, clients, and investors. Log every formalité for a complete and auditable record. 3. Insurance & Document Management Manage insurance policies, certificates (COIs), and the renewal calendar. Handle COI requests by checking them against contractual requirements and following up with brokers. Keep a register of policies and claims. File and archive documents with naming conventions and versioning in our document management tools. Manage e-signatures (DocuSign). Maintain the contract register with expiry dates and notice periods. Provide up-to-date insurance certificates and policy summaries as part of KYC documentation for each entity. 4. Procurement Contracts First-level review of NDAs, order forms, and simple SOWs against Mistral templates, flagging deviations for escalation. Version comparison and clean redlines. Understand the procurement policy to know when legal review is mandatory. Coordinate with Procurement, business teams, and Finance to move deals to signature. Complete supplier onboarding questionnaires (anti-bribery, sanctions, ESG, security) and supplier portals (Ariba, Coupa) as part of the vendor KYC process. Comfortable with tools like Ironclad, Notion, and Slack; keen to automate and reduce manual work. What you bring 10+ years of experience in a legal field, with a strong preference for corporate law (M&A, banking, funds, or large corporate groups). Experience in a law firm (corporate/M&A/banking), investment fund, bank, or a large multinational group (e.g., CAC 40). Proven experience with KYC processes, questionnaires, and administrative certificates. Strong understanding of confidentiality, data protection (GDPR), and the judgment to know what can and cannot be shared externally. Hands-on experience with cap table management tools (Ledgy, Axiocap) or share register administration. Familiarity with French corporate law (SAS) and international entity structures (Delaware Inc, UK Ltd, Singapore Pte, German GmbH). Experience with contract lifecycle management (CLM) tools and e-signature platforms. Exposure to procurement contract review and vendor onboarding. Fluent in English and French (both written and spoken). Additional languages are a plus. What We Offer We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page . Privacy Policy Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy . Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Category Manager - Strategic Sourcing (Packaging)
description: <h2><strong>The role</strong></h2> <p>At HelloFresh, our mission is simple: to change the way people eat, forever. As the Category Manager for Packaging, you will report directly to the Director of Packaging and take full ownership of creating and developing our Primary packaging category (ingredient packaging, plastic film…). Base</strong>: Build and maintain a strong pool of primary packaging suppliers capable of providing all of our ingredient packaging requirements, taking full ownership of vendor selection, specs packaging.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Preferably deep knowledge and interest in food, Ideally working within a similar environment and sector</li> <li>Masters flexible, ambitious, and assertive: you take ownership of your work</li> </ul> <p><strong>TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS: </strong>10% - 25% (Flexible)</p> <h2><strong>What we offer</strong></h2> <p>Elevate your title: Emerging Enterprise Hunter Account Executive, France
description: <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">SLSQ427R1101</p> <p>As an Emerging Enterprise Hunter Account Executive, you are a sales professional experienced in selling to Emerging Enterprise accounts in France (annual turnover $250mil to $1B). You know how to sell innovation and change through customer vision expansion and can guide deals forward to compress decision cycles. You love understanding a product in depth and are passionate about communicating its value to Customers and Partners. Always looking for new opportunities, you will secure net new logos with new accounts and expand them. Along with the chance to close exciting deals and solve meaningful problems, we also offer accelerators above 100% quota attainment.</p> <p>You will report to the Senior Director, Emerging Enterprise, South Europe.</p> <p><strong>The impact you will have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Assess your territory and develop a successful execution strategy </li> <li>Use a solution-based approach to selling and creating value for new logo accounts </li> <li>Identify and close quick, small wins while managing longer, complex sales cycles</li> <li>Track all customer details including use case, purchase time frames, next steps, and forecasting in Salesforce</li> <li>Exceed activity and quarterly revenue targets</li> <li>Promote the value of the Databricks' Data Intelligence Platform </li> <li>Ensure 100% satisfaction among all customers</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we look for:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Understanding of the data platform and cloud ecosystems</li> <li>Some exposure to the software industry and some basic concepts of selling SaaS, Data and Business Value</li> <li>Basic understanding on how to research company information and identifying key stakeholders</li> <li>Competent with prospecting research and ability to map out key stakeholders</li> <li>Adept in selling to technical buyers </li> <li>Understanding of MEDDPICC</li> <li>Experience exceeding sales targets/quotas</li> <li>Bachelor's Degree or relevant work experience</li> <li>Fluency in English and French is required</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About Databricks</strong></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;">Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/databricks">LinkedIn</a>, <a href="https://x.com/databricks">X</a>, <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@Databricks">YouTube</a>, and <a href="https://www.instagram.com/databricksinc/?hl=en">Instagram</a>.<br><br><strong>Benefits<br><br></strong></span>At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click <a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/154un3e8Xav4BceOSlcYFZRGEuQI54xMxVydRwQn54eQ/edit?usp=sharing">here</a>.<br><br></p> <p><strong>Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion</strong></p> <p>At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.</p> <p><strong>Compliance</strong></p> <p><strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.</span></strong></p></div> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Business Director H/F - CDI
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p>Dans un souci de clarté et d’accessibilité, nous avons choisi de ne pas utiliser l’écriture inclusive dans nos communications. WPP Media est fermement engagé en faveur de la diversité : nous valorisons l'inclusion et l'égalité, en considérant tous les candidats sans distinction d'identité de genre, d'origine ethnique ou de religion. Tous nos postes sont également ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.</p> <p><strong><u>À propos de WPP Media :</u></strong></p> <p><strong>WPP est le partenaire de confiance des plus grandes marques mondiales pour assurer leur croissance. </strong>Nous réunissons une intelligence média de pointe, une créativité de classe mondiale, une production de nouvelle génération, des solutions pour transformer le marketing à l’ère de l’IA et un conseil stratégique d’expert au sein d’une seule compagnie. </p> <p>Propulsés par des talents exceptionnels et WPP Open, notre plateforme de marketing agentique, nous déployons l’IA à grande échelle pour aider nos clients à naviguer dans un monde en pleines mutations et à optimiser leurs investissements marketing. </p> <p>Pour plus d’informations, visitez <a href="http://www.wpp.com/">www.wpp.com</a>. </p> <p>WPP Media est le collectif média global de WPP. Dans un monde où les médias sont omniprésents, nous regroupons la meilleure plateforme, les meilleurs talents et les meilleurs partenaires pour développer les solutions les plus innovantes, offrant une croissance inégalée à nos clients. Pour plus d'informations, visitez <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/">wppmedia.com</a>. </p> <p>Chez WPP Media, nous croyons en la puissance de notre culture et de nos collaborateurs. C'est grâce à cette synergie que nous parvenons à créer des expériences véritablement exceptionnelles, tant pour nos clients que pour nos équipes internes.</p> <p>Pour réussir dans ce poste, il est fondamental d'incarner les valeurs essentielles qui unissent WPP et WPP Media :</p> <ul> <li><strong>Être Extraordinaire</strong> en favorisant un leadership collectif qui inspire une créativité véritablement transformationnelle.</li> <li><strong>Créer un environnement Ouvert</strong> en trouvant l'équilibre parfait entre l'épanouissement de nos collaborateurs et la satisfaction de nos clients, le tout fondé sur une confiance mutuelle.</li> <li><strong>Diriger avec Optimisme</strong> en stimulant activement la croissance et le développement pour mobiliser l'ensemble de notre organisation.</li> </ul> <p><strong><u>Rôle et missions : </u></strong></p> <p>Vous prendrez la responsabilité du compte MGM au sein de l’équipe OpenDoor (entité qui gère l’ensemble des LOB d’Amazon au sein de WPP Media France).</p> <p>Sur ce portefeuille d'envergure, nous recherchons un <strong>Business Director</strong> <strong>– Client Lead </strong>pour incarner le conseil de haut niveau, guider les recommandations stratégiques et accompagner la montée en compétences d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire.</p> <p>Vos missions principales :</p> <ol> <li><strong> Vision Stratégique, Écriture & Prise de Hauteur :</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Rédiger et porter les recommandations stratégiques globales et spécifique à chaque sortie cinéma en apportant une vraie prise de hauteur 360°.</li> <li>Concevoir des présentations et des synthèses stratégiques à fort impact destinées aux directions marketing, comités de direction, instances internationales et réseaux de partenaires/franchisés.</li> <li>Valoriser, structurer et incarner avec conviction l'ensemble des travaux produits par l'agence pour sublimer la valeur délivrée aux clients.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> Appétence Innovation & Développement de la Valeur Client :</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Démontrer une forte curiosité et une appétence naturelle pour les sujets d'innovation média et les enjeux stratégiques clés du moment : <strong>Influence & Content / Opérations Spéciales, Event…</strong></li> <li>Dans une démarche conseil créatrice de valeur (et non de pur push commercial), savoir détecter dans les échanges clients les besoins émergents pour co-construire des solutions sur-mesure avec l'appui des équipes d'experts internes (Data, Studio, Activation).</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> Leadership Managérial & Coaching Orienté Développement :</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Encadrer et animer une équipe (Account Directors, Account Managers, Executives, Alternants).</li> <li>S'appuyer sur la forte autonomie de l'équipe dans la gestion opérationnelle du quotidien pour adopter une posture de <strong>mentor et de coach</strong>.</li> <li>Identifier les axes de progression individuels — notamment sur la prise de hauteur stratégique, l'écriture et la formalisation des recommandations — et accompagner le développement des collaborateurs seniors pour les aider à franchir des caps majeurs.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> Coordination 360 & Orchestration Interne :</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Assurer l'orchestration globale des réponses plurimédias (Online & Offline) en faisant le lien fluide entre le conseil, le planning stratégique, la création et les équipes d'activation technique (Social, Programmatique, TV/Vidéo).</li> </ul> <p>Profil Recherché :</p> <ul> <li><strong>Expérience :</strong> 10 à 12 ans d'expérience en agence média sur des fonctions de conseil, de stratégie média et de relation client.</li> <li><strong>Expertise dans l’industrie du Cinéma</strong>, idéalement ayant déjà piloté un compte Entertainment (distributeur cinéma).</li> <li><strong>Expertise Média 360 :</strong> Solide culture générale des médias (Off & Online).</li> <li><strong>Qualités Rédactionnelles & Synthèse :</strong> Excellence reconnue dans la réflexion et l'écriture stratégique, capacité à simplifier des problématiques complexes et à porter des dossiers stratégiques de haut niveau.</li> <li><strong>Posture Managériale :</strong>  Capacité avérée à faire progresser ses équipes par l'accompagnement et le coaching plutôt que par le micro-management.</li> <li><strong>Langues :</strong> Anglais professionnel obligatoire.</li> </ul> <p><strong><u>La vie chez WPP Media et ses avantages :</u></strong></p> <p>Notre engagement à façonner l'avenir des médias se manifeste par un soutien actif au développement professionnel de nos talents, les aidant à atteindre leur plein potentiel. Cette démarche s'accompagne d'une vision responsable dans nos stratégies d'investissement médiatique, reflétant ainsi notre double priorité : valoriser nos collaborateurs tout en adoptant des pratiques durables dans notre secteur.</p> <p>Les collaborateurs de WPP Media ont un accès privilégié aux réseaux internationaux de WPP Media et WPP, leur permettant de développer leurs passions, d'étendre leur réseau professionnel et de rester à la pointe des innovations en marketing et publicité.</p> <p>Nous disposons de ressources vastes et variées au service de nos collaborateurs, notre entreprise cultive activement l'inclusion des talents de tous horizons. Les réussites et expertises des équipes sont régulièrement mises en lumière lors d'événements fédérateurs qui ponctuent également les moments clés de l'année, renforçant ainsi notre culture d'entreprise collaborative et diversifiée.</p> <p><strong>Nos avantages comprennent :</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Télétravail :</strong> jusqu'à 2 jours par semaine et 2 semaines complètes à prendre en deux fois dans l’année.</li> <li><strong>Congés offerts :</strong> 2 jours de repos supplémentaires offerts, dont le lundi de Pentecôte.</li> <li><strong>Ancienneté :</strong> Jours de congé additionnels par palier de 5 ans d’ancienneté.</li> <li><strong>Santé & Équité :</strong> 5 jours de télétravail additionnels par mois pour les collaboratrices souffrant d’endométriose.</li> <li><strong>Politique handicap :</strong> 3 jours d'absence autorisés payés par an, accès à des Chèques Emploi Service Universel, et accompagnements spécifiques pour les collaborateurs ayant une RQTH.</li> <li><strong>Engagement sociétal :</strong> Missions solidaires possibles via le programme <em>We care and we act</em>.</li> <li><strong>Tools :</strong> Accès à des outils performants et à la pointe de la technologie pour la gestion des campagnes et le reporting (WPP Open).</li> </ul> <p><strong><u>Process de recrutement :</u></strong></p> <p>Nous nous engageons à rendre ce process aussi rapide et efficace que possible, et à maintenir une communication ouverte et transparente tout au long du process.</p> <ol> <li><strong>Entretien avec l’équipe Recrutement :</strong> Un premier entretien téléphonique ou par vidéoconférence avec l’équipe Talent pour aborder votre parcours et échanger sur le poste.</li> <li><strong>Entretiens Opérationnels :</strong> Une rencontre avec les leads des comptes à gérer. Au moins un entretien physique est prévu dans nos locaux.</li> <li><strong>Étude de cas :</strong> Réalisation d'un Business Case stratégique pour évaluer votre capacité d'analyse, de synthèse, la qualité de votre écriture et votre vision média.</li> </ol> <p>WPP Media garantit l'égalité des chances et considère tous les candidats sans discrimination ni considération de caractéristiques particulières. Nous nous engageons à cultiver un environnement de respect où chacun se sent à sa place et bénéficie des mêmes opportunités d'évolution professionnelle.  </p> <p>Consultez notre politique de confidentialité pour tout savoir sur la protection de vos données <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">politique de confidentialité</a>.  </p> <p>Bien que nous étudiions toutes les candidatures reçues, nous ne contactons que les personnes sélectionnées pour un entretien. <br><br>#<span class="mark

title: Account Development Representative - France
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Who we are</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.</span></p></div><p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive. </p> <p>On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our French EMEA business, generating opportunities via outbound outreach. </p> <p>We have offices in Paris and London and we offer remote working from France and the United Kingdom.</p> <p><strong>This is a remote position open to candidates based in France and the United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CET. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.</strong></p> <p><strong>You should apply if: </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You want to impact the industries that run our world: </strong>Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.</li> <li><strong>You are the architect of your own career: </strong>If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.</li> <li><strong>You love talking to people: </strong>In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.</li> <li><strong>You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: </strong>One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.</li> <li><strong>You treat rejection as a learning experience:</strong> In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara’s mission.</li> <li><strong>You want to be with the best: </strong>Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>In this role, you will:</strong> </h4> <ul> <li>Drive pipeline through personalised outreach to prospects via phone, emails and LinkedIn</li> <li>Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners.</li> <li>Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling</li> <li>Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)</li> <li>Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum requirements for the role:</strong></p> <ul> <li>1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles</li> <li>6-12 months sales experience as a minimum</li> <li>Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales</li> <li>Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, verbal and written</li> <li>Curious and able to ask insightful questions</li> <li>A champion of a Growth Mindset</li> <li>Highly proficient in English and fluent in French</li> </ul> <p><strong>An ideal candidate also has:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in closing-sales roles</li> <li>Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)</li> <li>Willingness to collaborate and influence in a “win as a team” environment</li> <li>Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways</li> <li>Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADR pathways</strong></p> <p>Through Samsara’s ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs’ understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program.</p> <ul> <li><strong>ADR I</strong> representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara. At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them.</li> </ul> <ul> <li>The next level in the program is <strong>ADR II</strong>, where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives. After building their skills in outbound sales and earning sales certifications, our representatives graduate to the final level of the program.</li> </ul> <ul> <li>The highest level within our organization is <strong>ADR III</strong>. These ADRs work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers at Samsara. They partner closely on large accounts, implementing detailed territory plans, participating in weekly strategy meetings, and scheduling and attending customer demos. Additionally, ADR IIIs partake in a mentorship program to learn from leadership on the Account Executive team who provide exposure and training ahead of their interview for an Account Executive position.</li> </ul> <p>Please submit an English CV with your application.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Total Rewards</strong></p> <p>At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why <a href="https://www.samsara.com/company/careers/benefits">our rewards</a> are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.</p> <p>Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.</p> <p><strong>Flexible Working </strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.</span></p> <p><strong>Belonging at Samsara</strong></p> <p>At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.</p> <p><strong>Accommodations </strong></p> <p>Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email <a ---------- or <a href="https://forms.gle/DrM6DFQUiSgfPtCVA">click here</a> if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.</p> <p><strong>Our Commitment to Authenticity</strong></p> <p>We use <a href="https://hiretofu.com/privacyPolicy">Tofu</a>, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize gen

title: Director of Cybersecurity & IT
description: Hi, we’re Back Market. We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new . We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new. Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have. Are you ready to join us? Back Market is looking for a Director of Cybersecurity & IT to define and lead the next phase of our security and technology operations maturity. Reporting to the VP of Platform Engineering, you will be a strategic leader at the intersection of cybersecurity, IT, risk, compliance, and business growth. You will lead a multi-disciplinary organization through its existing functional managers, creating the clarity, operating rhythm, and investment focus needed to protect Back Market while enabling the company to move quickly. The scope includes cybersecurity strategy and risk management, security operations, governance and compliance, IT operations, IT support, and the corporate technology foundations that keep our people productive and our business resilient. This is a director-level role, not a super-sized operational manager role. You will not be expected to personally own every process or make every technical decision. Your impact will come from setting direction, developing leaders, aligning stakeholders, making sound investment choices, and ensuring that the organization delivers measurable outcomes. You will be the senior voice who makes cybersecurity and IT understandable, actionable, and connected to the business. To know more about our engineering teams: A video of our VP Platform: https://youtu.be/zvTlw4BNNdc Our company purpose: http://bit.ly/3OsScpl Our engineering blog: https://bit.ly/3ASJNID How we work with the existing teams 💚 The Director sets direction, creates clarity, secures resources, removes organizational obstacles, develops leaders, and ensures that the overall portfolio delivers against agreed outcomes. The functional managers and senior experts retain ownership of day-to-day execution, technical practices, operational processes, and delivery within their domains. The Director creates the conditions for those leaders to succeed and makes sure their work adds up to a coherent company-wide strategy. description: Vacature: Marketing director (B2B SaaS/fintech) @ Snelstart Voor onze opdrachtgever Snelstart ( www.snelstart.nl ) in Amersfoort zoekt Sound People een marketing director die marketingstrategie, executie en teamontwikkeling verbindt. Met 180.000 gebruikers is het een van de grootste boekhoud en accountancy software platforms van Nederland Snelstart maakt ondernemen al 40+ jaar eenvoudiger met slimme software en wil uitgroeien tot de meest vooruitstrevende fintech‑partner van Nederland. Jij krijgt mandaat om die ambitie te versnellen. De rol van marketing director bij Snelstart. · Co-creëer de marketingstrategie met de Sales Director en directie en bewaak de realisatie. · Leid en coach het team (growth & automation, campagnes, product marketing, design, content). · Bouw een AI‑gedreven leadfunnel in HubSpot (Breeze AI), gekoppeld aan Dynamics, voor een constante stroom kwalitatieve MQL’s richting sales. · Vergroot het eigen leadkanaal (‘base’) en verminder afhankelijkheid van externe platformen. · Zet een schaalbare B2B‑contentmachine op op basis van ICP’s, persona’s en doelgroepdata. · Stuur campagnes op ROI; elke euro meetbaar en aantoonbaar resultaat. · Verhoog interne marketingkennis en verminder bureau‑afhankelijkheid; zet AI slim in. · Manage budget en martech‑stack; rapporteer KPI’s (leadvolume, conversie, CPL/CAC, CLV). Our day-to-day stack currently relies on Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) as our primary engine, and we are actively considering next-generation architecture like Marketing Cloud Next. However, for us, specific tool proficiency takes a backseat to a genuine passion for marketing technology, AI-driven marketing innovations, robust data architecture, and technical problem-solving. We value your ability to analyze complex data models, integrate APIs, write clean code, and optimize high-throughput automation pipelines over specific certifications. What you will do Data Architecture & Engineering Operations Enablement: Prepare, clean, structure, and model marketing data for Marketing Operations teams to run campaigns, segment audiences, and manage daily operations friction-free. Data Modeling: Build and optimize scalable relational database structures, data extensions, custom models, and subscriber key lifecycles for operational needs. ETL & Data Pipelines: Partner with the Data Team to create automated SQL queries and ETL pipelines ingesting and transforming data warehouse datasets (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery) into production-ready data extensions. Governance & Hygiene: Maintain data hygiene, identity resolution, deduplication, and real-time ecosystem syncs to ensure efficiency. Technical Customization & Custom Development Write maintainable custom platform code (e.g., AMPscript, SSJS, WSProxy) for personalization engines. Develop dynamic rendering logic, interactive web forms, and secure landing pages. Troubleshoot automation failures, script exceptions, and data bottlenecks. API & Ecosystem Integrations Architect and maintain API integrations (REST, SOAP, Webhooks) connecting product apps, mobile backends, and third-party systems to the marketing platform. Configure native CRM and database connectors for low-latency, real-time bidirectional sync. Manage rate limits, payload efficiency, OAuth, and retry handlers. Platform Operations & System Health Monitor runtimes, script performance, and query execution to ensure 99.9% uptime. Lead security governance, permissions, business unit structuring, and privacy compliance (GDPR, CCPA, CAN-SPAM). Partner with DevOps and IT Security on domain authentication and deliverability infrastructure. Experience and qualifications Core Technical Competencies Advanced SQL & Database Design: Extensive experience with relational data modeling, complex joins, aggregation, and query tuning. Integrations & Protocols: Strong knowledge of REST/SOAP APIs, JSON/XML, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, and Postman. Scripting & Code: Skilled in AMPscript, SSJS, or general languages (JavaScript, Node.js, Python) applied to MarTech. MarTech & AI Curiosity: Passionate about marketing architecture, event triggers, relational mapping, agentic AI, CDPs, and automated personalization. Experience 3+ years in technical architecture, administration, or development in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) (Automation Studio, Journey Builder, Contact Builder, CloudPages, APIs, or Data Cloud/AI frameworks). Practical understanding of how Predictive, Generative, and Agentic AI transform technical marketing. Proven track record of evaluating and mastering new marketing platforms and technical tools. Key Personality Traits Tech & AI Enthusiast: Actively follows MarTech, CDPs, AI automation, and data engineering trends. Platform Agnostic: Uses tools and AI models adaptively to solve data and communication challenges. title: Reliability Engineer
description: Make Your Mark as a Reliability Engineer at Storio group About the role. We are looking for a Reliability Engineer to join our production team and help optimize our machinery operations. In this role, you will analyze the lifecycle of our equipment, evaluate how we manage asset maintenance, and prevent potential downtime before it happens. You will work closely with operational teams to keep our production running safely and smoothly across our plant. When failures do occur, you will advise the team on how to respond quickly and effectively. You will use data and engineering risk methodologies to develop preventive maintenance strategies, establish inspection criteria, and protect our business from performance losses. Your work directly impacts our operational efficiency and the continuous delivery of personalized products to our customers. How you embrace curiosity daily. Analyze statistical data, performance losses, and cost drivers to predict equipment failures and uncover improvement opportunities. Facilitate root cause analysis using techniques like FMEA, Fault Tree Analysis, and PHA for complex machinery issues. Test new ideas and support machine trials to optimize process performance and material changes. Review preventive maintenance programs and recommend technical updates to increase machinery availability. Assess the technical feasibility of proposed changes from procurement and operational teams. Explore innovative ways to streamline maintenance approaches while cutting overall operational costs. How you make your mark. Maximize equipment availability and reliability while lowering maintenance costs across the plant. Develop effective maintenance strategies and clear standard operating procedures for autonomous maintenance. Lead cross-functional improvement teams to solve persistent technical problems and boost site productivity. Support capital investment projects to ensure new equipment meets strict maintainability standards and spare part requirements. Conduct risk assessments to maintain full compliance with statutory inspection requirements, safety guidelines, and product quality standards. What you bring to the team. Strong experience as a reliability engineer or production specialist in a manufacturing environment. Deep knowledge of reliability engineering techniques including FMEA, FTA, PHA, and criticality analysis. Proven ability to facilitate root cause analysis and resolve complex technical equipment failures. Practical background in developing preventive maintenance strategies, SOPs, and machine inspection criteria. Hands-on experience supporting new machine installations, engineering trials, and capital projects. Strong communication skills to guide production teams and collaborate on safety and quality standards. What sets you apart. Experience applying maintainability analysis within high-volume automated production settings. Degree or formal qualification in Mechanical, Electrical, or Reliability Engineering. title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer, Internship
description: Le poste Les Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSE) travaillent directement avec les clients afin de comprendre rapidement leurs problèmes les plus importants et ainsi concevoir et implémenter des solutions qui vont utiliser leurs données afin de résoudre ces problématiques. Nos clients s’appuient sur les plateformes de Palantir pour certaines de leurs opérations les plus critiques, et les projets débutent souvent par une question ouverte, par exemple : « Comment évaluer le risque d’incendie de forêt et, par conséquent, comment optimiser le réseau électrique ? » ou « Comment évaluer rapidement notre chaîne d’approvisionnement alimentaire et l’adapter afin d’apporter à temps une aide vitale ? » En tant que FDSE, vous appliquez votre capacité à résoudre les problèmes, votre créativité et vos compétences techniques pour aider les organisations à exploiter au mieux leurs données et avoir ainsi un impact réel sur le monde. Vous avez l’opportunité d’obtenir des informations rares et de contribuer à certaines des industries et institutions les plus importantes au monde. Responsabilités principales En tant que stagiaire chez FDSE, vos responsabilités s’apparentent à celles que l’on trouve dans une petite start-up, tout en bénéficiant des ressources, de la stabilité et de l’accompagnement d’une entreprise technologique bien établie. Vous travaillerez en petites équipes avec une supervision minimale et serez responsable de l’exécution de bout en bout de projets à enjeux élevés. Votre journée peut consister à discuter de l’architecture avec d’autres ingénieurs, à gérer des données à grande échelle, à coder une application web personnalisée, à discuter avec l’équipe dirigeante du client ou à établir une stratégie pour votre équipe. Les stagiaires FDSE sont traités exactement comme des ingénieurs à temps plein, et bénéficient d’une grande liberté et d’une grande autonomie dans leur travail. Ils assument la responsabilité des projets et des résultats réels sur lesquels nos clients comptent. Nos principes: Impact : nous gérons des projets significatifs et enthousiasmants qui rendent le monde meilleur. Responsabilité : nous menons nos projets du début à la fin, en surmontant tous les obstacles que nous pourrions rencontrer. Nous nous faisons mutuellement confiance afin de gérer efficacement le temps et les priorités et donner aux individus l’espace nécessaire pour réfléchir par eux-mêmes. Collaboration : nous travaillons en interne avec des personnes d’horizons variés, tels que d’autres FDSE, des équipes Produits et des Deployment Strategists. Nous travaillons également en externe avec nos clients, souvent sur site, afin de comprendre et de répondre à leurs problèmes. Développement : nous pensons que l’apprentissage par l’expérience est l’une des meilleures écoles et nous nous encourageons nous-mêmes tout comme nos pairs à rechercher de nouveaux défis et de nouvelles opportunités de croissance, ainsi qu’à trouver de nouvelles façons d’innover et de partager les connaissances. Le profil recherché Propension et intérêt à se déplacer sur les sites client en fonction des besoins. Capacité de passer 25 à 50 % du temps en déplacement de préférence, mais les exigences peuvent varier selon l’équipe et l’emplacement. Capacité démontrée à apprendre continuellement, à travailler de manière autonome et à prendre des décisions avec un minimum de direction. Capacité à collaborer avec des équipes de personnes techniques et non techniques, et à être à l’aise pour travailler dans un environnement en évolution constante avec des objectifs dynamiques et des itérations avec les utilisateurs. Volonté de résoudre de façon créative les problèmes techniques liés aux structures de données, aux systèmes de stockage, à l’infrastructure cloud, aux frameworks front-end et à d’autres outils techniques. Intérêt à travailler avec des données à grande échelle et à les utiliser pour résoudre des problèmes opérationnels importants. Les exigences Expérience en ingénierie, de préférence dans des domaines tels que l’informatique, les mathématiques, le Software Engineering, la physique et la science des données. Maîtrise de langages de programmation tels que Python, Java, C++, TypeScript/JavaScript ou similaire. Vous devez prévoir d’obtenir votre diplôme en 2027. Il doit s’agir de votre dernier stage avant d’obtenir votre diplôme. Pour postuler, veuillez soumettre ce qui suit : Un CV à jour Des réponses réfléchies à nos questions de candidature Date limite de l’offre Afin de renforcer la transparence de notre processus de recrutement, nous aimerions vous faire part de nos attentes concernant la date limite de l’offre. En postulant à ce poste, vous vous engagez à confirmer votre décision dans les deux semaines suivant la réception de votre offre écrite. La vie chez Palantir Nous tenons à ce que chaque Palantirien(ne) atteigne son meilleur potentiel, c’est pourquoi nous célébrons les forces, les compétences et les intérêts des individus, de votre premier entretien à votre croissance à long terme, plutôt que de nous appuyer sur les échelles de carrière traditionnelles. L’attention portée aux besoins de notre communauté nous permet d’optimiser nos possibilités de croissance et contribue à garantir de nombreuses voies de réussite chez Palantir. Promouvoir la santé et le bien-être dans tous les domaines de la vie des Palantiriens n’est que l’une des façons dont nous investissons dans notre communauté. Apprenez-en davantage sur la vie chez Palantir et notez que nos offres peuvent varier selon les régions. Conformément aux valeurs et à la culture de Palantir, nous estimons que les employés sont « meilleurs ensemble » et que le travail en présentiel permet d’obtenir des résultats plus créatifs. En conséquence, nous encourageons les employés à travailler depuis nos bureaux pour favoriser la connectivité et l’innovation. De nombreuses équipes proposent des options hybrides (télétravail un jour ou deux par semaine), ce qui permet à nos employés de trouver le bon compromis pour leur productivité personnelle. En fonction des besoins de l’entreprise, il existe quelques postes qui permettent de travailler « à distance » de manière exceptionnelle. Si vous postulez à l’un de ces postes, vous devez travailler depuis la ville et/ou le pays dans lequel vous êtes employé(e). Si le poste précise « sur site », vous devez travailler depuis un bureau. Si vous souhaitez donner aux organisations les plus importantes au monde les moyens d’agir, votre place est ici. Palantir valorise l’excellence, d’où qu’elle vienne. Nous nous engageons à rendre le processus de candidature et d’embauche accessible à tous et offrirons des aménagements raisonnables aux personnes vivant en situation de handicap. Si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement pour le processus de candidature ou d’embauche, veuillez et nous indiquer comment nous pouvons vous aider. Attention : il ne vous sera jamais demandé d’envoyer un paiement ou de partager des données financières pour participer à notre processus d’entretien. Si vous pensez avoir été contacté par un escroc, nous vous conseillons de cesser toute communication avec la personne et d’envisager de la signaler aux autorités compétentes, telles que l’ Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3) du FBI aux États-Unis. A World-Changing Company Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. title: Product Manager
description: Wanna join the adventure? At Loft, we are convinced that space programs should not have to be rebuilt from scratch every time. Our philosophy has been to productize them: we develop our own proprietary technology blocks, hardware and software, so that a customer payload can be integrated faster and more reliably than any bespoke program allows. That approach has delivered — it is why our customers reach orbit in months rather than years, and it is what makes working here different from working in the rest of the industry. We are now taking the next step: launching and operating our own constellations, and building a new set of services on top of them. That includes a full product suite enabling third-party AI applications to run directly onboard our satellites, and a growing ecosystem of partners whose needs we have to understand and design for. Loft is expanding at a very high pace, and the range of what we build is expanding just as fast. This is why Product Management matters so much here. Someone has to hold the whole picture — what is technically possible, what customers actually need, what we should build first — and turn it into something engineering and leadership can act on. As a Product Manager, you will own a significant perimeter and the autonomy that goes with it. We are growing the team precisely so that each of us can go deeper on our topics, anticipate rather than react, and have more impact across the company. You will need to be comfortable talking to anyone here. In the same week you might sit with a system engineer to understand a design constraint, join a BD call with an institutional customer, and present a recommendation to the executive team. Ideas at Loft get discussed openly and on their merits, wherever they come from, so being able to ask a naive question without ego — and to disagree with someone senior without making it personal — matters more than seniority. About this role: Understand what is possible, and turn it into requirements Spend the bulk of your time with engineering: understanding architectures, constraints, and dependencies well enough to judge what is realistically doable in a given timeframe. Translate strategic direction into clear requirements and use cases that engineering can act on directly, and follow them down to the Jira tickets. Surface and shape the good ideas that come from engineering — many of the best ones do — and connect them to a product rationale. Define success criteria for each capability, and verify they are actually met through implementation and delivery. Maintain an accurate, shared view of Loft's product capabilities, what is in development, and where the gaps are. Bring the outside in Run customer discovery interviews alongside business development, and debrief missions to see how Loft's capabilities are actually used in operations. Engage directly with the partners building on our platform, including the onboard AI application ecosystem, to understand their needs and constraints. Track market trends and competitive moves closely enough to know where our offering stands. Decide and prioritize Own the roadmap for your perimeter, reconciling customer needs, engineering reality, and Loft's strategy into a single coherent plan. Build the analysis behind every recommendation — sizing, segmentation, business cases, operational data — so decisions are grounded in evidence rather than intuition alone. Negotiate scope and delivery commitments with engineering leadership, and re-plan when capacity or mission timelines shift. Challenge, constructively and with data, business development, engineering leadership, and your own assumptions. Communicate Own internal communication on your perimeter: keep engineering, program leadership, and executives working from the same technical reality. Develop the technical narratives and proof points that marketing and BD then turn into their own customer-facing material. Prepare recommendations and presentations for top-executive-level audiences. Must Haves: 7+ years of professional experience, including hands-on product management. Domain experience in at least one of: earth observation, embedded systems, aerospace systems, security & defense. Comfort at both ends of the spectrum — understand the market, and the technology Structured and data-driven: you bring your experience and your intuitions, but when you put a recommendation on the table you can show the analysis it stands on. Real product obsession: you think about the bigger picture and product-market fit before you think about features. Relentless curiosity. In a single month you might move from a satellite bus constraint, to onboard AI inference, to a defense accreditation requirement — and you need to find that stimulating rather than exhausting. High autonomy and a bias for action: handed a broad perimeter, you organize it yourself and come back with a plan. At ease being challenged, and challenging others, in a fast-moving and demanding environment. Working knowledge of both hardware and software development lifecycles. Proficient using and configuring Atlassian tools (Jira and Confluence). Fluency in English, written and spoken. Willingness to travel to other Loft offices and to customers. Nice to Haves: Fluency in French. Experience with AI/ML products, edge computing, or developer and partner platforms and ecosystems. title: Lead AI Engineer - ML/LLM Ops & Agentic AI
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Shift delivers AI agents that transform insurers' most critical work. We come from more than 50 different countries and cultures and together we are creating the future of insurance.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Learn more at <a href="http://www.shift-technology.com" target="_blank">www.shift-technology.com</a></span></p> <p> </p></div><h3><strong>ABOUT THE ROLE</strong></h3> <p>At Shift, we are building the next generation of AI-driven platform capabilities. You will lead a focused team of engineers and work directly with software engineers and product leaders to design, prototype, and ship state-of-the-art AI systems into production, while acting as the link with our Data Science team to align priorities with their needs and spread best practices.</p> <p>If you are a senior AI engineer looking for the next step in your career, where you can lead people and shape a roadmap <strong>without giving up hands-on coding and building</strong>, this role is for you.</p> <h3> </h3> <h3><strong>WHAT YOU'LL DO</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Build agentic systems (hands-on):</strong> design and ship production-grade agentic workflows (LLM orchestration, tool calling, MCP, RAG, structured outputs), and define reference architectures that decide what a model handles and what deterministic code handles.</li> <li><strong>Own LLMOps standards:</strong> evaluation harnesses, prompt and agent versioning, tracing (OpenTelemetry), cost and token governance, and release gates, with tenant-aware patterns that respect client data isolation.</li> <li><strong>Evolve our ML platform:</strong> be the technical owner of our Databricks-based ML platform (Unity Catalog, MLflow, CI/CD to serving on AKS, monitoring), and extend it toward the agent and prompt lifecycle.</li> <li><strong>Run & Serve Open-Weight Models:</strong> Partner closely with our Cloud Ops team to design and deploy the architecture required to self-host open-weight foundation models internally. You will own the inference layer and model optimizations (latency, throughput), while collaborating seamlessly with Cloud Ops on GPU resource provisioning and cluster management.  </li> <li><strong>Push the frontier:</strong> run time-boxed POCs on emerging techniques, such as relational foundation models for claims fraud detection or agentic ingestion of medical billing sources to generate claim edits, with clear success criteria and a path to production.</li> <li><strong>Lead and grow the team:</strong> coach and develop 2 to 5 people, raise the technical bar through design and code reviews, and partner with product, SMEs, architecture, security and SRE.</li> </ul> <h3> </h3> <h3><strong>WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Agentic AI expertise:</strong> proven experience building production agentic systems (Microsoft Agent Framework, OpenAI Agents SDK, PydanticAI, LangGraph or custom), and strong command of tool calling, MCP, RAG and evaluation.</li> <li><strong>MLOps and engineering:</strong> high proficiency in Python; hands-on experience with experiment tracking, model registry, serving and monitoring (ideally Databricks and MLflow); backend services on Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform and event-driven patterns.</li> <li><strong>Applied ML curiosity:</strong> solid ML foundations, ability to judge new approaches critically; exposure to graph ML, fraud or claims data is a plus.</li> <li><strong>Software design:</strong> high proficiency in Python and strong experience with OOP; proven ability to design robust, maintainable software systems and write clean code, applying the right design patterns and software engineering best practices.</li> <li><strong>Leadership:</strong> experience leading technical initiatives across stakeholders, and coaching or managing technical contributors (or a clear motivation to do so).</li> <li><strong>English</strong> fluency required; French is a plus.</li> </ul> <h3> </h3> <h3><strong>HOW YOU WORK (Shift High-Impact Behaviors)</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Jump in and get things done:</strong> You are a proactive builder who loves turning ambitious ideas into working code.
