title: Team Lead - Platform Engineering
description: About the role: We are looking for a new team lead for one of the teams within our Infra Platform Group. Your mission in this role is to architect and deliver foundational services that empower the product engineering teams building our e-commerce platform. Together with your team, you will be tackling challenging engineering problems, working on high-performing and scalable services written in Haskell and Rust, while also providing a high-quality developer experience for the teams that use them via Python. Your time will be split approximately 50-50 between leadership tasks and hands-on development. In your leadership role, you are a mentor to your team members, unblocking them when they face challenging roadblocks, and you help them grow both their hard and soft skills. As part of your hands-on work, you are contributing to the architecture and the ongoing development and maintenance of our services. You will initially be managing a team of four experienced Haskell and Rust engineers, and you will be working closely together with the other teams in the group, the engineering manager of the Infra Platform Group, and the stakeholders from other engineering teams that consume our services. If you don't have direct experience with Haskell, but you have solid experience with Rust or Scala and a willingness to learn Haskell, please submit your application, as we are still happy to consider it! Your responsibilities: Your Team Lead tasks will include: Organizing the work and managing priorities Collaborating with the other team leads in the Infra Platform Group on the long-term roadmap Mentoring team members, helping them grow and holding half-yearly performance reviews with them Setting up project teams and mentor project leads Hiring new team members Implementing and improving upon our processes for the team Establishing the team culture and fostering a collaborative environment Your Development tasks will include: Designing, developing and testing new features in our services Improving the reliability and robustness of our application Working on scalability and performance improvements Collaborating with and review PRs of other engineers Breaking down big projects into smaller issues Writing clear and actionable issues Debugging and fixing issues, and teaching team members to do the same Working together with our product engineering teams and DevOps team on requirements and issues Who are you? You like working in a dynamic team of skilled engineers, discussing technical decisions openly and collaboratively. It is easy for you to break down big issues into smaller tasks and to prioritize work pragmatically. To set you up for success in this role, we think you'll benefit from having the following skills and experience: You have previous experience leading an engineering team, or you are an experienced engineer, excited to start your career as a leader. You can give detailed code reviews both from a high-level and a low-level perspective. You have the technical depth to help your team members grow and can remove roadblocks for them. You have substantial backend development experience, you are experienced with functional programming concepts, and are comfortable working with either Haskell, Scala, or Rust. Experience with Python is a plus. You are familiar with relational databases (ideally PostgreSQL), Linux and git. You have experience with web development, web technologies, and APIs You have strong communication and problem-solving skills You are a people-oriented individual who helps others with an open and approachable attitude. You value high software engineering standards. You are pragmatic and empathic towards your team members and other stakeholders (i.e. colleagues from other departments etc). You like helping the team focus on the most important tasks, making sure its priorities and plans align with the rest of the company (we use the OKR framework for this). Practical requirements: EU citizenship or a valid work permit for the Netherlands; you are preferably already living in the Netherlands Available for at least 32 hours a week, with two days spent at the Utrecht office Important note: We understand that studies show women may only apply for roles when they feel they meet 100% of the requirements; therefore, we strongly encourage you to apply even if you don't check every box, as we are looking for passionate individuals with potential and a willingness to grow. Who are we? Channable was founded in 2014 in the heart of Utrecht and is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform that offers a fully integrated way to market your products online. We empower marketers and online businesses to manage, scale, and optimize their marketing. We are now a strong team of 320+ diverse individuals from more than 40+ nationalities. Joining Channable means you’re looking for a bit more than just a job. Diverse as we are, we all share our love for growth, to help, to take ownership, and create an awesome journey together. Feel free to take a further look at who we are here and on our Instagram or LinkedIn ! Wanna get to know us even more? Give our Culture Playbook a read. Why Channable? At Channable, you’ll find a culture that values openness, craftsmanship, and collaboration. We invest in our people and give them the autonomy to drive meaningful change. You'll work on technical challenges that matter, with colleagues who care deeply about the product and each other. What do we offer? Gross annual salary ranging from € 77k-103k, including 8% holiday allowance and based on a 40-hour work week. This salary range reflects our career framework. Your final role level will be determined throughout the recruitment process, based on alignment with this framework. Savings for old age: we have a savings scheme for old age, which can accrue up to 5% of your monthly salary, or you can get an additional +2.5% to your monthly base salary. Annual L&D budget of €1000 to spend on your professional growth. Stock Appreciation Rights: you can profit from Channable’s success. Company-wide performance bonus, up to 10% of your annual salary, determined yearly by our founders based on financial planning and targets. 26 vacation days + 2 reload days based on 40 hours, with the possibility of buying up to 5 extra vacation days per year. Are you going to become a parent? Enjoy 5 weeks of 100% paid partner leave! Commuting to our office? Choose between an NS Business Card or a €0.25/km travel allowance for alternative transport. Work from our office in central Utrecht at least 2 days a week, and from home for the rest (we'll provide the gear and a budget for extra supplies). Plus, enjoy flexible working hours with a morning start window between 8:00 AM and 10:00 AM. We offer a 3-week-long workcation; and an additional 3 weeks if you live as an expat in the Netherlands! Your well-being matters: we offer a discounted Urban Sports Club subscription and anonymous access to OpenUp psychologists and resources. Fresh daily lunch: enjoy fresh meals prepared Monday to Thursday by our in-house Chef (fully catering to vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free diets). On Fridays, we switch it up by ordering in tasty sandwiches and salads. Additional working conditions include massages, even personal training sessions at our Channagym, video games, an in-office bar, and many more! Channaweek & Channaweekend: connect with your global colleagues at our annual team gathering in Utrecht, and pack your bags for Channaweekend, our annual company-wide getaway. How can you introduce yourself to us? Are you interested? To ensure your application reaches the right team quickly, please submit it in English directly through our careers page by clicking the “Apply” button. Applications submitted via email won’t be considered. If it's a match, Ioana (Tech Talent Acquisition Partner) will get in touch with you for an introductory call. After that, you'll be invited for interviews. We look forward to hearing from you as soon as possible! Contact by job agencies and recruiters will not be appreciated. Each recruiter or headhunter who approaches us agrees with a donation of €250 for Make-A-Wish. At Channable, we strive to create and foster an environment of belonging and collaboration and we believe in diverse and inclusive teams. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Social Creative
description: Intro Wil jij als creative deel uitmaken van een snel groeiend en tech gedreven creatief advertising & content bureau in de Houthavens en samen met een leuk team werk maken dat opvalt, werkt én connact? ACT. Now! Advertising, Content en Technology, samen met jou ACT.agency staat voor Advertising, Content & Technology together. Wij geloven dat advertising en content via een geïntegreerde aanpak ontwikkeld moet worden, versnelt door technology. Met onze ACT.vertising aanpak zorgen we ervoor dat merken zich strategisch en creatief onderscheiden, always-on communiceren en zo consistent blijven op de lange én korte termijn. In ons kantoor in de Amsterdamse Houthavens werken we met 32 mensen aan accounts als Odido, PwC, Mercedes-Benz Trucks, Schiphol, Museumkaart, Noordhoff en Prinses Máxima Centrum. ACT zoekt een medior Social Creative. Of ben je juist een medior creatief met veel social ervaring? Allebei kan. Je bedenkt alleen of samen in een team het concept, schrijft het uit en maakt het zelf, snel en met de nieuwste technologie. Taken Als creative bij ACT bedenk je concepten die kloppen, de kern raken en waar iedereen energie van krijgt. Social is jouw vak: ongeveer 80% van je werk. De rest is breder creatief werk, zoals campagne-ideeën en pitches. Je schrijft het script, pakt zelfs eventueel de camera en kan het ook zelf monteren. Van idee tot eindresultaat is het van jou. Je idee staat als t moet als eerste versie binnen een dag. Je weet wat er speelt op Insta, TikTok en YouTube Shorts. Je presenteert je ideeën intern en bij de klant, onderbouwt ze op basis van de briefing en denkt tactisch mee, met gelaagdheid in je campagnes. Je spart dagelijks met de creative directors en werkt samen met strategie, account, social media manegers en community management. Wij vragen Je hebt minimaal 2 tot 3 jaar ervaring als creative bij een creatief bureau, met veel social ervaring Je hebt een portfolio met werk dat je zelf hebt bedacht én gemaakt, met aantoonbare resultaten Je kunt idealiter zelf filmen en monteren, bijvoorbeeld in Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut of DaVinci Je maakt zelf content en brengt een idee in korte tijd van concept naar een eerste versie Je bent nieuwsgierig naar technologie en gebruikt AI-tools in je dagelijkse werk, bijvoorbeeld voor beeld, video, geluid of tekst. title: AI platform engineer
description: Wil jij werken op het snijvlak van cloud, platform engineering en AI? Bij Itility krijg je de ruimte om te bouwen aan een platform dat onze engineers en klantenteams helpt slimmer, efficiënter en veiliger te werken. Je ontwikkelt niet alleen nieuwe functionaliteiten, maar denkt ook actief mee over hoe we AI en automation kunnen inzetten om onze dienstverlening verder te verbeteren. Wat jij gaat doen Je bouwt mee aan de verdere ontwikkeling van ons platform en vertaalt behoeften vanuit onze klantenteams naar concrete, herbruikbare oplossingen. Je werkt aan features vanuit de roadmap, maar signaleert ook zelf waar verbeteringen mogelijk zijn. Een belangrijk onderdeel van je werk is het toepassen van AI en automation. Je ontwikkelt bijvoorbeeld AI-agents die informatie verzamelen en analyseren, engineers ondersteunen bij troubleshooting of binnen duidelijke kaders zelfstandig acties uitvoeren. Je zorgt ervoor dat deze oplossingen niet bij een proof of concept blijven, maar daadwerkelijk in productie worden gebruikt. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Het ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van nieuwe platformfunctionaliteiten. Het doorontwikkelen van onze centrale dashboard- en beheeromgeving. Het bouwen van AI-agents, agentic workflows, API's en integraties. Het ontwikkelen en verbeteren van Terraform-modules en andere automatiseringen. Het inrichten van human-in-the-loop-processen, approvals en guardrails. Het analyseren en automatiseren van terugkerende operationele werkzaamheden. Het ondersteunen bij incidenten, troubleshooting en wijzigingen wanneer dat nodig is. Je krijgt de ruimte om zelf verbeterkansen te signaleren, ideeën uit te werken en oplossingen te realiseren. Daarbij houd je altijd rekening met security, betrouwbaarheid en beheersbaarheid. Waar kom je terecht? Je maakt deel uit van het Platform Team binnen onze MSP-organisatie. Dit team ontwikkelt en beheert de centrale diensten waarop onze klantenteams vertrouwen. Het platform vormt de basis voor onze cloud-, data- en AI-dienstverlening en helpt engineers om hun werk efficiënt, veilig en consistent uit te voeren. Binnen het team werken we met onder andere: Microsoft Azure en AWS voor cloud-, data- en AI-foundations. Terraform voor Infrastructure as Code en herbruikbare infrastructuurmodules. LogicMonitor voor centrale monitoring. Puppet voor configuration management. Centrale dashboards en tooling voor het beheer en de ontsluiting van onze platformdiensten. We blijven investeren in de verdere ontwikkeling van dit platform. Daarbij willen we AI en automation een steeds grotere rol geven, zodat onze engineers minder tijd kwijt zijn aan repetitieve werkzaamheden en meer ruimte hebben voor complexe vraagstukken en innovatie. Daar hoort natuurlijk ook een aantrekkelijk arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket bij. Naast een salaris dat past bij jouw ervaring, achtergrond en potentie, kun je rekenen op: Een Leaseauto met tankpas of een mobiliteitsvergoeding met kilometervergoeding; €115 onkostenvergoeding per maand; 26 vakantiedagen per jaar; 50% bijdrage aan je ziektekostenverzekering van jou én die van je partner; 60% bijdrage aan je pensioenregeling; Een variabele bonusregeling gebaseerd op jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling en gezamenlijke successen; Laptop en telefoon; Hybride werken; Gebruik van gym op kantoor Dit ben jij Je bent in de eerste plaats een hands-on engineer. Je vindt het leuk om zelf oplossingen te ontwerpen en te bouwen, maar kijkt ook verder dan het individuele ticket. Je neemt initiatief, zoekt actief de samenwerking met de teams die ons platform gebruiken en signaleert waar processen en diensten beter kunnen. Je denkt in herbruikbare oplossingen en vraagt jezelf regelmatig af hoe werkzaamheden slimmer kunnen worden ingericht. Daarbij verlies je security, betrouwbaarheid en beheersbaarheid niet uit het oog. Je brengt mee; Een bachelor of masterdiploma in Informatica, Software engineering, Data Science/ AI of vergelijkbaar, Sterke kennis van Microsoft Azure en/of AWS, met diepgaande ervaring in minimaal één van beide. Ervaring met Python, .NET of een vergelijkbare programmeertaal. Ervaring met API's en integraties. Ervaring met Infrastructure as Code, bij voorkeur Terraform. Kennis van AI- en LLM-oplossingen en interesse in of ervaring met AI-agents en agentic workflows. Ervaring met CI/CD en moderne software-ontwikkelmethoden. Een proactieve houding, eigenaarschap en de motivatie om zelf verbeterkansen te signaleren en te realiseren. Nice to have; Ervaring met een of meer van de volgende technologieën en onderwerpen is een pré: Azure OpenAI, Azure AI-services, AWS Bedrock of andere AWS AI-services. LogicMonitor en Puppet. Observability en event-driven architecturen. Multi-tenantplatformen. Werken binnen een MSP-omgeving. Voldoe je niet aan alle eisen? Solliciteer gerust. We kijken naar impact en groeipotentieel. Screening is onderdeel van deze procedure. title: Senior Stack Scientist
description: Senior Stack Scientist About EH Energy Engineering EH Energy develops fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power. Our redesigned fuel cell is more compact, has higher power density and costs less to produce. We build high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to help address climate change and the move toward decentralised energy. As Senior Stack Scientist, you will own the scientific understanding of how our stacks perform and age. You will connect cell-level electrochemistry with stack-level design, operating conditions and manufacturing, and turn that understanding into stacks with higher power density, longer life and repeatable performance. Key Responsibilities Lead stack-level performance and durability investigations, from short stacks to full-size stacks. Define and run stack test campaigns: polarisation, EIS, cell voltage monitoring, durability and accelerated stress tests under realistic duty cycles. Analyse water management, thermal behaviour, gas distribution and cell-to-cell uniformity, and identify what limits performance. Investigate stack degradation and failure modes, including post-mortem analysis, and lead root-cause work with the materials, process and design teams. Develop and validate stack models (electrochemical, thermal, fluidic) to guide design choices and operating strategies. Set the operating windows, conditioning and break-in procedures, and the diagnostic methods used in development and production. Translate results into clear requirements for flow fields, bipolar plates, MEAs, sealing and compression. Mentor junior scientists and engineers, and present results to internal stakeholders and partners. Skills and Experience Required PhD or MSc in electrochemistry, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, materials science, physics or a related field. 12+ years of experience in fuel cell stack development or testing (PEM preferred). Strong grasp of stack physics: water and heat management, reactant distribution, contact resistance and compression. Hands-on experience with stack test benches, cell voltage monitoring, EIS and durability/AST protocols. Solid understanding of MEA, GDL and bipolar plate degradation mechanisms. Experience with modelling and data analysis tools (e.g. Python, MATLAB, COMSOL or similar). Ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations. Team player who can also work autonomously in a fast-moving environment. Management experience English is mandatory; French or German is a plus. Start date: Immediately Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Marketing & Content Intern (Haarlem)
description: Six restaurants. Six dishes. One afternoon, every dish with a pairing to match. An introduction to a city's food scene, and to the people shaping it. We have been making those introductions in the Netherlands as WijnSpijs since 2013. Table6 carries the same standards into the UK and Germany. The Netherlands is where we started and it is still the market we know best. Keeping it that way takes a steady stream of content: Dutch restaurants and creators to find and contact, footage and photography to collect and label, stories filmed on event days, posts prepared and checked after they go out. We are looking for a Marketing & Content Intern to work on all of it with us. The briefs, templates and guidelines already exist, so you are never starting from a blank page. You will use them from week one and take on more of the work yourself as you go. Most of what you do will be in Dutch. You will report to our Marketing Lead. The internship is hybrid, with agreed office days in Haarlem. Tasks Research restaurants, creators, photographers and videographers, and build shortlists against the criteria the marketing team gives you. Contact them, ask for footage, and follow up until it arrives. Come to selected events, including some Sundays, and film dishes, pairings, guest moments and the walk between restaurants to a short brief. Upload, name and label everything in Notion and Google Drive, so an editor can find it without asking you. Watch what our restaurant partners post, respond where it makes sense, and flag anything the marketing team should see. Prepare approved posts for scheduling, with captions, tags, links and locations, and check afterwards that they went out properly. In your first weeks you and your Marketing Lead agree what you want out of the internship and what you will own by the end of it. Requirements Fluent Dutch and strong English, written and spoken. Enrolled in a relevant study, and available full time for at least four months. Organised and accurate, with several requests and deadlines running at once. Comfortable writing to restaurants and creators yourself, and confident enough to ask when something falls outside the guidelines. At home on social platforms, and comfortable with Google Drive and simple spreadsheets. Available for selected Sunday events. They are always planned in advance. Nice to have, not essential Filming or editing for social; Canva, Notion or Meta Business Suite. Experience in a customer-facing job in hospitality or retail. A real interest in food and restaurants counts for more with us than a perfect CV. If you recognise yourself in most of the above, apply. Benefits A monthly internship allowance Hybrid, with agreed office days Lunch with the team A close view of how content gets made across three markets, from the brief through sourcing, capture, approval and publishing A seat at the restaurants on our lineups. Knowing what a good afternoon feels like is part of the job Sounds like your kind of work? Please apply with your CV and a cover letter, both in English. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Business Developer B2B & Retail
description: Bij de meeste salesbanen stopt je werk bij de afspraak. Bij MarketLeap begint het daar pas. Ik ben Luc, mede-oprichter van MarketLeap. Daarna blijf jij het aanspreekpunt, want de herhaalorders zijn waar het geld zit, voor de klant en voor jou. Zo ziet dit er in de praktijk uit. Zelf heb ik voor een van ons klanten een stoomreiniger bij Makro in het assortiment geplaatst, en de tweede,derde en vierde bestelling volgde. Een collega bouwde bij Decathlon een relatie op waar de orders sindsdien blijven doorlopen. In de eerste 30 dagen zorgde dit al voor tienduizenden euro's extra omzet voor onze klant. Elke week bel je zo'n 80 tot 100 keer, ongeveer twee uur per dag. De rest van je tijd gaat naar het uitdenken van de strategie, klant management, voeren van warme gesprekken, voorstellen uitwerken, op afspraak gaan en het bijhouden van je pijplijn. Elke maandag stuur je de ondernemer achter het merk je weekplan en elke vrijdag je evaluatie. Hoe je start: In je eerste maand krijg je één of twee eigen klanten. We doen niet aan een meeloopperiode van een kwartaal. Vanaf dag één heb je direct een klant waar jij verantwoordelijk voor bent. Zo leer je accountmanagement, sales en relatiebeheer op de enige manier die werkt, door het te doen. Je doet dat niet alleen. Week 1 zit je in het inwerkprogramma. Hierin neem je onze SOP's door, leer je de systemen kennen en kijk je mee bij een collega op een lopende deal. Daarna heb je een ervaren buddy die je eerste mails valideert en na je eerste gesprekken met je terugkijkt. Wekelijks krijg je salestraining en heb je een 1-op-1 met mij. Dagelijks kun je bij mij en de buddy terecht. Vereisten 2 tot 5 jaar werkervaring in een commerciële rol. Je hebt al deals geclosed en kunt dit aantonen. Je hebt ook geleerd waarom een deal niet doorging en wist dit vervolgens snel te implementeren. Je woont binnen een uur van Utrecht en bent drie dagen per week op kantoor. Rijbewijs en een eigen auto zijn een must. Je gaat naar onze klanten en potentiële afnemers toe. Vloeiend Nederlands, in spraak en op papier. 40 uur per week beschikbaar, in loondienst. Je neemt eigenaarschap over je pijplijn en je resultaten. Je krijgt energie van targets, deals en een product dat door jou uiteindelijk in het schap terug te vinden is. Benefits Basissalaris 3.200 tot 3.700 euro per maand, afhankelijk van ervaring. De helft van de commissie die wij factureren over deals die jij sluit. Ook over elke herhaalorder, twee tot drie jaar lang. Geen plafond. Extra bonussen bij grote wins. Kilometervergoeding van €0,23,-per kilometer. 25 vakantiedagen Interne salestraining en dagelijks aan het werk met de nieuwste AI-tooling, ingericht voor dit werk. Een hecht team van zes business developers en twee founders, 28 lopende klant trajecten, winstgevend en groeiend. Hybride: drie dagen kantoor in Utrecht, twee dagen thuis. Regelmatige leuke teamuitjes en sportieve activiteiten zoals padel. Herken je jezelf hierin? Stuur je CV en drie regels over een deal waar je het meest trots op bent. Binnen twee werkdagen hoor je van mij. Daarna plannen we een belafspraak in van 20 a 30 minuten, gevolgd door een gesprek op kantoor in Utrecht met mij en een van de business developers. Bij een match vanuit beide kanten ontvang je een concreet aanbod. Van sollicitatie tot handtekening duurt zo'n twee weken en eventueel sneller als het kan. Luc Broos, mede-oprichter MarketLeap Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

You do not need to build every workflow yourself, but you should be able to understand Notion systems, coach workflow design, and help your team troubleshoot adoption blockers. - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems. - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious, hands-on, and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter, coach better, and help customers deliver better outcomes. This team will help us gain insights into the business and our talent pool, and use those insights to improve the experience of working at Canonical.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">As a Workplace Engineer at Canonical, you need an analytical, data-driven mind and a passion to connect and make sense of interesting data from APIs. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Annual compensation review</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Recognition rewards</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Annual holiday leave</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Maternity and paternity leave</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</span></li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. title: Customer Success  - Team Manager
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing. </p> <p><strong>We are hiring a Customer Success - Team Manager.</strong></p> <p>To support Canonical's growth, we are expanding our CSM team globally and recruiting leaders to support and drive our Customer Success teams regionally. We consider our Customer Success operations an exceptional tool to sustain revenue retention and growth, placing excellence in delivering outstanding customer services in the new technologies sector. As such, we are looking for exceptional candidates with proven track records in Customer Success management and an obvious passion for new technologies. </p> <p>You will enjoy this role if you are organised, persistent, analytical, diplomatic, a listener, hard-working, and determined to grow your skills and teams. As a lead, you will provide mentoring, coaching in post-sales account management and feedback to team members. You will play a crucial role in proactively identifying areas of improvement and implementing process change, driving high-performing teams. Comfortable dealing with ambiguity you will be equip to quickly adapt to change. Collaboration with other teams is also vital to this role to enhance the overall customer experience. Your key responsibility will be to analyze regional performance metrics, identify trends and opportunities for improvement, and implement changes to increase efficiency and achieve business objectives. You will work in close collaboration with the Global Head of Customer Success to drive results.</p> <p>We engage with a diverse customer base and follow a diverse set of motions to provide the appropriate and required level of focus for every customer. The successful candidate will be able to demonstrate the ability to pivot right across this customer base regardless of culture, location or focus.</p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>This opportunity is available in the APAC region and is remote.</p> <p><strong>The role entails:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic planning and analysis:</strong> preparing communication plans, team meetings, and other messages shared in broader management forums, setting yourself and your team up for success. Regularly reviewing key performance indicators and metrics is your baseline. You will develop strategies to enhance customer engagement, improve retention rates, drive up-sells or cross-sells where appropriate, and ultimately increase customer success.</li> <li><strong>Customer interactions and support to your team:</strong> resolve escalated customer issues requiring expertise or intervention ensuring timely resolution.</li> <li><strong>Team management:</strong> passionate about guiding and supporting your team members, helping them navigate complex customer situations, improve their skills, and achieve their goals. Conducting regular performance reviews with team members you will also help identifying areas for improvement/development as well as celebrating excellence, recognising team achievements, and setting goals for individual growth. </li> <li><strong>Cross-functional collaboration: </strong>collaboration with other departments, such as Sales, Marketing, Product development, and Support, is essential. This ensures alignment on customer needs, feedback sharing, and coordinated efforts to drive customer success. You will establish trustworthy channels of communication across the board.</li> <li><strong>Documentation and reporting: </strong>you are allowed to be creative! While building content with your team and your manager, you will also ensure the changes are well documented, instilling quality and attention to detail in all you do.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></p> <ul> <li>Excellent academic results at school and university</li> <li>Bachelor’s or equivalent degree in Business, Communication or STEM subject</li> <li>Knowledge and passion for Customer Success, revenue management and technology, experience in SaaS or software industries</li> <li>Track record of bringing exceptional Customer Success experience results</li> <li>Commitment to continuous learning and improvement - curious, flexible, scientific</li> <li>Creative problem-solving and cross-team collaboration</li> <li>Experience growing and developing a CSM team</li> <li>Hands-on approach to using data to drive team activities and continuous improvement</li> <li>Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Whilst English is our business language, proficiency (both written and spoken) in Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, or French will be valued.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we offer you</strong></p> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others</li> <li>Priority Pass for travel</li> </ul> <p><strong>About Canonical</strong></p> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background creates a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p> </p> <p>#LI-remote </p>

Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Canonical is growing its channel sales team to capitalize on rapidly growing demand from channel partners, leveraging their expertise and connections to bring open source technology to organizations across a multitude of industries.  </span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The role requires a mix of both farming and hunting capabilities. The successful candidate will be responsible for achieving assigned annual growth quotas. </span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">They should be able to identify, prospect, and engage reseller and distributor partners to build and maintain relationships and grow Canonical’s business within the assigned territory.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The successful candidate must be comfortable owning and leading initiatives in an unstructured, startup-like environment.  This individual must be able to sell open source, cloud, virtualization, and technical software solutions.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Although the role is focused primarily on reseller and distributor channel partners, the successful candidate must be capable of and comfortable with initial customer discovery calls and presentations as appropriate.  </span></p> <h3><strong>The Role Entails</strong></h3> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Bachelor's level degree, preferably in a technology field</span></li> <li 400;">Fluency in English</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">An understanding of open source, Linux and Ubuntu</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span distributed team through self-discipline and self-motivation</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Mature approach to long-term relationship development with customers</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">The ability to represent the company at external events</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span title: Credit Risk Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">📍Dublin | 💶 €93,500 - €114,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + benefits | <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U62l09nB0M4">Hear from the team</a> ✨</span></p> <p><strong>⭐ About the team:</strong></p> <p>Our Borrowing (lending) business is growing rapidly across both existing products and the planned launch of new initiatives. We aim to create a genuine feel-good factor when it comes to personal credit, and are looking for driven, analytical and creative individuals to help us achieve this goal.</p> <p>We’re looking for a Credit Risk Manager to help drive the credit and growth strategy for our consumer lending products as we grow our business in Ireland. Our credit teams are part of our Credit Discipline which drives a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. We’re great believers in powerful, real-time analytics and empowerment of the wider business. All our data lives in one place and is super easy to use. 90% of day-to-day data-driven decisions are covered by self-serve analytics through Looker which gives analysts the head space to focus on more impactful business questions and analyses.</p> <p>Join a team where your ideas can rapidly transform into reality, leveraging our cutting-edge technology and agile ways of working. Our credit analysts and managers are fully embedded into a product squad alongside Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, Marketers, Customer Researchers, Data Scientists etc. This enables us to solve customer problems in a fast paced and innovative way.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You'll play a key role by:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Working closely with Borrowing squad leadership to develop and execute an ambitious growth strategy </li> <li>Collaborating with people from engineering, marketing, product, risk and control to design and deliver new products and customer journeys</li> <li>Leading the development and maintenance of the NPV models and affordability strategies that underpin the Borrowing underwriting decisions</li> <li>Monthly monitoring and reporting on Borrowing performance to stakeholders up to executive level</li> <li>Collaborating with the Decision Science team to maximise value from our internal and external data through cutting-edge ML models</li> <li>Promoting a culture of proactive, high quality analysis and ensure we have the right credit capabilities, infrastructure and talent in place to scale safely</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!</li> <li>You have extensive experience in unsecured lending in Ireland</li> <li>You have a deep understanding of lending economics and have experience developing and deploying underwriting strategies and credit models</li> <li>You have strong analytical and data capabilities, backed up by technical coding skills. SQL, Python and Looker experience is a plus</li> <li>You have experience with the development and maintenance of NPV models</li> <li>You have a strong understanding of the regulations that apply to lending in Ireland</li> <li>You thrive in a fast-paced environment and are keen for the chance to improve our products and help ship changes to our customers</li> <li>You are a strong communicator, able to cut through complex problems and articulate decision points, particularly to senior leadership</li> <li>You have experience in project management and coordination across teams</li> <li>You work well collaborating in a team with diverse skill-sets and personality types</li> <li>You are highly motivated and energised by the idea of bringing a positive impact to our customers and Monzo</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💶 A salary range of €93,500 - €114,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance</p> <p>📍This role will have a hybrid working model, based in our Dublin office 3 days a week. You will also travel to Monzo’s head office in London from time to time</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team</p> <p>🏝 Annual Leave - 34 days including public holidays (24 holiday days + 10 public holidays)</p> <p>📚€1,200 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>🏥 Private healthcare scheme</p> <p>💰Pension scheme: the minimum contribution is 4% and Monzo matches any additional contributions that you make up to a maximum of 6%</p> <p>💛 Wellbeing benefits: financial education, women’s and men’s health support, mental health benefits, including coaching and counselling</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ol> <li>An introductory video call with a member of the Monzo Recruitment team</li> <li>An initial video call with the hiring manager</li> <li>A series of role specific, case study & behavioural interviews</li> <li>A final call with senior leadership</li> </ol> <p>This process should take around 4-5 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We'll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don't miss out.</p> <p>#LI-MOS1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. title: Senior Software Engineer - MAAS
location: Home Based - Americas; Home based - EMEA
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>The Canonical MAAS team is responsible for delivering our <a href="https://maas.io/" target="_blank">Metal As A Service</a> hyperscale provisioning technology. Ubuntu strives to be the most scalable, cloud ready server distribution and MAAS is our platform to get it there. MAAS is a rapidly evolving software stack written in Python and Go, and we are looking for experienced software engineers who understand performance at scale, networking, storage and usability.</p> <p>Applicants should be passionate about the future of Ubuntu and be able to show technical leadership with a globally distributed team of engineers who share that passion. This position requires international travel several times a year.</p> <p><strong>This role entails</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop MAAS core components and features to make MAAS the #1 bare metal cloud system.</li> <li>Shape the architecture of MAAS to make it simpler, faster and easier to use.</li> <li>Collaborate with other teams to ensure MAAS works well with other tools and is released on time.</li> <li>Contribute your improvements to our continuous integration environment, tests and practices, to maintain fast feedback and good test coverage.</li> <li>Contribute to documentation of current and existing features, making it world-class resource for Data Centre operators and users.</li> <li>Provide technical communication and collaboration with other teams where appropriate.</li> <li>Take personal ownership of problems and drive them to solutions.</li> <li><a href="https://canonical.com/careers/travel" target="_blank">Travel internationally</a> a few times a year to meet and collaborate with your and other teams. </li> </ul> <p><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></p> <ul> <li>Passionate about open source software, Linux, and Data Centre automation</li> <li>Solid track record of professional software development experience in Python, Go for back-end roles, or TypeScript, React for front-end roles.</li> <li>Capacity to learn quickly about new systems and techniques</li> <li>Excellent logic, problem solving, and troubleshooting skills</li> <li>Strong English language communication skills - both written and verbal</li> <li>Experience with Linux server technologies, including but not limited to Virtualization (KVM), Containers (LXC), etc.</li> <li>You have a Bachelor’s or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree</li> <li>Knowledge of network technologies, including PXE, DHCP, TFTP, DNS, NTP</li> <li>Some experience with Baseboard Management Controllers and Protocols (Redfish, IPMI, AMT and others)</li> <li>Strong experience with networking, storage technologies and Cloud hosting and infrastructure.</li> <li>Ideally, experience of large-scale physical server provisioning and automation, including rapid deployment, configuration, management and service orchestration.</li> <li>Familiarity with some of the open source development tools and methodologies used in creation of several Ubuntu projects (MAAS, Juju, Ubuntu Server, LXD, Ubuntu Core), such as Launchpad, Debian packaging tools (APT, dpkg) and snapcraft.</li> <li>An exceptional academic track record from both high school and preferably university.</li> <li>Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote</p>

They should also be astute judges of character, and comfortable setting expectations and holding colleagues accountable to them. </p> <p>We are building an observability stack that is easy to deploy and operate on Kubernetes. This is part of a broader initiative to deliver the world's best suite of open source tools, where we provide deep integration and automation for best-of-breed open source offerings that cover metrics, logging, telemetry, alerting, tracing and profiling. Our goal is to make observability tools integral and pervasive across software practices .</p> <p>Our implementation of Kubernetes operators is opinionated, resilient, and scalable, providing deep insights out of the box. The user experience is polished and seamless for the end-users, and its administrators will enjoy smooth, lightweight Day 1 and Day 2 operations. We are excited to be improving the state of the art for open-source observability.</p> <p>This is an exciting opportunity for a software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, Kubernetes, and Observability. Build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, the growing international software company behind Ubuntu.</p> <p>As an Engineering Manager at Canonical, you must be technically strong, but your main responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You will develop and review code as a leader, but know that the best way to improve the product is to ensure that the whole team is focused, productive and unblocked. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do meaningful work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. You will also be expected to be a positive influence on culture, facilitate technical delivery, and regularly reflect with your team on strategy and execution. You will collaborate closely with other Engineering Managers, product managers, and architects, producing an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals.</p> <p>We expect Engineering Managers to be fluent in the programming language, architecture, and components that their team uses. Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. The commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation is as important, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure title: Senior FinCrime Operations Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">📍Dublin | 💶 €76,500 - €95,500 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + benefits | <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U62l09nB0M4">Hear from the team</a> ✨</span></p> <p><strong>⭐ Our FinCrime, Fraud and Dispute Operations team</strong></p> <p>Reporting to the EU Director of FinCrime, Fraud and Dispute Operations, we're looking for a Senior Financial Crime Ops Manager to join our fast-growing EU team here in Dublin. You will need to oversee our outsourced partners, holding them accountable for SLAs and performance. This position requires in-depth data analysis expertise and a strong commitment to data-driven decision making, alongside a solid understanding of day-to-day fincrime operations and deep knowledge of transaction monitoring, AML/CTF, screening, and onboarding rules and models implementation. You will work across different areas and products including our current and business accounts and partner with our group data science, data engineering, product, and technology teams.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Driving strategic partners oversight: Ensuring that our outsourcing partners for FinCrime Operations are operating effectively.</li> <li>Monitoring our FinCrime metrics and driving action delivery with our product teams to address the trends.</li> <li>Combining hands-on execution with strategic thinking to align cross-functional teams with our FinCrime, AML/ CTF vision and strategy.</li> <li>Helping to build and oversee solutions with technology at the heart of our screening, onboarding and transaction monitoring mitigation strategies to cover the various typologies using automated alerts.</li> <li>Supporting the Director of FinCrime, Fraud and Disputes operations with producing Committee packs.</li> <li>Supporting and managing the oversight of change implementation, making prioritisation calls of those initiatives. </li> <li>Working closely with the second line of defence and our Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO) to complete assurance activity, identification and remediation of any actions. </li> <li>Collaborating across the company to remove roadblocks and solve complex challenges relating to Monzo's EU expansion.</li> <li>Supporting 3rd line of defence with auditing activities. </li> <li>Being an excellent partner to our third party vendors, unblocking and empowering their teams for high delivery and high performance. </li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You excel at leveraging robust data insights and analytics to drive strategic decision-making.</li> <li>You are a problem solver who takes initiative to create a high impact for stakeholders.</li> <li>Excel at stakeholder management and coordination across multiple teams.</li> <li>You have previous experience of achieving results through 3rd party/outsourcing  management and you’re excited about working in a cross-functional team with engineers and data scientists to empower third party vendors' success.</li> <li>You have previous experience leading and managing FinCrime operations in payments or banking.</li> <li>You enjoy partnering with 3rd party vendors, data scientists, and second line of defence (2LOD) to proactively mitigate and respond to existing and emerging fraud trends.</li> <li>You understand the Financial crime,  money mulling risks of the various products and services operating in the fintech space.</li> <li>You champion the use of automated processes to find more efficient ways of working.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💶 A salary range of €76,500 - €95,500 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance</p> <p>📍This role will have a hybrid working model, based in our Dublin office 3 days a week. You will also travel to Monzo’s head office in London from time to time</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team</p> <p>🏝 Annual Leave - 34 days including public holidays (24 holiday days + 10 public holidays)</p> <p>📚€1,200 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>🏥 Private healthcare scheme</p> <p>💰Pension scheme: the minimum contribution is 4% and Monzo matches any additional contributions that you make up to a maximum of 6%</p> <p>💛 Wellbeing benefits: financial education, women’s and men’s health support, mental health benefits, including coaching and counselling</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ol> <li>An introductory video call with a member of the Monzo Recruitment team</li> <li>An initial video call with the hiring manager</li> <li>A series of role specific, behavioural & leadership principles interviews</li> </ol> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We'll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don't miss out.</p> <p>#LI-MOS1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

You will develop engineering talent, establish effective engineering practices, shape technical direction with senior engineers, and ensure the team delivers high-quality testing infrastructure and automation that enables engineering teams across Canonical to ship software with confidence.</p> <p>We believe engineering managers should be outstanding engineers themselves. You should be comfortable reviewing patches, evaluating software design, debugging a distributed system, or discussing test architecture. team.</p> <p>You will work closely with senior engineers and engineering leaders across Canonical to define priorities, improve testing capabilities, and advance how we validate increasingly complex cloud-native and distributed systems.</p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>This is a globally remote role, typically leading a team concentrated within a major time zone such as EMEA or the Americas.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of software and quality engineers, ranging from graduate to senior level</li> <li>Set clear expectations, strengthen engineering practices, and ensure timely delivery against agreed goals</li> <li>Partner with senior engineers to shape technical strategy, architecture, roadmap, and engineering standards</li> <li>Guide the development of automated testing infrastructure for the reliability, interoperability, and resilience of distributed systems</li> <li>Improve CI pipelines, testing tools, and reporting used to validate Canonical's products and solutions across bare-metal, private and public cloud environments</li> <li>Enable engineering teams across Canonical to adopt effective distributed-systems testing practices and tooling</li> <li>Contribute technical leadership through design and code reviews, debugging, and hands-on engineering where appropriate</li> <li>Represent the team with stakeholders and collaborate across Canonical on quality engineering, infrastructure, and developer experience</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we're looking for in you</strong></h2> <ul> <li>An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university</li> <li>Experience in leading, coaching, and mentoring software engineers</li> <li>Professional software engineering experience with Python or Go</li> <li>Expertise in distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, quality engineering, or a closely related domain</li> <li>Strong knowledge of modern software testing processes, strategies, and automation</li> <li>Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred) </li> <li>Strong technical judgement and the ability to engage meaningfully in code reviews, architecture discussions, and software design</li> <li>Experience working in an agile development environment with the ability to organize a team to deliver high-quality results</li> <li>Professional written and spoken English with excellent communication and presentation skills </li> <li>Great interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability, demonstrating passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation</li> <li>Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Additional skills we value</strong></h2> <p>Experience with any of the following:</p> <ul> <li>Cloud technologies such as Kubernetes, OpenStack, Juju, Terraform, AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure</li> <li>Designing testing strategies for distributed or cloud-native systems</li> <li>Building or operating large-scale CI/CD and test infrastructure</li> <li>Applying AI or machine learning to test analysis, failure classification, or engineering workflows</li> <li>Deploying, operating, or debugging distributed systems</li> <li>Leading globally distributed teams</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h2> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually, and more often for graduates and associates, to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus.</p> <p>We provide all team members with additional benefits that reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programmes to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme and wellness support</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About Canonical</strong></h2> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. title: Senior Internal Controls Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">📍Dublin | 💶 €91,000 - €111,500 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + benefits | <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U62l09nB0M4">Hear from the team</a> ✨</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>⭐ Our Finance team</strong></span></p> <p>We are looking for a Senior Internal Controls Manager to join the Finance team at Monzo Bank Europe DAC based in Dublin.</p> <p>You will help Finance build and maintain a strong risk and control environment as we develop and grow our business across European markets. You will test key Finance controls, review evidence, support regulatory reporting assurance, track remediation actions and help improve the way Finance manages risk.</p> <p>Working across Financial Control, Regulatory Reporting, Treasury, FP&A, Tax, Risk & Compliance and Internal Audit, you will bring your accounting expertise, strong attention to detail and a practical approach to controls. You will be comfortable challenging processes, writing clear findings and helping teams improve.</p> <p>This is a great role for someone from audit, financial control or risk assurance who wants to help build a high-quality and robust Finance control environment in a growing digital bank.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Maintaining a robust and well-documented risk and control environment by improving documentation, evidence standards and control processes for the Finance team, and helping to ensure Finance-owned risks are aligned with MBEU’s risk appetite and the wider Enterprise Risk Management Framework.</li> <li>Designing, maintaining and enhancing Finance risk and control matrices for key processes.</li> <li>Performing regular control testing and review of evidence across Finance processes, including financial reporting, month-end close, balance sheet reconciliations, regulatory reporting, tax, treasury and capital/liquidity-related processes.</li> <li>Testing Finance controls and assessing design and operating effectiveness. Identifying control gaps, recommending enhancements, and embedding change by tracking remediation actions and progress.</li> <li>Leading and supporting Finance risk and control self-assessments, including evidence gathering, challenge and documentation.</li> <li>Preparing concise updates for Finance leadership on control testing results, open issues, remediation progress and emerging risks. Supporting risk assurance reporting to MBEU governance forums.</li> <li>Working with second-line Risk & Compliance teams on oversight reviews, assurance planning and risk reporting.</li> <li>Supporting Internal Audit and external audit requests relating to Finance controls.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>Hold a recognised accounting qualification, or be close to qualification, such as ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CPA Ireland or equivalent.</li> <li>Have detailed experience in audit, financial control, risk assurance, internal controls or regulatory reporting.</li> <li>Have experience in Banking, fintech or financial services experience.</li> <li>Can demonstrate a strong understanding of accounting processes, balance sheet controls, reconciliations and financial reporting risks.</li> <li>Have experience testing or reviewing controls, including assessing design and operating effectiveness.</li> <li>Can demonstrate strong attention to detail and ability to challenge evidence, assumptions and process weaknesses.</li> <li>Have experience in documenting robust processes, risks, controls, issues and remediation plans clearly.</li> <li>Have good interpersonal and influencing skills, ability to engage across various internal functions to develop, get buy-in and deliver outcomes across teams</li> <li>Have the ability to confidently present data in a meaningful and effective way; understanding the needs of the end users and tailoring presentations to their requirements</li> <li>Have experience building strong trusted relationships with stakeholders at all levels</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💶 A salary range of €91,000 - €111,500 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance</p> <p>📍This role will have a hybrid working model, based in our Dublin office 2 - 3 days a week. You will also travel to Monzo’s head office in London from time to time</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team</p> <p>🏝 Annual Leave - 34 days including public holidays (24 holiday days + 10 public holidays)</p> <p>📚€1,200 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>🏥 Private healthcare scheme</p> <p>💰Pension scheme: the minimum contribution is 4% and Monzo matches any additional contributions that you make up to a maximum of 6%</p> <p>💛 Wellbeing benefits: financial education, women’s and men’s health support, mental health benefits, including coaching and counselling</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ol> <li>An introductory video call with a member of the Monzo Recruitment team</li> <li>An initial video call with the hiring manager</li> <li>A series of role specific, behavioural & leadership principles interviews</li> </ol> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We'll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don't miss out.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>
